column13: /*     Usp_Qrcode_gheplot (gop HVN + YMVN Gear)     - @USEGEAR = 1 : nhanh Gear (YMVN MP). TMP co the la BANG hoac VIEW.         + Cot Gear: uu tien GEAR, khong co thi dung TTPHIEU (theo cot thuc su ton tai).         + Neu thieu cot, thong bao loi neu ro ten cot thieu.         + Bo qua cac dong TMP da Cap nhat kho (STATUS = 'OK') khi nap #GearSrc.     - @USEGEAR = 0 : nhanh HVN (logic OLD):         1) Khoa lot = LEFT(LOT, 20).         2) Thu tu duyet lot: LOT so tang dan (lot cu truoc).         3) Da XOA dong debug "select * from #IFSCursorTable" (gay grid Ghep lot trong,            vi C# doc nham result set dau tien).         4) Cursor lot doc SLCONLAITMP (ton tam sau khi tru cac don truoc) thay vi SLCONLAI,            giong Usp_Qrcode_gheplot(OLD). Doc SLCONLAI thi don nao cung thay ton day du            => khong bao gio sinh dong ghep.         5) Bo UPDATE STT/HOP tren TMP (gay trung STT giua cac dong cung MAHANG+SOLUONG+GIOGIAO).         6) Sua nhanh cuoi (@HT_SL >= @SOLUONG, @SLCANGHEP > 0): dung @SLCANGHEP truoc khi reset,            them truong hop @HT_SL < @SLCANGHEP.         7) MOI: Loai cac dong da Cap nhat kho (TMP.STATUS = 'OK', da tru SLCONLAI) khoi danh sach            can ghep lot. Khop dong bang MAHANG+SOLUONG+NGAYGIAO+GIOGIAO, danh so RN trong nhom            trung de chi loai dung so dong da OK (dong trung chua giao van duoc xu ly).         8) MOI: #IFSCursorTable nap theo NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO => gio som lay lot truoc.     Chi tra DUNG 1 result set cuoi cung (MH, GG, LG[, GearName]). */ CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_gheplot]     @TMPTABLE nvarchar(128) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',     @IFSTABLE nvarchar(128) = N'IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG',     @USEGEAR bit = 0,     @EXPECTEDTMPTABLE nvarchar(128) = NULL,     @VIEWTABLEPREFIX nvarchar(128) = NULL AS BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;      /* ======================= NHANH GEAR (@USEGEAR = 1) ======================= */     IF @USEGEAR = 1     BEGIN         IF @EXPECTEDTMPTABLE IS NULL OR @VIEWTABLEPREFIX IS NULL            OR (@TMPTABLE <> @EXPECTEDTMPTABLE                AND LEFT(@TMPTABLE, LEN(@VIEWTABLEPREFIX) + 1) <> @VIEWTABLEPREFIX + N'_'                AND @TMPTABLE <> N'YMVN_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG')             THROW 51221, N'Tên TMP không khớp CustomerTableConfig cho xử lý Gear.', 1;          DECLARE @GearObjectId int = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE));         IF @GearObjectId IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS            (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = @GearObjectId AND type IN (N'U', N'V'))             THROW 51222, N'Không tìm thấy bảng/VIEW TMP dùng cho xử lý Gear.', 1;          -- Chon cot Gear theo cot thuc su ton tai trong bang/VIEW         DECLARE @TmpFull nvarchar(300) = N'dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE);          DECLARE @GearCol sysname =             CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH(@TmpFull, N'GEAR')    IS NOT NULL THEN N'GEAR'                  WHEN COL_LENGTH(@TmpFull, N'TTPHIEU') IS NOT NULL THEN N'TTPHIEU'                  ELSE N'GEAR' END;          DECLARE @MissingCols nvarchar(500) = N'';         SELECT @MissingCols = @MissingCols + N',' + c.ColName         FROM (VALUES (N'MAHANG'),(N'SOLUONG'),(N'NGAYGIAO'),(N'GIOGIAO'),(@GearCol)) AS c(ColName)         WHERE COL_LENGTH(@TmpFull, c.ColName) IS NULL;          IF @MissingCols <> N''         BEGIN             DECLARE @Msg nvarchar(600) =                 N'TMP Gear thiếu cột: ' + STUFF(@MissingCols, 1, 1, N'') + N' (' + @TMPTABLE + N')';             THROW 51223, @Msg, 1;         END;          CREATE TABLE #GearSrc         (             MAHANG nvarchar(56) NOT NULL,             SOLUONG int NOT NULL,             NGAYGIAO datetime NULL,             GIOGIAO nvarchar(50) NULL,             GearText nvarchar(1000) NULL         );          -- Bo qua dong da Cap nhat kho (STATUS = OK) neu TMP co cot STATUS         DECLARE @GearStatusFilter nvarchar(200) =             CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH(@TmpFull, N'STATUS') IS NOT NULL                  THEN N' AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([STATUS], N'''')))) <> N''OK'''                  ELSE N'' END;          DECLARE @GearSql nvarchar(max) =             N'INSERT INTO #GearSrc(MAHANG,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,GearText)               SELECT MAHANG, TRY_CONVERT(int,SOLUONG), NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO,' + QUOTENAME(@GearCol) +               N' FROM dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) +               N' WHERE ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(int,SOLUONG),0) > 0 AND ISNULL(MAHANG,'''') <> ''''' +               @GearStatusFilter + N';';         EXEC sys.sp_executesql @GearSql;          CREATE TABLE #GearStock         (             StockId int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,             PART nvarchar(100) NOT NULL,             LOT13 nvarchar(20) NOT NULL,             GearCode nvarchar(10) NULL,             Qty int NOT NULL,             SortKey decimal(38,0) NULL         );          INSERT INTO #GearStock (PART, LOT13, GearCode, Qty, SortKey)         SELECT             s.PART,             LEFT(s.LOT, 20),                           -- 20 ky tu dau lam khoa LOT             SUBSTRING(s.LOT, 13, 1),                   -- ky tu thu 13 = B20Gear.Code             CONVERT(int, s.SLCONLAI),             TRY_CONVERT(decimal(38,0), LEFT(s.LOT, 20))         FROM dbo.STOCKTP s         WHERE s.SLCONLAI > 0           AND LEN(ISNULL(s.LOT, '')) >= 20           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GearSrc src WHERE src.MAHANG = s.PART);          CREATE TABLE #GearResult         (             ResultId int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,             MH nvarchar(56) NOT NULL,             GG nvarchar(50) NULL,             LG nvarchar(1000) NOT NULL,             GearName nvarchar(100) NULL         );          CREATE TABLE #GearItems         (             ItemId int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,             ItemQty int NOT NULL,             GearName nvarchar(100) NOT NULL,             GearCode nvarchar(10) NOT NULL         );          DECLARE @Part nvarchar(56), @OrderQty int, @DeliveryDate datetime, @DeliveryTime nvarchar(50),                 @GearTextValue nvarchar(1000), @PackQty int, @GearToken nvarchar(400),                 @ResolvedGearName nvarchar(100), @ResolvedGearCode nvarchar(10),                 @ItemQty int, @ItemGearName nvarchar(100), @ItemGearCode nvarchar(10),                 @LotKey nvarchar(20), @StockQty int, @Pending int,                 @LotList nvarchar(1000), @Need int, @ParsedQty int, @DigitStart int, @GearPartialQty int,                 @Digits nvarchar(40), @StockId int;          DECLARE GearOrderCur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR             SELECT MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO, GearText             FROM #GearSrc             ORDER BY MAHANG, NGAYGIAO, GearText, GIOGIAO;          OPEN GearOrderCur;         FETCH NEXT FROM GearOrderCur INTO @Part,@OrderQty,@DeliveryDate,@DeliveryTime,@GearTextValue;         WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0         BEGIN             SET @PackQty = NULL;             SELECT TOP(1) @PackQty = TRY_CONVERT(int,MinCloseQty)             FROM dbo.B20Item WHERE Code=@Part;             IF ISNULL(@PackQty,0) <= 0 SET @PackQty = 1;              TRUNCATE TABLE #GearItems;              /*               Vi du chuoi Gear: "Gear D : 5000pcs, Gear E : 300pcs"               Chu cai = B20Gear.Name ; LOT[13] = B20Gear.Code.             */             IF CHARINDEX(N',',ISNULL(@GearTextValue,N'')) > 0             BEGIN                 DECLARE GearTokenCur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                     SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(strval))                     FROM dbo.Split(@GearTextValue, N',')                     WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(strval)) <> N'';                 OPEN GearTokenCur;                 FETCH NEXT FROM GearTokenCur INTO @GearToken;                 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0                 BEGIN                     SET @ResolvedGearName = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@GearToken,6,1)));                     SET @DigitStart = PATINDEX('%[0-9]%',@GearToken);                     SET @Digits = CASE WHEN @DigitStart > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@GearToken,@DigitStart,40) ELSE N'' END;                     SET @ParsedQty = TRY_CONVERT(int,LEFT(@Digits,                         CASE WHEN PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%',@Digits+N'X') > 0                              THEN PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%',@Digits+N'X')-1 ELSE LEN(@Digits) END));                      SET @ResolvedGearCode = NULL;                     SELECT TOP(1) @ResolvedGearCode = CONVERT(nvarchar(10),Code)                     FROM dbo.B20Gear                     WHERE Name=@ResolvedGearName AND ISNULL(IsActive,1)=1                     ORDER BY Id;                      IF @ResolvedGearCode IS NULL OR @ParsedQty IS NULL OR @ParsedQty <= 0                     BEGIN                         CLOSE GearTokenCur; DEALLOCATE GearTokenCur;                         CLOSE GearOrderCur; DEALLOCATE GearOrderCur;                         THROW 51224, N'Không phân tích được Gear hoặc số lượng trong TMP YMVN. Kiểm tra B20Gear.Name/Code và chuỗi GEAR.', 1;                     END;                      INSERT INTO #GearItems(ItemQty,GearName,GearCode)                     VALUES(@ParsedQty,@ResolvedGearName,@ResolvedGearCode);                      FETCH NEXT FROM GearTokenCur INTO @GearToken;                 END;                 CLOSE GearTokenCur;                 DEALLOCATE GearTokenCur;             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 SET @ResolvedGearName = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(ISNULL(@GearTextValue,N''),6,1)));                 SET @ResolvedGearCode = NULL;                 SELECT TOP(1) @ResolvedGearCode = CONVERT(nvarchar(10),Code)                 FROM dbo.B20Gear                 WHERE Name=@ResolvedGearName AND ISNULL(IsActive,1)=1                 ORDER BY Id;                  IF @ResolvedGearCode IS NULL                 BEGIN                     CLOSE GearOrderCur; DEALLOCATE GearOrderCur;                     THROW 51224, N'Không ánh xạ được Gear.Name sang Gear.Code trong B20Gear.', 1;                 END;                  INSERT INTO #GearItems(ItemQty,GearName,GearCode)                 VALUES(@OrderQty,@ResolvedGearName,@ResolvedGearCode);             END;              DECLARE GearItemCur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                 SELECT ItemQty,GearName,GearCode FROM #GearItems ORDER BY ItemId;             OPEN GearItemCur;             FETCH NEXT FROM GearItemCur INTO @ItemQty,@ItemGearName,@ItemGearCode;             WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0             BEGIN                 -- Reset trang thai ghep cho MOI gear item                 SET @Need = @ItemQty;                 SET @Pending = 0;                 SET @LotList = N'';                  DECLARE GearLotCur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                     SELECT StockId,LOT13,Qty                     FROM #GearStock                     WHERE PART=@Part AND GearCode=@ItemGearCode AND Qty>0                     ORDER BY SortKey,LOT13,StockId;                 OPEN GearLotCur;                 FETCH NEXT FROM GearLotCur INTO @StockId,@LotKey,@StockQty;                 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0                 BEGIN                     IF @StockQty < @Need                     BEGIN                         IF @Pending > 0                         BEGIN                             IF @StockQty < @Pending                             BEGIN                                 SET @LotList = @LotList + N',' + @LotKey + N'-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20),@StockQty);                                 SET @Pending = @Pending - @StockQty;                                 SET @Need = @Need - @StockQty;                                 UPDATE #GearStock SET Qty=0 WHERE StockId=@StockId;                             END                             ELSE                             BEGIN                                 SET @LotList = @LotList + N',' + @LotKey + N'-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20),@Pending);                                 INSERT INTO #GearResult(MH,GG,LG,GearName)                                 VALUES(@Part,@DeliveryTime,@LotList,@ItemGearName);                                 SET @LotList = N'';                                 SET @GearPartialQty = (@StockQty - @Pending) % @PackQty;                                 IF @GearPartialQty = 0                                     SET @Pending = 0;                                 ELSE                                 BEGIN                                     SET @Pending = @PackQty - @GearPartialQty;                                     SET @LotList = @LotKey + N'-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20),@GearPartialQty);                                 END;                                 SET @Need = @Need - @StockQty;                                 UPDATE #GearStock SET Qty=0 WHERE StockId=@StockId;                             END;                         END                         ELSE                         BEGIN                             SET @GearPartialQty = @StockQty % @PackQty;                             IF @GearPartialQty = 0                                 SET @Pending = 0;                             ELSE                                 SET @Pending = @PackQty - @GearPartialQty;                              IF @GearPartialQty > 0                             BEGIN                                 IF @LotList = N''                                 BEGIN                                     SET @LotList = @LotKey + N'-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20),@GearPartialQty);                                     SET @Need = @Need - @StockQty;                                 END                                 ELSE                                 BEGIN                                     SET @LotList = @LotList + N',' + @LotKey + N'-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20),@GearPartialQty);                                 END;                                 UPDATE #GearStock SET Qty=0 WHERE StockId=@StockId;                             END                             ELSE                             BEGIN                                 SET @Pending = 0;                                 SET @Need = @Need - @StockQty;                             END;                         END;                     END                     ELSE                     BEGIN                         IF @Pending > 0                         BEGIN                             SET @LotList = @LotList + N',' + @LotKey + N'-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20),@Pending);                             INSERT INTO #GearResult(MH,GG,LG,GearName)                             VALUES(@Part,@DeliveryTime,@LotList,@ItemGearName);                             SET @LotList = N'';                             SET @Pending = 0;                             UPDATE #GearStock SET Qty=@StockQty-@Need WHERE StockId=@StockId;                             SET @Need = 0;                             BREAK;                         END                         ELSE                         BEGIN                             UPDATE #GearStock SET Qty=@StockQty-@Need WHERE StockId=@StockId;                             BREAK;                         END;                     END;                      FETCH NEXT FROM GearLotCur INTO @StockId,@LotKey,@StockQty;                 END;                 CLOSE GearLotCur;                 DEALLOCATE GearLotCur;                  FETCH NEXT FROM GearItemCur INTO @ItemQty,@ItemGearName,@ItemGearCode;             END;             CLOSE GearItemCur;             DEALLOCATE GearItemCur;              FETCH NEXT FROM GearOrderCur INTO @Part,@OrderQty,@DeliveryDate,@DeliveryTime,@GearTextValue;         END;         CLOSE GearOrderCur;         DEALLOCATE GearOrderCur;          SELECT MH,GG,LG,GearName         FROM #GearResult         WHERE CHARINDEX(N',',LG)>0         ORDER BY ResultId;         RETURN;     END;      /* ======================= NHANH HVN (@USEGEAR = 0) ======================= */     SET NOCOUNT ON;       DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);     DECLARE @MAHANG NVARCHAR(56), @CUA NVARCHAR(10), @TRUYEN NVARCHAR(10), @SOLUONG INT,             @NGAYGIAO SMALLDATETIME, @GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50), @QCDG INT, @STT INT,             @HT_LOT NVARCHAR(30), @HT_SL INT,             @LOTGHEP NVARCHAR(MAX), @SLCANGHEP INT, @SLGHEP INT;     SET @STT = 0;       IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#TMPGHEPLOT') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TMPGHEPLOT;     CREATE TABLE #TMPGHEPLOT (MH NVARCHAR(56), GG NVARCHAR(50), LG NVARCHAR(MAX));       -- Đặt lại tồn tạm theo tồn thực tế     SET @SQL = N'UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = SLCONLAI         WHERE PART IN (SELECT MAHANG FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE) + N' GROUP BY MAHANG) AND SLCONLAI > 0';     EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;       -- Dùng bảng tạm (#) thay vì biến bảng (@) để dùng được bên trong sp_executesql     IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#IFSCursorTable') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #IFSCursorTable;     CREATE TABLE #IFSCursorTable (         ID INT IDENTITY(1,1),         MAHANG NVARCHAR(56),          SOLUONG INT,          NGAYGIAO SMALLDATETIME,          GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50)     );           SET @SQL = N'INSERT INTO #IFSCursorTable (MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO)                  SELECT MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE);     EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;       DECLARE IFSPGH CURSOR FOR         SELECT MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO FROM #IFSCursorTable ORDER BY ID;       OPEN IFSPGH;     FETCH NEXT FROM IFSPGH INTO @MAHANG, @SOLUONG, @NGAYGIAO, @GIOGIAO;     WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0     BEGIN         SET @STT = @STT + 1;                  IF EXISTS (SELECT CAST(MinCloseQty AS INT) FROM B20Item WHERE Code = @MAHANG)             SELECT @QCDG = CAST(MinCloseQty AS INT) FROM B20Item WHERE Code = @MAHANG;         ELSE             SET @QCDG = -1;           -- Cập nhật số lượng hộp trên bảng tạm         SET @SQL = N'UPDATE ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'             SET STT = @p_stt, HOP = CASE WHEN @p_qcdg > 0 THEN CEILING(CAST(@p_sl AS FLOAT) / @p_qcdg) ELSE 1 END             WHERE MAHANG = @p_mahang AND SOLUONG = @p_sl AND GIOGIAO = @p_giogiao';         EXEC sp_executesql @SQL,             N'@p_stt INT, @p_sl INT, @p_qcdg INT, @p_mahang NVARCHAR(56), @p_giogiao NVARCHAR(50)',             @STT, @SOLUONG, @QCDG, @MAHANG, @GIOGIAO;           ---- Duyệt ghép lô cho từng mốc số lượng (giữ quy cách đóng gói)         SET @LOTGHEP = '';         SET @SLCANGHEP = 0;         SET @SLGHEP = 0;          DECLARE DHT CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FORWARD_ONLY READ_ONLY FOR             SELECT LEFT(b.LOT, 20) AS LotKey, b.SLCONLAITMP             FROM STOCKTP b             WHERE b.PART = @MAHANG AND b.SLCONLAI > 0             ORDER BY TRY_CAST(LEFT(b.LOT, 20) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)), b.LOT;           OPEN DHT;         FETCH NEXT FROM DHT INTO @HT_LOT, @HT_SL;           -- VÒNG LẶP DUYỆT LÔ: Chỉ chạy khi còn hàng trong lô và số lượng cần xuất (@SOLUONG) lớn hơn 0         WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @SOLUONG > 0         BEGIN             IF (@HT_SL <= 0)             BEGIN                 FETCH NEXT FROM DHT INTO @HT_LOT, @HT_SL;                 CONTINUE;             END              IF (@QCDG IS NULL OR @QCDG <= 0)             BEGIN                 IF @HT_SL >= @SOLUONG                 BEGIN                     IF @LOTGHEP = '' SET @LOTGHEP = @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SOLUONG AS NVARCHAR);                     ELSE SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SOLUONG AS NVARCHAR);                      UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = SLCONLAITMP - @SOLUONG WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                     SET @SOLUONG = 0;                 END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     IF @LOTGHEP = '' SET @LOTGHEP = @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@HT_SL AS NVARCHAR);                     ELSE SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@HT_SL AS NVARCHAR);                      SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                     UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                 END             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 -- CÓ QUY CÁCH ĐÓNG GÓI (@QCDG > 0)                 IF (@HT_SL < @SOLUONG)                 BEGIN                     IF (@SLCANGHEP > 0)                     BEGIN                         IF (@HT_SL < @SLCANGHEP)                         BEGIN                             SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@HT_SL AS NVARCHAR);                             SET @SLCANGHEP = @SLCANGHEP - @HT_SL;                             SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                             UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                         END                         ELSE                         BEGIN                             SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SLCANGHEP AS NVARCHAR);                                                          DECLARE @DuDuoi INT = (@HT_SL - @SLCANGHEP) % @QCDG;                             IF (@DuDuoi = 0)                                 SET @SLCANGHEP = 0;                             ELSE                             BEGIN                                 SET @SLCANGHEP = @QCDG - @DuDuoi;                                 SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@DuDuoi AS NVARCHAR);                             END                                                          SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                             UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                         END                     END                     ELSE                     BEGIN                         SET @SLGHEP = @HT_SL % @QCDG;                         IF (@SLGHEP > 0)                         BEGIN                             SET @SLCANGHEP = (@SOLUONG % @QCDG) - @SLGHEP;                             IF @SLCANGHEP < 0 SET @SLCANGHEP = @QCDG - @SLGHEP;                              IF @LOTGHEP = ''                                 SET @LOTGHEP = @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SLGHEP AS NVARCHAR);                             ELSE                                 SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SLGHEP AS NVARCHAR);                         END                                                  SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                         UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                     END                 END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     -- LÔ NÀY ĐỦ HOẶC DƯ SỐ LƯỢNG CÒN LẠI CỦA ĐƠN HÀNG                     IF (@SLCANGHEP > 0)                     BEGIN                         IF (@HT_SL >= @SLCANGHEP)                         BEGIN                             SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SLCANGHEP AS NVARCHAR);                             UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = @HT_SL - @SLCANGHEP WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                             SET @SLCANGHEP = 0;                             -- Đã hoàn thành, trừ hết số lượng cần thiết và ngắt vòng lặp                             SET @SOLUONG = 0;                             BREAK;                         END                     END                     ELSE                     BEGIN                         -- Bốc trực tiếp phần số lượng còn thiếu từ lô này và chốt hạ                         IF @LOTGHEP = '' SET @LOTGHEP = @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SOLUONG AS NVARCHAR);                         ELSE SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SOLUONG AS NVARCHAR);                          UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = @HT_SL - @SOLUONG WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                         SET @SOLUONG = 0;                         BREAK; -- CẮT ĐỨT NGAY LẬP TỨC, KHÔNG CHO DUYỆT SANG CÁC LÔ PHÍA SAU NỮA!                     END                 END             END               FETCH NEXT FROM DHT INTO @HT_LOT, @HT_SL;         END           CLOSE DHT;         DEALLOCATE DHT;          -- CHỈ INSERT DUY NHẤT 1 DÒNG VÀO BẢNG TẠM SAU KHI ĐÃ GOM ĐỦ CHUỖI LÔ CHO MÃ HÀNG ĐÓ         IF @LOTGHEP <> ''         BEGIN             INSERT INTO #TMPGHEPLOT (MH, GG, LG) VALUES (@MAHANG, @GIOGIAO, @LOTGHEP);         END          -------------------------------         FETCH NEXT FROM IFSPGH INTO @MAHANG, @SOLUONG, @NGAYGIAO, @GIOGIAO;     END     CLOSE IFSPGH;     DEALLOCATE IFSPGH;       SELECT * FROM #TMPGHEPLOT WHERE CHARINDEX(',', LG, 1) > 0; END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_gheplot]     @TMPTABLE NVARCHAR(128) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',     @IFSTABLE NVARCHAR(128) = N'IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG' AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;       DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);     DECLARE @MAHANG NVARCHAR(56), @CUA NVARCHAR(10), @TRUYEN NVARCHAR(10), @SOLUONG INT,             @NGAYGIAO SMALLDATETIME, @GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50), @QCDG INT, @STT INT,             @HT_LOT NVARCHAR(30), @HT_SL INT,             @LOTGHEP NVARCHAR(500), @SLCANGHEP INT, @SLGHEP INT, @SLGIAO_CONLAI INT;     SET @STT = 0;       IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#TMPGHEPLOT') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TMPGHEPLOT;     CREATE TABLE #TMPGHEPLOT (MH NVARCHAR(56), GG NVARCHAR(50), LG NVARCHAR(500));       -- Duyet: dat lai ton tam theo ton that     SET @SQL = N'UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = SLCONLAI         WHERE PART IN (SELECT MAHANG FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE) + N' GROUP BY MAHANG) AND SLCONLAI > 0';     EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;       DECLARE @IFSCursorTable TABLE (MAHANG NVARCHAR(56), SOLUONG INT, NGAYGIAO SMALLDATETIME, GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50));     SET @SQL = N'SELECT MAHANG, SUM(SOLUONG), NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE)              + N' GROUP BY MAHANG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO';     INSERT INTO @IFSCursorTable EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;       DECLARE IFSPGH CURSOR FOR         SELECT MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO FROM @IFSCursorTable;       OPEN IFSPGH;     FETCH NEXT FROM IFSPGH INTO @MAHANG, @SOLUONG, @NGAYGIAO, @GIOGIAO;     WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0     BEGIN         SET @STT = @STT + 1;           IF EXISTS (SELECT CAST(MinCloseQty AS INT) FROM B20Item WHERE Code = @MAHANG)             SELECT @QCDG = CAST(MinCloseQty AS INT) FROM B20Item WHERE Code = @MAHANG; CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_LOAD_PHIEU_DOCQR2405]       @NGAYGIAO   nvarchar(20),       @NHAMAY     nvarchar(50)  = N'',       @GIOFCC     nvarchar(200) = N'',       @ADDNM      int,       @TMPTABLE   nvarchar(100) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',       @IFSTABLE   nvarchar(100) = N'IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG',       @DOCQRTABLE nvarchar(100) = N'DOCQRCODE'   AS   BEGIN       SET NOCOUNT ON;          -- ── 1. Build #GioList (giữ INT như SP cũ) ───────────────────────────       CREATE TABLE #GioList (GioInt int)       INSERT INTO #GioList       SELECT TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT)       FROM   STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(@GIOFCC, '''', ''), ',')       WHERE  LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> ''         AND  LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> '(GIAO DB)'         AND  TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT) IS NOT NULL          -- ── 2. Đếm IFS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────       DECLARE @TTIFS int       DECLARE @SQL   nvarchar(max)       SET @SQL = N'SELECT @CNT = COUNT(*) FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE)       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@CNT int OUTPUT', @TTIFS OUTPUT          -- ── 3. Chuẩn hóa NHAMAY ─────────────────────────────────────────────       IF CHARINDEX('(NHA MAY HA NAM)', @NHAMAY) > 0           SET @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'       ELSE           SET @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'          IF @NHAMAY LIKE '%NHA MAY VP%'           SET @ADDNM = 1       ELSE           SET @ADDNM = 2          -- ── 4. Normalize LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG — chỉ theo ngày+nhà máy ──────────       -- GIỮ từ SP mới: filter NGAYGIAO + NHAMAY, không update toàn bảng       UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG       SET GIOGIAO = CASE           WHEN GIOGIAO = '0H'    THEN '00H'           WHEN GIOGIAO LIKE '%H' THEN REPLACE(GIOGIAO, 'H', '')           ELSE GIOGIAO END       WHERE NHAMAY   LIKE @NHAMAY         AND NGAYGIAO  = @NGAYGIAO         AND (GIOGIAO = '0H' OR GIOGIAO LIKE '%H')          UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG       SET NHAMAY = 'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY VP)'       WHERE NHAMAY   LIKE '%VP)'         AND NGAYGIAO  = @NGAYGIAO          UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG       SET GIOGIAOFCC = GIOGIAO       WHERE GIOGIAOFCC = '(GIAO DB)'         AND GIOGIAO   <> '05'         AND NGAYGIAO   = @NGAYGIAO         AND NHAMAY    LIKE @NHAMAY          -- ── 5. Chuẩn hóa GIOGIAOFCC — SET-BASED (GIỮ từ SP mới) ────────────       UPDATE luu       SET luu.GIOGIAOFCC = CASE           WHEN @NHAMAY LIKE '%NHA MAY HA NAM%' THEN ct.GIOFCCHN           ELSE ct.GioFCCVP       END       FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG luu       INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME ct              ON  ct.GIOHVN        = luu.GIOGIAOFCC       WHERE  luu.NHAMAY          LIKE @NHAMAY         AND  luu.NGAYGIAO         = @NGAYGIAO         AND  luu.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'         AND  luu.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'         AND  luu.NHAMAY          <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'          -- ── 6. GIAO DB ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────       IF @GIOFCC = '(GIAO DB)'       BEGIN           SET @SQL =               N'DELETE ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N';' +               N'INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) +               N' (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,' +               N'  STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)' +               N' SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,' +               N'        STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,' +               N'        ISNULL(PO_NO,''''),ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'''')' +               N' FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE)           EXEC sp_executesql @SQL           GOTO XUAT_KQ       END          -- ── 7. Kiểm tra DOCQR — đang bắn dở → giữ nguyên TMP ───────────────       DECLARE @CntDocQR int = 0       SET @SQL = N'SELECT @CNT = COUNT(*) FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@DOCQRTABLE)       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@CNT int OUTPUT', @CntDocQR OUTPUT          IF @CntDocQR > 0           GOTO XUAT_KQ          -- ── 8. Không bắn QR → load mới ──────────────────────────────────────       SET @SQL = N'DELETE ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE)       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL          -- ── 9. TTIFS = 0 → IFS đã close → đọc thẳng LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG ────────       IF @TTIFS = 0       BEGIN           SET @SQL = N'               INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'                   (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                    NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,                    HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)               SELECT                   STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                   NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,@ADDNM,                   HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                   ISNULL(PO_NO,''''), ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'''')               FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG               WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)                 AND NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY                 AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE ''%[^0-9]%''                 AND GIOGIAO <> ''''                 AND (                     NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GioList)                     OR TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                 )'           EXEC sp_executesql @SQL,               N'@NGAYGIAO nvarchar(20), @NHAMAY nvarchar(50), @ADDNM int',               @NGAYGIAO, @NHAMAY, @ADDNM           GOTO XUAT_KQ       END          -- ── 10. TTIFS > 0 → IFS có data → #LUU → #LUUGIO → LEFT JOIN ────────       -- GIỮ NGUYÊN từ SP cũ: đây là flow đúng, không dùng LEFT JOIN thô       CREATE TABLE #LUU (           MAHANG     nvarchar(50),           NGAYGIAO   date,           CUA        nvarchar(20),           TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),           SOLUONG    int,           GIOGIAO    nvarchar(10),           GIOGIAOFCC nvarchar(50),           LOT        nvarchar(500),           STATUS     nvarchar(20),           STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)       )          CREATE TABLE #LUUGIO (           MAHANG    nvarchar(50),           NGAYGIAO  date,           CUA       nvarchar(20),           TRUYEN    nvarchar(20),           SOLUONG   int,           GIO_PARSE nvarchar(10),           LOT       nvarchar(500),           STATUS    nvarchar(20),           STATUSDOC nvarchar(50)       )          -- ── 11. INSERT #LUU — lấy dòng mới nhất theo TGLUU ──────────────────       INSERT INTO #LUU       SELECT           RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),           RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),           SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, GIOGIAOFCC, LOT, STATUS, STATUSDOC       FROM (           SELECT *,               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                   PARTITION BY RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),                                RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),                                SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, RTRIM(NHAMAY)                   ORDER BY TGLUU DESC               ) AS RN           FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG           WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)             AND NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY             AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'             AND GIOGIAO <> ''             AND (                 NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GioList)                 OR TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)             )       ) x       WHERE x.RN = 1          -- ── 12. INSERT #LUUGIO — chuẩn hóa GIO_PARSE ────────────────────────       INSERT INTO #LUUGIO       SELECT           l.MAHANG, l.NGAYGIAO, l.CUA, l.TRUYEN, l.SOLUONG,           RIGHT('00' + LTRIM(RTRIM(l.GIOGIAO)), 2) AS GIO_PARSE,           l.LOT, l.STATUS, l.STATUSDOC       FROM #LUU l       WHERE l.GIOGIAO <> ''         AND (             NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GioList)             OR TRY_CAST(l.GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)         )          -- Index để tăng tốc JOIN ở bước 13       CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_LUUGIO           ON #LUUGIO (MAHANG, CUA, TRUYEN, SOLUONG, GIO_PARSE)          -- ── 13. INSERT vào TMP — LEFT JOIN IFS + #LUUGIO ─────────────────────       -- FIX NULL: ISNULL(CUA,'') và ISNULL(TRUYEN,'') — giữ từ SP cũ đã fix       SET @SQL = N'           INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'               (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)           SELECT               i.STT, i.CUA, i.TRUYEN, i.MAHANG, i.TENHANG,               ISNULL(l.LOT,       i.LOT),       i.DV, i.SOLUONG, i.NGAYGIAO, i.GIOGIAO,               ISNULL(l.STATUS,    i.STATUS),    i.TTPHIEU, i.NHAMAY, @ADDNM,               i.HOP,               ISNULL(l.STATUSDOC, i.STATUSDOC), i.Note,               ISNULL(i.PO_NO,  '''') AS PO_NO,               ISNULL(i.PO_ITEM,'''') AS PO_ITEM           FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE) + N' i           LEFT JOIN #LUUGIO l               ON  l.MAHANG                  = RTRIM(i.MAHANG)               AND ISNULL(l.CUA,   '''')     = ISNULL(RTRIM(i.CUA),   '''')               AND ISNULL(l.TRUYEN,'''')     = ISNULL(RTRIM(i.TRUYEN),'''')               AND l.SOLUONG                 = i.SOLUONG               AND l.GIO_PARSE               = RIGHT(''00'' + LTRIM(RTRIM(i.GIOGIAO)), 2)'       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@ADDNM int', @ADDNM          DROP TABLE #LUU       DROP TABLE #LUUGIO          XUAT_KQ:       DROP TABLE #GioList          -- ── 14. Xuất kết quả ─────────────────────────────────────────────────       SET @SQL =           N'SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,' +           N'       NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,' +           N'       HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,' +           N'       ISNULL(PO_NO,'''')   AS PO_NO,' +           N'       ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'''') AS PO_ITEM' +           N' FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) +           N' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(STT AS INT), STT'       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL   END

create PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_LOAD_PHIEU_DOCQR2405OLD]               @NGAYGIAO   nvarchar(20),               @NHAMAY     nvarchar(50)  = N'',               @GIOFCC     nvarchar(200) = N'',               @ADDNM      int,           @TMPTABLE   nvarchar(100) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',           @IFSTABLE   nvarchar(100) = N'IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG',           @DOCQRTABLE nvarchar(100) = N'DOCQRCODE'       AS           BEGIN               SET NOCOUNT ON;                -- ── 1. SUY RA CUSTOMERID ─────────────────────────────────────────────     DECLARE @CUSTOMERID nvarchar(20)         IF @TMPTABLE = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG'             SET @CUSTOMERID = '100001'         ELSE IF CHARINDEX('_', @TMPTABLE) > 0             SET @CUSTOMERID = RIGHT(@TMPTABLE, LEN(@TMPTABLE) - CHARINDEX('_', @TMPTABLE))         ELSE             SET @CUSTOMERID = '100001'            DECLARE @TTIFS  int               DECLARE @SQL    nvarchar(max)                -- ── 2. BUILD #GioList ────────────────────────────────────────────────     CREATE TABLE #GioList (GioInt int)               INSERT INTO #GioList               SELECT TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT)               FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(@GIOFCC, '''', ''), ',')               WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> ''                 AND LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> '(GIAO DB)'                 AND TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT) IS NOT NULL                  -- ── 3. ĐẾM IFS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────     SET @SQL = N'SELECT @CNT = COUNT(*) FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE)           EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@CNT int OUTPUT', @TTIFS OUTPUT                -- ── 4. NORMALIZE @NHAMAY ─────────────────────────────────────────────     IF @CUSTOMERID = '100001'         BEGIN             UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAO = '00H' WHERE GIOGIAO = '0H'                   UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAO = REPLACE(GIOGIAO, 'H', '')             WHERE GIOGIAO <> '00H' AND GIOGIAO LIKE '%H'                   UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET NHAMAY = 'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY VP)'             WHERE NHAMAY LIKE '%VP)'                   UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAOFCC = GIOGIAO             WHERE GIOGIAOFCC = '(GIAO DB)' AND GIOGIAO <> '05'                  IF CHARINDEX('(NHA MAY HA NAM)', @NHAMAY) > 0                       SET @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'                   ELSE                       SET @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'                  IF EXISTS (                       SELECT 1 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                       WHERE GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'                         AND GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'                         AND NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'                   )                   BEGIN                       IF @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'                           UPDATE L SET L.GIOGIAOFCC = C.GIOFCCHN                           FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG L                           INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME C ON C.GIOHVN = L.GIOGIAOFCC                           WHERE L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'                        AND L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'                          AND L.NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'                        AND L.NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY                       ELSE                           UPDATE L SET L.GIOGIAOFCC = C.GioFCCVP                           FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG L                           INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME C ON C.GIOHVN = L.GIOGIAOFCC                           WHERE L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'                        AND L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'                          AND L.NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'                        AND L.NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY                   END         END         ELSE         BEGIN             IF @NHAMAY = N''                 SET @NHAMAY = '%'             ELSE                 SET @NHAMAY = '%' + @NHAMAY + '%'         END              -- ── 5. TRƯỜNG HỢP GIAO DB ────────────────────────────────────────────     IF @GIOFCC = '(GIAO DB)'               BEGIN               SET @SQL = N'                 DELETE ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'                 INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'                     (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                      STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)                 SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                        STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                        ISNULL(PO_NO,''''), ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'''')                 FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE)               EXEC sp_executesql @SQL           END               ELSE               BEGIN               -- ── 6. KIỂM TRA DOCQR ────────────────────────────────────────────         DECLARE @CntDocQR int = 0               SET @SQL = N'SELECT @CNT = COUNT(*) FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@DOCQRTABLE)               EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@CNT int OUTPUT', @CntDocQR OUTPUT                      IF @CntDocQR = 0               BEGIN                       SET @SQL = N'DELETE ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE)                   EXEC sp_executesql @SQL                        IF @CUSTOMERID = '100001'                 BEGIN                     IF @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'                               SET @ADDNM = 1                           ELSE                               SET @ADDNM = 2                 END                  -- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════             -- FIX: TTIFS = 0 → IFS đã close (tháng trước)             --      → bỏ qua #LUU/#LUUGIO, đọc thẳng LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG             -- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════             IF @TTIFS = 0             BEGIN                 -- ── Đọc thẳng LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG — đầy đủ cột ─────────────                 SET @SQL = N'                     INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'                         (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                          NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,                          HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)                     SELECT                         STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                         NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,@ADDNM,                         HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                         ISNULL(PO_NO,''''), ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'''')                     FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                     WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)                       AND NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY                       AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE ''%[^0-9]%''                       AND GIOGIAO <> ''''                       AND (                           NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GioList)                           OR TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                       )'                 EXEC sp_executesql @SQL,                     N'@NGAYGIAO nvarchar(20), @NHAMAY nvarchar(50), @ADDNM int',                     @NGAYGIAO, @NHAMAY, @ADDNM             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 -- ── TTIFS > 0 → IFS có data → flow cũ ───────────────────                 -- ── 7. TẠO BẢNG TẠM ─────────────────────────────────────                     CREATE TABLE #LUU (                               MAHANG      nvarchar(50),                          NGAYGIAO    date,                          CUA         nvarchar(20),                               TRUYEN      nvarchar(20),                          SOLUONG     int,                          GIOGIAO     nvarchar(10),                               GIOGIAOFCC  nvarchar(50),                          LOT         nvarchar(500),                               STATUS      nvarchar(20),                          STATUSDOC   nvarchar(50)                           )                              CREATE TABLE #LUUGIO (                         MAHANG      nvarchar(50),                         NGAYGIAO    date,                         CUA         nvarchar(20),                         TRUYEN      nvarchar(20),                         SOLUONG     int,                         GIO_PARSE   nvarchar(10),                         LOT         nvarchar(500),                         STATUS      nvarchar(20),                         STATUSDOC   nvarchar(50)                     )                              -- ── 8. INSERT #LUU ───────────────────────────────────────                     INSERT INTO #LUU                           SELECT                                RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),                     RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),                               SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, GIOGIAOFCC, LOT, STATUS, STATUSDOC                           FROM (                               SELECT *,                                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                                       PARTITION BY RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),                                                    RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),                                                    SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, RTRIM(NHAMAY)                                       ORDER BY TGLUU DESC                                   ) AS RN                               FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                               WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)                                 AND NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY                                 AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'                                   AND GIOGIAO <> ''                           AND (                               NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GioList)                               OR TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                           )                     ) x                           WHERE x.RN = 1                              -- ── 9. INSERT #LUUGIO ────────────────────────────────────                     INSERT INTO #LUUGIO                   SELECT                       l.MAHANG, l.NGAYGIAO, l.CUA, l.TRUYEN, l.SOLUONG,                       RIGHT('00' + LTRIM(RTRIM(l.GIOGIAO)), 2) AS GIO_PARSE,                       l.LOT, l.STATUS, l.STATUSDOC                   FROM #LUU l                   WHERE l.GIOGIAO <> ''                     AND (                         NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GioList)                         OR TRY_CAST(l.GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                     )                                 CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_LUUGIO                     ON #LUUGIO (MAHANG, CUA, TRUYEN, SOLUONG, GIO_PARSE)                  -- ── 10. INSERT VÀO TMP ĐỘNG ─────────────────────────────                   SET @SQL = N'                         INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'                             (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                              STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)                         SELECT                             i.STT, i.CUA, i.TRUYEN, i.MAHANG, i.TENHANG,                             ISNULL(l.LOT, i.LOT), i.DV, i.SOLUONG, i.NGAYGIAO, i.GIOGIAO,                             ISNULL(l.STATUS, i.STATUS), i.TTPHIEU, i.NHAMAY, @ADDNM,                             i.HOP, ISNULL(l.STATUSDOC, i.STATUSDOC), i.Note,                             ISNULL(i.PO_NO,''''), ISNULL(i.PO_ITEM,'''')                         FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE) + N' i                         LEFT JOIN #LUUGIO l                             ON  l.MAHANG                    = RTRIM(i.MAHANG)                             AND ISNULL(l.CUA,   '''')       = ISNULL(RTRIM(i.CUA),   '''')                           AND ISNULL(l.TRUYEN,'''')       = ISNULL(RTRIM(i.TRUYEN),'''')                           AND l.SOLUONG                   = i.SOLUONG                             AND l.GIO_PARSE                 = RIGHT(''00'' + LTRIM(RTRIM(i.GIOGIAO)), 2)'                   EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@ADDNM int', @ADDNM                                DROP TABLE #LUU                           DROP TABLE #LUUGIO                       END -- ← kết thúc ELSE (@TTIFS > 0)         END               END                    -- ── 11. SELECT KẾT QUẢ ──────────────────────────────────────────────     SET @SQL = N'             SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,                    GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                    ISNULL(PO_NO,'''') AS PO_NO, ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'''') AS PO_ITEM             FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'             ORDER BY TRY_CAST(STT AS INT), STT'           EXEC sp_executesql @SQL                DROP TABLE #GioList           END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_LOAD_PHIEU_DOCQROLD]         @NGAYGIAO nvarchar(20),         @NHAMAY   nvarchar(50)  = N'',         @GIOFCC   nvarchar(200) = N'',         @ADDNM    int     AS     BEGIN         SET NOCOUNT ON;              DECLARE @TTIFS int              -- ── 1. TẠO DANH SÁCH GIỜ TỪ THAM SỐ RADIO ĐANG CHỌN (DÙNG INT ĐỂ LỌC GỐC) ──         CREATE TABLE #GioList (GioInt int)            INSERT INTO #GioList         SELECT TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT)         FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(@GIOFCC, '''', ''), ',')         WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> ''           AND LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> '(GIAO DB)'           AND TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT) IS NOT NULL            SELECT @TTIFS = COUNT(*) FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG              -- ── 2. CHUẨN HÓA THAM SỐ ĐỂ TRA CỨU ─────────────────────────────────         IF CHARINDEX('(NHA MAY HA NAM)', @NHAMAY) > 0             SET @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'         ELSE             SET @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'              -- Chuẩn hóa dữ liệu bảng lịch sử quét để tăng tốc độ tìm kiếm         UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAO = '00H' WHERE GIOGIAO = '0H'         UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAO = REPLACE(GIOGIAO, 'H', '') WHERE GIOGIAO <> '00H' AND GIOGIAO LIKE '%H'         UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET NHAMAY  = 'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY VP)' WHERE NHAMAY LIKE '%VP)'         UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAOFCC = GIOGIAO WHERE GIOGIAOFCC = '(GIAO DB)' AND GIOGIAO <> '05'              -- Đồng bộ hóa khung giờ thực tế theo bảng tra cứu thời gian         IF EXISTS (             SELECT 1 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG             WHERE GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'               AND GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'               AND NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'         )         BEGIN             IF @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'             BEGIN                 UPDATE L SET L.GIOGIAOFCC = C.GIOFCCHN                 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG L                 INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME C ON C.GIOHVN = L.GIOGIAOFCC                 WHERE L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H' AND L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%' AND L.NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM' AND L.NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 UPDATE L SET L.GIOGIAOFCC = C.GioFCCVP                 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG L                 INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME C ON C.GIOHVN = L.GIOGIAOFCC                 WHERE L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H' AND L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%' AND L.NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM' AND L.NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY             END         END              -- ── 3. XỬ LÝ ĐỔ DỮ LIỆU RA LƯỚI HIỂN THỊ ────────────────────────────         IF @GIOFCC = '(GIAO DB)'         BEGIN             DELETE TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG             INSERT INTO TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                 (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                  STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)             SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                    STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                    ISNULL(PO_NO,''), ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'')             FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG         END         ELSE         BEGIN             IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DOCQRCODE)             BEGIN                 DELETE TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                      IF @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'                     SET @ADDNM = 1                 ELSE                     SET @ADDNM = 2                      -- ── BƯỚC 1: Lọc nạp dữ liệu lịch sử quét ──                 CREATE TABLE #LUU (                     MAHANG     nvarchar(50),                     NGAYGIAO   date,                     CUA        nvarchar(20),                     TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),                     SOLUONG    int,                     GIOGIAO    nvarchar(10),                     GIOGIAOFCC nvarchar(50),                     LOT        nvarchar(500),                     STATUS     nvarchar(20),                     STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)                 )                      INSERT INTO #LUU                 SELECT                      RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date), RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),                     SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, GIOGIAOFCC, LOT, STATUS, STATUSDOC                 FROM (                     SELECT *,                         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                             PARTITION BY RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),                                          RTRIM(CUA),    RTRIM(TRUYEN),                                          SOLUONG,       GIOGIAO,                                          RTRIM(NHAMAY)                             ORDER BY TGLUU DESC                         ) AS RN                     FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                     WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)                       AND NHAMAY                 LIKE @NHAMAY                       AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'                         AND GIOGIAO <> ''                       -- Lọc nhanh bằng ép kiểu INT để tránh sót dữ liệu dạng '6' hay '06'                       AND TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                  ) x                 WHERE x.RN = 1                      -- ── BƯỚC 2: Tách chuỗi Giờ tổng hợp để phục vụ đối chiếu mẫu ──────                 CREATE TABLE #LUUGIO (                     MAHANG     nvarchar(50),                     NGAYGIAO   date,                     CUA        nvarchar(20),                     TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),                     SOLUONG    int,                     GIO_PARSE  nvarchar(10),                     LOT        nvarchar(500),                     STATUS     nvarchar(20),                     STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)                 )                      INSERT INTO #LUUGIO                 SELECT                      l.MAHANG, l.NGAYGIAO, l.CUA, l.TRUYEN, l.SOLUONG,                     -- ══ FIX CHÍ MẠNG: Định dạng chuỗi giờ bóc tách về dạng 2 chữ số '0X' (ví dụ: '6' -> '06')                     -- Điều này đảm bảo mỗi khung giờ con trả về đúng mã định danh của nó, không trùng lắp GIO_PARSE                     RIGHT('00' + LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)), 2) AS GIO_PARSE,                     l.LOT, l.STATUS, l.STATUSDOC                 FROM #LUU l                 CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(                     REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(l.GIOGIAOFCC, '(', ''), ')', ''), 'H', ''),                     '+'                 ) gs                 WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)) <> ''                   AND TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)) AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                      CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_LUUGIO ON #LUUGIO (MAHANG, CUA, TRUYEN, SOLUONG, GIO_PARSE)                      -- ── BƯỚC 3: Dùng IFS làm gốc, LEFT JOIN để map trạng thái Quét ──                 INSERT INTO TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                     (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                      STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)                 SELECT                     i.STT,                     i.CUA,                     i.TRUYEN,                     i.MAHANG,                     i.TENHANG,                     ISNULL(l.LOT,       i.LOT)       AS LOT,                     i.DV,                     i.SOLUONG,                     i.NGAYGIAO,                     i.GIOGIAO,                     ISNULL(l.STATUS,    i.STATUS)    AS STATUS,                     i.TTPHIEU,                     i.NHAMAY,                     @ADDNM,                     i.HOP,                     ISNULL(l.STATUSDOC, i.STATUSDOC) AS STATUSDOC,                     i.Note,                     ISNULL(i.PO_NO,   '') AS PO_NO,                     ISNULL(i.PO_ITEM, '') AS PO_ITEM                 FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG i                 LEFT JOIN #LUUGIO l                     ON  l.MAHANG    = RTRIM(i.MAHANG)                     AND l.CUA       = RTRIM(i.CUA)                     AND l.TRUYEN    = RTRIM(i.TRUYEN)                     AND l.SOLUONG   = i.SOLUONG                     -- So khớp chuẩn chuỗi dạng '06' = '06' (hoàn toàn loại bỏ double row)                     AND l.GIO_PARSE = RTRIM(i.GIOGIAO)                       DROP TABLE #LUU                 DROP TABLE #LUUGIO             END         END              -- ── 4. TRẢ KẾT QUẢ ĐẦU RA CHO GRIDVIEW ───────────────────────────────         SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,                GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                ISNULL(PO_NO,   '') AS PO_NO,                ISNULL(PO_ITEM, '') AS PO_ITEM         FROM TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG         ORDER BY TRY_CAST(STT AS INT), STT              DROP TABLE #GioList     END

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_BaoCao_DeliveryTrace (     @CustomerNo   nvarchar(20),     @CustomerName nvarchar(200) = NULL,     @FromDate     date,     @ToDate       date ) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SET XACT_ABORT ON;      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 1. VALIDATE     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     IF @CustomerNo NOT IN (N'100001', N'100002')     BEGIN         THROW 50001,               N'CustomerNo không được hỗ trợ. Chỉ hỗ trợ 100001 / 100002.',               1;     END;      IF @FromDate IS NULL OR @ToDate IS NULL     BEGIN         THROW 50002,               N'@FromDate và @ToDate không được NULL.',               1;     END;      IF @FromDate > @ToDate     BEGIN         THROW 50003,               N'@FromDate không được lớn hơn @ToDate.',               1;     END;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 2. CUSTOMER DISPLAY NAME     --     -- Application mapping:     --     -- 100001 -> HON DA - VIET NAM     -- 100002 -> YAMAHA - VIET NAM     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     DECLARE @CustomerDisplayName nvarchar(200);      SET @CustomerDisplayName =         CASE @CustomerNo             WHEN N'100001' THEN N'HON DA - VIET NAM'             WHEN N'100002' THEN N'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'         END;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 3. CUSTOMER FACTORY FILTER     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE TABLE #CustomerFactory     (         NhaMay nvarchar(200) NOT NULL             PRIMARY KEY     );      IF @CustomerNo = N'100001'     BEGIN         INSERT INTO #CustomerFactory         (             NhaMay         )         VALUES             (N'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY VP)'),             (N'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY HN)');     END     ELSE     BEGIN         INSERT INTO #CustomerFactory         (             NhaMay         )         VALUES             (N'YAMAHA - VIET NAM');     END;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 4. DELIVERY SOURCE     --     -- Normalize:     --     -- 01     -> 1     -- 001    -> 1     -- 0001   -> 1     -- J0663  -> J0663     -- 0J0663 -> J0663     --     -- KHÔNG TRY_CONVERT(INT)     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH DeliverySource AS     (         SELECT             P.STT,             P.CUA,             P.TRUYEN,             P.MAHANG,             P.TENHANG,             P.LOT,             P.DV,             P.SOLUONG,             P.NGAYGIAO,             P.GIOGIAO,             P.STATUS,             P.TTPHIEU,             P.NHAMAY,             P.GIOGIAOFCC,             P.GearYMVN,             P.HOP,             P.STATUSDOC,             P.Note,             P.TGLUU,             P.PO_NO,             P.PO_ITEM,              NormalizedGioGiao =                 CASE                     WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO)), N'') IS NULL                         THEN NULL                      WHEN PATINDEX                     (                         N'%[^0]%',                         LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO))                     ) = 0                         THEN N'0'                      ELSE SUBSTRING                     (                         LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO)),                         PATINDEX                         (                             N'%[^0]%',                             LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO))                         ),                         LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO)))                     )                 END          FROM dbo.LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG P          INNER JOIN #CustomerFactory CF             ON CF.NhaMay = P.NHAMAY          WHERE P.NGAYGIAO >= @FromDate           AND P.NGAYGIAO < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @ToDate)     ),      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 5. QR SOURCE     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     QrSource AS     (         SELECT             D.LOTFCC,             D.MAHANGFCC,             D.SLTEMFCC,              D.LOTHVN,             D.MAHANGHVN,             D.SLTEMHVN,              D.STATUS,             D.MAFCC,             D.STT,             D.KETQUA,              D.NGAYXUAT,             D.GIOXUAT,             D.NHAMAY,             D.GIOGIAO,              D.TGLUU,             D.TGLuuDuLieu,              NormalizedGioGiao =                 CASE                     WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO)), N'') IS NULL                         THEN NULL                      WHEN PATINDEX                     (                         N'%[^0]%',                         LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO))                     ) = 0                         THEN N'0'                      ELSE SUBSTRING                     (                         LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO)),                         PATINDEX                         (                             N'%[^0]%',                             LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO))                         ),                         LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO)))                     )                 END          FROM dbo.LUUDOCQRCODE D     ),      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 6. MATCH DELIVERY <-> QR     --     -- Common:     --     -- D.NHAMAY      = P.NHAMAY     -- D.MAHANGFCC   = P.MAHANG     -- D.NGAYXUAT    = P.NGAYGIAO     --     -- Honda:     -- D.GIOXUAT     = P.GIOGIAOFCC     --     -- Yamaha:     -- Normalize(D.GIOGIAO) = Normalize(P.CUA)     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     DeliveryMatched AS     (         SELECT             @CustomerNo AS CustomerNo,              @CustomerDisplayName AS CustomerName,              P.NHAMAY AS Factory,              P.STT AS PhieuSTT,              P.CUA,             P.TRUYEN,              P.MAHANG,             P.TENHANG,             P.LOT AS DeliveryLot,              P.DV,             P.SOLUONG AS DeliveryQuantity,              P.NGAYGIAO,             P.GIOGIAO,             P.GIOGIAOFCC,              P.GearYMVN,             P.HOP,              P.STATUS AS DeliveryStatus,             P.TTPHIEU,             P.STATUSDOC,             P.Note,              P.PO_NO,             P.PO_ITEM,              D.STT AS QrSTT,              D.MAFCC,              D.LOTFCC,             D.MAHANGFCC,             D.SLTEMFCC,              D.LOTHVN,             D.MAHANGHVN, KHỞI TẠO BẢNG CHỨA KẾT QUẢ ĐỘNG (BẢNG VẬT LÝ THEO MÁY TRẠM) ──────     DECLARE @sqlCreateResult NVARCHAR(MAX)     SET @sqlCreateResult = N'         CREATE TABLE [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + '] (             MH NVARCHAR(56),             SLGIAO INT,             SLTHIEU INT,             GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50)         )'     EXEC sp_executesql @sqlCreateResult      -- ── 3. TÍNH TOÁN @MaxDaGiao BẰNG DYNAMIC SQL ────────────────────────────     DECLARE @MaxDaGiao INT = 0     DECLARE @sqlMax NVARCHAR(MAX)      SET @sqlMax = N'         IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG WHERE NGAYGIAO = (SELECT TOP 1 NGAYGIAO FROM TBL_TT_MA) AND LEN(GIOGIAO) < 4)           BEGIN               SELECT @MaxOut = MAX(CAST(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(''h'', GIOGIAO, 1) > 0                                               THEN SUBSTRING(GIOGIAO, 1, CHARINDEX(''h'', GIOGIAO, 1) - 1)                                              ELSE GIOGIAO                                         END AS INT))              FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG               WHERE NGAYGIAO <= (SELECT TOP 1 NGAYGIAO FROM TBL_TT_MAView) AND LEN(GIOGIAO) < 4           END'          EXEC sp_executesql @sqlMax, N'@MaxOut INT OUTPUT', @MaxOut = @MaxDaGiao OUTPUT     SET @MaxDaGiao = ISNULL(@MaxDaGiao, 0)      -- ── 4. THỰC THI LOGIC DUYỆT DỮ LIỆU SỬ DỤNG DYNAMIC SQL TOÀN BỘ ────────     DECLARE @sqlMain NVARCHAR(MAX)     SET @sqlMain = N'         DECLARE @MAHANG NVARCHAR(56), @TTSLGIAO INT, @GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50)         DECLARE @TK INT, @SLT INT, @SLGIAO INT          DECLARE IFSPGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR           SELECT MAHANG, SUM(TTSLG) as TTSLG          FROM TBL_TT_MAView           WHERE CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) > @MaxDaGiao          GROUP BY MAHANG            OPEN IFSPGH           FETCH NEXT FROM IFSPGH INTO @MAHANG, @TTSLGIAO           WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0           BEGIN               SELECT @TK = ISNULL(SUM(slconlai), 0) FROM STOCKTP WHERE SLCONLAI > 0 AND PART = @MAHANG                            IF (@TK < @TTSLGIAO)               BEGIN                   DECLARE DUYETHT CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                   SELECT MAHANG, SUM(TTSLG) as TTSLG, GIOGIAO                   FROM TBL_TT_MAView                   WHERE CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) > @MaxDaGiao AND MAHANG = @MAHANG                  GROUP BY MAHANG, GIOGIAO                  ORDER BY CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) ASC                    OPEN DUYETHT                   FETCH NEXT FROM DUYETHT INTO @MAHANG, @SLGIAO, @GIOGIAO                   WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                   BEGIN                       IF (@TK > 0)                       BEGIN                           IF (@SLGIAO < @TK)                           BEGIN                               SET @TK = @TK - @SLGIAO                               SET @TTSLGIAO = @TTSLGIAO - @SLGIAO                           END                           ELSE                           BEGIN                               SET @SLT = @SLGIAO - @TK                               SET @TK = 0                               INSERT INTO [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + '] VALUES(@MAHANG, @SLGIAO, @SLT, @GIOGIAO)                           END                       END                       ELSE                       BEGIN                           INSERT INTO [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + '] VALUES(@MAHANG, @SLGIAO, @SLGIAO, @GIOGIAO)                       END                        FETCH NEXT FROM DUYETHT INTO @MAHANG, @SLGIAO, @GIOGIAO                   END                   CLOSE DUYETHT                   DEALLOCATE DUYETHT               END                FETCH NEXT FROM IFSPGH INTO @MAHANG, @TTSLGIAO           END                    CLOSE IFSPGH           DEALLOCATE IFSPGH     '      -- Thực thi chuỗi lệnh để đổ dữ liệu vào bảng vật lý động riêng biệt     EXEC sp_executesql @sqlMain, N'@MaxDaGiao INT', @MaxDaGiao = @MaxDaGiao      -- ── 5. XUẤT KẾT QUẢ VÀ DỌN DẸP ─────────────────────────────────────────     DECLARE @sqlSelect NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'         SELECT MH, SLGIAO, SLTHIEU, GIOGIAO          FROM [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + ']         ORDER BY MH, CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) ASC'     EXEC sp_executesql @sqlSelect      -- Xóa bảng kết quả của phiên làm việc này ngay sau khi xuất dữ liệu xong     DECLARE @sqlDrop NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'DROP TABLE [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + ']'     EXEC sp_executesql @sqlDrop END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_LOAD_PHIEU_DOCQR]     @NGAYGIAO nvarchar(20),     @NHAMAY   nvarchar(50)  = N'',     @GIOFCC   nvarchar(200) = N'',     @ADDNM    int AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON      DECLARE @TTIFS int      CREATE TABLE #GioList (GioInt int)     INSERT INTO #GioList     SELECT TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT)     FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(@GIOFCC, '''', ''), ',')     WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> ''       AND LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> '(GIAO DB)'       AND TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT) IS NOT NULL      SELECT @TTIFS = COUNT(*) FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG      IF CHARINDEX('(NHA MAY HA NAM)', @NHAMAY) > 0         SET @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'     ELSE         SET @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'      UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAO = '00H' WHERE GIOGIAO = '0H'     UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAO = REPLACE(GIOGIAO, 'H', '')         WHERE GIOGIAO <> '00H' AND GIOGIAO LIKE '%H'     UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET NHAMAY = 'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY VP)'         WHERE NHAMAY LIKE '%VP)'     UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAOFCC = GIOGIAO         WHERE GIOGIAOFCC = '(GIAO DB)' AND GIOGIAO <> '05'      IF EXISTS (         SELECT 1 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG         WHERE GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'           AND GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'           AND NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'     )     BEGIN         IF @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'             UPDATE L SET L.GIOGIAOFCC = C.GIOFCCHN             FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG L             INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME C ON C.GIOHVN = L.GIOGIAOFCC             WHERE L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'               AND L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'               AND L.NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'               AND L.NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY         ELSE             UPDATE L SET L.GIOGIAOFCC = C.GioFCCVP             FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG L             INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME C ON C.GIOHVN = L.GIOGIAOFCC             WHERE L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'               AND L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'               AND L.NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'               AND L.NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY     END      IF @GIOFCC = '(GIAO DB)'     BEGIN         DELETE TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG         INSERT INTO TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG             (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,              STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)         SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                ISNULL(PO_NO,''), ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'')         FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG     END     ELSE     BEGIN         IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DOCQRCODE)         BEGIN             DELETE TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG              IF @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'                 SET @ADDNM = 1             ELSE                 SET @ADDNM = 2              -- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════             -- FIX: nếu IFS rỗng (tháng trước đã close) →             --      bỏ qua bước tạo #LUU/#LUUGIO, đọc thẳng LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG             -- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════             IF @TTIFS = 0             BEGIN                 -- ── IFS rỗng → đọc thẳng LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG đầy đủ cột ───                 INSERT INTO TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                     (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                      NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,                      HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)                 SELECT                     STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                     NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,@NHAMAY,@ADDNM,                     HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                     ISNULL(PO_NO,''), ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'')                 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                 WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)                   AND NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY                   AND TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 -- ── IFS có dữ liệu → flow cũ: #LUU + #LUUGIO + LEFT JOIN ─                 CREATE TABLE #LUU (                     MAHANG     nvarchar(50),                     NGAYGIAO   date,                     CUA        nvarchar(20),                     TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),                     SOLUONG    int,                     GIOGIAO    nvarchar(10),                     GIOGIAOFCC nvarchar(50),                     LOT        nvarchar(500),                     STATUS     nvarchar(20),                     STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)                 )                  INSERT INTO #LUU                 SELECT                     RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),                     RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),                     SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, GIOGIAOFCC, LOT, STATUS, STATUSDOC                 FROM (                     SELECT *,                         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                             PARTITION BY RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),                                          RTRIM(CUA),    RTRIM(TRUYEN),                                          SOLUONG,       GIOGIAO,                                          RTRIM(NHAMAY)                             ORDER BY TGLUU DESC                         ) AS RN                     FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                     WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)                       AND NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY                       AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'                       AND GIOGIAO <> ''                       AND TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                 ) x                 WHERE x.RN = 1                  CREATE TABLE #LUUGIO (                     MAHANG     nvarchar(50),                     NGAYGIAO   date,                     CUA        nvarchar(20),                     TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),                     SOLUONG    int,                     GIO_PARSE  nvarchar(10),                     LOT        nvarchar(500),                     STATUS     nvarchar(20),                     STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)                 )                  INSERT INTO #LUUGIO                 SELECT                     l.MAHANG, l.NGAYGIAO, l.CUA, l.TRUYEN, l.SOLUONG,                     RIGHT('00' + LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)), 2) AS GIO_PARSE,                     l.LOT, l.STATUS, l.STATUSDOC                 FROM #LUU l                 CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(                     REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(l.GIOGIAOFCC, '(', ''), ')', ''), 'H', ''),                     '+'                 ) gs                 WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)) <> ''                   AND TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)) AS INT)                         IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                  CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_LUUGIO                     ON #LUUGIO (MAHANG, CUA, TRUYEN, SOLUONG, GIO_PARSE)                  INSERT INTO TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                     (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                      NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,                      HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)                 SELECT                     i.STT, i.CUA, i.TRUYEN, i.MAHANG, i.TENHANG,                     ISNULL(l.LOT,       i.LOT)       AS LOT,                     i.DV, i.SOLUONG, i.NGAYGIAO, i.GIOGIAO,                     ISNULL(l.STATUS,    i.STATUS)    AS STATUS,                     i.TTPHIEU, i.NHAMAY, @ADDNM, i.HOP,                     ISNULL(l.STATUSDOC, i.STATUSDOC) AS STATUSDOC,                     i.Note,                     ISNULL(i.PO_NO,   '') AS PO_NO,                     ISNULL(i.PO_ITEM, '') AS PO_ITEM                 FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG i                 LEFT JOIN #LUUGIO l                     ON  l.MAHANG    = RTRIM(i.MAHANG)                     AND l.CUA       = RTRIM(i.CUA)                     AND l.TRUYEN    = RTRIM(i.TRUYEN)                     AND l.SOLUONG   = i.SOLUONG                     AND l.GIO_PARSE = RTRIM(i.GIOGIAO)                  DROP TABLE #LUU                 DROP TABLE #LUUGIO             END         END     END      SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,            GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,            ISNULL(PO_NO,   '') AS PO_NO,            ISNULL(PO_ITEM, '') AS PO_ITEM     FROM TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG     ORDER BY TRY_CAST(STT AS INT), STT      DROP TABLE #GioList END
