CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_LOAD_PHIEU_DOCQR2405]       @NGAYGIAO   nvarchar(20),       @NHAMAY     nvarchar(50)  = N'',       @GIOFCC     nvarchar(200) = N'',       @ADDNM      int,       @TMPTABLE   nvarchar(100) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',       @IFSTABLE   nvarchar(100) = N'IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG',       @DOCQRTABLE nvarchar(100) = N'DOCQRCODE'   AS   BEGIN       SET NOCOUNT ON;          -- ── 1. Build #GioList (giữ INT như SP cũ) ───────────────────────────       CREATE TABLE #GioList (GioInt int)       INSERT INTO #GioList       SELECT TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT)       FROM   STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(@GIOFCC, '''', ''), ',')       WHERE  LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> ''         AND  LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> '(GIAO DB)'         AND  TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT) IS NOT NULL          -- ── 2. Đếm IFS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────       DECLARE @TTIFS int       DECLARE @SQL   nvarchar(max)       SET @SQL = N'SELECT @CNT = COUNT(*) FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE)       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@CNT int OUTPUT', @TTIFS OUTPUT          -- ── 3. Chuẩn hóa NHAMAY ─────────────────────────────────────────────       IF CHARINDEX('(NHA MAY HA NAM)', @NHAMAY) > 0           SET @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'       ELSE           SET @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'          IF @NHAMAY LIKE '%NHA MAY VP%'           SET @ADDNM = 1       ELSE           SET @ADDNM = 2          -- ── 4. Normalize LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG — chỉ theo ngày+nhà máy ──────────       -- GIỮ từ SP mới: filter NGAYGIAO + NHAMAY, không update toàn bảng       UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG       SET GIOGIAO = CASE           WHEN GIOGIAO = '0H'    THEN '00H'           WHEN GIOGIAO LIKE '%H' THEN REPLACE(GIOGIAO, 'H', '')           ELSE GIOGIAO END       WHERE NHAMAY   LIKE @NHAMAY         AND NGAYGIAO  = @NGAYGIAO         AND (GIOGIAO = '0H' OR GIOGIAO LIKE '%H')          UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG       SET NHAMAY = 'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY VP)'       WHERE NHAMAY   LIKE '%VP)'         AND NGAYGIAO  = @NGAYGIAO          UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG       SET GIOGIAOFCC = GIOGIAO       WHERE GIOGIAOFCC = '(GIAO DB)'         AND GIOGIAO   <> '05'         AND NGAYGIAO   = @NGAYGIAO         AND NHAMAY    LIKE @NHAMAY          -- ── 5. Chuẩn hóa GIOGIAOFCC — SET-BASED (GIỮ từ SP mới) ────────────       UPDATE luu       SET luu.GIOGIAOFCC = CASE           WHEN @NHAMAY LIKE '%NHA MAY HA NAM%' THEN ct.GIOFCCHN           ELSE ct.GioFCCVP       END       FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG luu       INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME ct              ON  ct.GIOHVN        = luu.GIOGIAOFCC       WHERE  luu.NHAMAY          LIKE @NHAMAY         AND  luu.NGAYGIAO         = @NGAYGIAO         AND  luu.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'         AND  luu.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'         AND  luu.NHAMAY          <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'          -- ── 6. GIAO DB ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────       IF @GIOFCC = '(GIAO DB)'       BEGIN           SET @SQL =               N'DELETE ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N';' +               N'INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) +               N' (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,' +               N'  STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)' +               N' SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,' +               N'        STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,' +               N'        ISNULL(PO_NO,''''),ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'''')' +               N' FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE)           EXEC sp_executesql @SQL           GOTO XUAT_KQ       END          -- ── 7. Kiểm tra DOCQR — đang bắn dở → giữ nguyên TMP ───────────────       DECLARE @CntDocQR int = 0       SET @SQL = N'SELECT @CNT = COUNT(*) FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@DOCQRTABLE)       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@CNT int OUTPUT', @CntDocQR OUTPUT          IF @CntDocQR > 0           GOTO XUAT_KQ          -- ── 8. Không bắn QR → load mới ──────────────────────────────────────       SET @SQL = N'DELETE ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE)       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL          -- ── 9. TTIFS = 0 → IFS đã close → đọc thẳng LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG ────────       IF @TTIFS = 0       BEGIN           SET @SQL = N'               INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'                   (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                    NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,                    HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)               SELECT                   STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                   NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,@ADDNM,                   HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                   ISNULL(PO_NO,''''), ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'''')               FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG               WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)                 AND NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY                 AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE ''%[^0-9]%''                 AND GIOGIAO <> ''''                 AND (                     NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GioList)                     OR TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                 )'           EXEC sp_executesql @SQL,               N'@NGAYGIAO nvarchar(20), @NHAMAY nvarchar(50), @ADDNM int',               @NGAYGIAO, @NHAMAY, @ADDNM           GOTO XUAT_KQ       END          -- ── 10. TTIFS > 0 → IFS có data → #LUU → #LUUGIO → LEFT JOIN ────────       -- GIỮ NGUYÊN từ SP cũ: đây là flow đúng, không dùng LEFT JOIN thô       CREATE TABLE #LUU (           MAHANG     nvarchar(50),           NGAYGIAO   date,           CUA        nvarchar(20),           TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),           SOLUONG    int,           GIOGIAO    nvarchar(10),           GIOGIAOFCC nvarchar(50),           LOT        nvarchar(500),           STATUS     nvarchar(20),           STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)       )          CREATE TABLE #LUUGIO (           MAHANG    nvarchar(50),           NGAYGIAO  date,           CUA       nvarchar(20),           TRUYEN    nvarchar(20),           SOLUONG   int,           GIO_PARSE nvarchar(10),           LOT       nvarchar(500),           STATUS    nvarchar(20),           STATUSDOC nvarchar(50)       )          -- ── 11. INSERT #LUU — lấy dòng mới nhất theo TGLUU ──────────────────       INSERT INTO #LUU       SELECT           RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),           RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),           SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, GIOGIAOFCC, LOT, STATUS, STATUSDOC       FROM (           SELECT *,               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                   PARTITION BY RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),                                RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),                                SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, RTRIM(NHAMAY)                   ORDER BY TGLUU DESC               ) AS RN           FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG           WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)             AND NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY             AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'             AND GIOGIAO <> ''             AND (                 NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GioList)                 OR TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)             )       ) x       WHERE x.RN = 1          -- ── 12. INSERT #LUUGIO — chuẩn hóa GIO_PARSE ────────────────────────       INSERT INTO #LUUGIO       SELECT           l.MAHANG, l.NGAYGIAO, l.CUA, l.TRUYEN, l.SOLUONG,           RIGHT('00' + LTRIM(RTRIM(l.GIOGIAO)), 2) AS GIO_PARSE,           l.LOT, l.STATUS, l.STATUSDOC       FROM #LUU l       WHERE l.GIOGIAO <> ''         AND (             NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GioList)             OR TRY_CAST(l.GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)         )          -- Index để tăng tốc JOIN ở bước 13       CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_LUUGIO           ON #LUUGIO (MAHANG, CUA, TRUYEN, SOLUONG, GIO_PARSE)          -- ── 13. INSERT vào TMP — LEFT JOIN IFS + #LUUGIO ─────────────────────       -- FIX NULL: ISNULL(CUA,'') và ISNULL(TRUYEN,'') — giữ từ SP cũ đã fix       SET @SQL = N'           INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'               (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)           SELECT               i.STT, i.CUA, i.TRUYEN, i.MAHANG, i.TENHANG,               ISNULL(l.LOT,       i.LOT),       i.DV, i.SOLUONG, i.NGAYGIAO, i.GIOGIAO,               ISNULL(l.STATUS,    i.STATUS),    i.TTPHIEU, i.NHAMAY, @ADDNM,               i.HOP,               ISNULL(l.STATUSDOC, i.STATUSDOC), i.Note,               ISNULL(i.PO_NO,  '''') AS PO_NO,               ISNULL(i.PO_ITEM,'''') AS PO_ITEM           FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE) + N' i           LEFT JOIN #LUUGIO l               ON  l.MAHANG                  = RTRIM(i.MAHANG)               AND ISNULL(l.CUA,   '''')     = ISNULL(RTRIM(i.CUA),   '''')               AND ISNULL(l.TRUYEN,'''')     = ISNULL(RTRIM(i.TRUYEN),'''')               AND l.SOLUONG                 = i.SOLUONG               AND l.GIO_PARSE               = RIGHT(''00'' + LTRIM(RTRIM(i.GIOGIAO)), 2)'       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@ADDNM int', @ADDNM          DROP TABLE #LUU       DROP TABLE #LUUGIO          XUAT_KQ:       DROP TABLE #GioList          -- ── 14. Xuất kết quả ─────────────────────────────────────────────────       SET @SQL =           N'SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,' +           N'       NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,' +           N'       HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,' +           N'       ISNULL(PO_NO,'''')   AS PO_NO,' +           N'       ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'''') AS PO_ITEM' +           N' FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) +           N' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(STT AS INT), STT'       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL   END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_LOAD_PHIEU_DOCQROLD]         @NGAYGIAO nvarchar(20),         @NHAMAY   nvarchar(50)  = N'',         @GIOFCC   nvarchar(200) = N'',         @ADDNM    int     AS     BEGIN         SET NOCOUNT ON;              DECLARE @TTIFS int              -- ── 1. TẠO DANH SÁCH GIỜ TỪ THAM SỐ RADIO ĐANG CHỌN (DÙNG INT ĐỂ LỌC GỐC) ──         CREATE TABLE #GioList (GioInt int)            INSERT INTO #GioList         SELECT TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT)         FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(@GIOFCC, '''', ''), ',')         WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> ''           AND LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> '(GIAO DB)'           AND TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT) IS NOT NULL            SELECT @TTIFS = COUNT(*) FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG              -- ── 2. CHUẨN HÓA THAM SỐ ĐỂ TRA CỨU ─────────────────────────────────         IF CHARINDEX('(NHA MAY HA NAM)', @NHAMAY) > 0             SET @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'         ELSE             SET @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'              -- Chuẩn hóa dữ liệu bảng lịch sử quét để tăng tốc độ tìm kiếm         UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAO = '00H' WHERE GIOGIAO = '0H'         UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAO = REPLACE(GIOGIAO, 'H', '') WHERE GIOGIAO <> '00H' AND GIOGIAO LIKE '%H'         UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET NHAMAY  = 'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY VP)' WHERE NHAMAY LIKE '%VP)'         UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAOFCC = GIOGIAO WHERE GIOGIAOFCC = '(GIAO DB)' AND GIOGIAO <> '05'              -- Đồng bộ hóa khung giờ thực tế theo bảng tra cứu thời gian         IF EXISTS (             SELECT 1 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG             WHERE GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'               AND GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'               AND NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'         )         BEGIN             IF @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'             BEGIN                 UPDATE L SET L.GIOGIAOFCC = C.GIOFCCHN                 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG L                 INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME C ON C.GIOHVN = L.GIOGIAOFCC                 WHERE L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H' AND L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%' AND L.NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM' AND L.NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 UPDATE L SET L.GIOGIAOFCC = C.GioFCCVP                 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG L                 INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME C ON C.GIOHVN = L.GIOGIAOFCC                 WHERE L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H' AND L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%' AND L.NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM' AND L.NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY             END         END              -- ── 3. XỬ LÝ ĐỔ DỮ LIỆU RA LƯỚI HIỂN THỊ ────────────────────────────         IF @GIOFCC = '(GIAO DB)'         BEGIN             DELETE TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG             INSERT INTO TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                 (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                  STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)             SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                    STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                    ISNULL(PO_NO,''), ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'')             FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG         END         ELSE         BEGIN             IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DOCQRCODE)             BEGIN                 DELETE TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                      IF @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'                     SET @ADDNM = 1                 ELSE                     SET @ADDNM = 2                      -- ── BƯỚC 1: Lọc nạp dữ liệu lịch sử quét ──                 CREATE TABLE #LUU (                     MAHANG     nvarchar(50),                     NGAYGIAO   date,                     CUA        nvarchar(20),                     TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),                     SOLUONG    int,                     GIOGIAO    nvarchar(10),                     GIOGIAOFCC nvarchar(50),                     LOT        nvarchar(500),                     STATUS     nvarchar(20),                     STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)                 )                      INSERT INTO #LUU                 SELECT                      RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date), RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),                     SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, GIOGIAOFCC, LOT, STATUS, STATUSDOC                 FROM (                     SELECT *,                         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                             PARTITION BY RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),                                          RTRIM(CUA),    RTRIM(TRUYEN),                                          SOLUONG,       GIOGIAO,                                          RTRIM(NHAMAY)                             ORDER BY TGLUU DESC                         ) AS RN                     FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                     WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)                       AND NHAMAY                 LIKE @NHAMAY                       AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'                         AND GIOGIAO <> ''                       -- Lọc nhanh bằng ép kiểu INT để tránh sót dữ liệu dạng '6' hay '06'                       AND TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                  ) x                 WHERE x.RN = 1                      -- ── BƯỚC 2: Tách chuỗi Giờ tổng hợp để phục vụ đối chiếu mẫu ──────                 CREATE TABLE #LUUGIO (                     MAHANG     nvarchar(50),                     NGAYGIAO   date,                     CUA        nvarchar(20),                     TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),                     SOLUONG    int,                     GIO_PARSE  nvarchar(10),                     LOT        nvarchar(500),                     STATUS     nvarchar(20),                     STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)                 )                      INSERT INTO #LUUGIO                 SELECT                      l.MAHANG, l.NGAYGIAO, l.CUA, l.TRUYEN, l.SOLUONG,                     -- ══ FIX CHÍ MẠNG: Định dạng chuỗi giờ bóc tách về dạng 2 chữ số '0X' (ví dụ: '6' -> '06')                     -- Điều này đảm bảo mỗi khung giờ con trả về đúng mã định danh của nó, không trùng lắp GIO_PARSE                     RIGHT('00' + LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)), 2) AS GIO_PARSE,                     l.LOT, l.STATUS, l.STATUSDOC                 FROM #LUU l                 CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(                     REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(l.GIOGIAOFCC, '(', ''), ')', ''), 'H', ''),                     '+'                 ) gs                 WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)) <> ''                   AND TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)) AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                      CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_LUUGIO ON #LUUGIO (MAHANG, CUA, TRUYEN, SOLUONG, GIO_PARSE)                      -- ── BƯỚC 3: Dùng IFS làm gốc, LEFT JOIN để map trạng thái Quét ──                 INSERT INTO TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                     (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                      STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)                 SELECT                     i.STT,                     i.CUA,                     i.TRUYEN,                     i.MAHANG,                     i.TENHANG,                     ISNULL(l.LOT,       i.LOT)       AS LOT,                     i.DV,                     i.SOLUONG,                     i.NGAYGIAO,                     i.GIOGIAO,                     ISNULL(l.STATUS,    i.STATUS)    AS STATUS,                     i.TTPHIEU,                     i.NHAMAY,                     @ADDNM,                     i.HOP,                     ISNULL(l.STATUSDOC, i.STATUSDOC) AS STATUSDOC,                     i.Note,                     ISNULL(i.PO_NO,   '') AS PO_NO,                     ISNULL(i.PO_ITEM, '') AS PO_ITEM                 FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG i                 LEFT JOIN #LUUGIO l                     ON  l.MAHANG    = RTRIM(i.MAHANG)                     AND l.CUA       = RTRIM(i.CUA)                     AND l.TRUYEN    = RTRIM(i.TRUYEN)                     AND l.SOLUONG   = i.SOLUONG                     -- So khớp chuẩn chuỗi dạng '06' = '06' (hoàn toàn loại bỏ double row)                     AND l.GIO_PARSE = RTRIM(i.GIOGIAO)                       DROP TABLE #LUU                 DROP TABLE #LUUGIO             END         END              -- ── 4. TRẢ KẾT QUẢ ĐẦU RA CHO GRIDVIEW ───────────────────────────────         SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,                GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                ISNULL(PO_NO,   '') AS PO_NO,                ISNULL(PO_ITEM, '') AS PO_ITEM         FROM TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG         ORDER BY TRY_CAST(STT AS INT), STT              DROP TABLE #GioList     END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_Update_Stock]           @GIOGIAOFCC NVARCHAR(250) = N'',           @NHAMAY     NVARCHAR(250) = N''      AS       BEGIN           SET NOCOUNT ON;                  DECLARE @NgayGiao SMALLDATETIME = CAST(GETDATE() AS SMALLDATETIME)                  DECLARE               @_LOT        NVARCHAR(MAX),               @_STTPHIEU   INT,               @_SL         INT,               @_STATUS     NVARCHAR(5),               @_SLCONLAI   INT,               @STT         INT,               @MH          NVARCHAR(60),               @_LOTSL_Tach NVARCHAR(500),               @_LOTOK      NVARCHAR(500),               @_SLOK       INT,               @_KTPC       INT                  -- =====================================================================           -- KHỞI TẠO CÁC BẢNG TẠM           -- =====================================================================           IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#TMPUPDATE') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TMPUPDATE           CREATE TABLE #TMPUPDATE (             STT     INT,             MH      NVARCHAR(60),             LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),             SOLUONG INT,             STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)         )              IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STOK') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #STOK         CREATE TABLE #STOK (             STT     INT,             LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),             SOLUONG INT,             STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)         )              IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STNG') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #STNG         CREATE TABLE #STNG (             MH      NVARCHAR(100),             LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),             SLCAN   INT,            -- Số lượng cần xuất         SLCO    INT,            -- Số lượng tồn kho hiện tại         SLTHIEU INT,            -- Số lượng hụt thiếu         STATUS  NVARCHAR(500)         )                  BEGIN TRY                  -- 1. DUYỆT PHIẾU GIAO HÀNG TỪ BẢNG TẠM ĐỂ PHÂN TÍCH (CURSOR 1)               DECLARE PGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                    SELECT STT, LOT, MAHANG                   FROM TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                   WHERE LOT <> '' AND (STATUS <> 'OK' OR STATUS IS NULL)                      OPEN PGH               FETCH NEXT FROM PGH INTO @STT, @_LOT, @MH                      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0               BEGIN                                  -- Kiểm tra trùng cho RIÊNG DÒNG MÃ HÀNG đang duyệt này                 IF EXISTS (                     SELECT 1                     FROM TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG tmp                     INNER JOIN LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG luu ON                          RTRIM(luu.MAHANG)   = RTRIM(tmp.MAHANG)                          AND CAST(luu.NGAYGIAO AS DATE) = CAST(tmp.NGAYGIAO AS DATE)                           AND RTRIM(luu.CUA)    = RTRIM(tmp.CUA)                           AND RTRIM(luu.TRUYEN) = RTRIM(tmp.TRUYEN)                           AND luu.SOLUONG       = tmp.SOLUONG                           AND RTRIM(luu.GIOGIAO)= RTRIM(tmp.GIOGIAO)                           AND RTRIM(luu.NHAMAY) = RTRIM(LEFT(@NHAMAY, 50))                     WHERE tmp.STT = @STT                 )                 BEGIN                     INSERT INTO #STNG (MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)                       VALUES (@MH, @_LOT, 0, 0, 0, N'Mã hàng này đã được lưu trước đó!')                   END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     -- Tách chuỗi LOT-SL con nếu một ô chứa chuỗi nhiều lô phân cách bằng dấu phẩy                 IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SplitResult') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SplitResult                 CREATE TABLE #SplitResult (LotTach NVARCHAR(500))                  INSERT INTO #SplitResult                 SELECT * FROM dbo.Split(@_LOT, ',')                                  DECLARE @CurrLotTach NVARCHAR(500)                 DECLARE LOT_IN_PGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT LotTach FROM #SplitResult                                  OPEN LOT_IN_PGH                       FETCH NEXT FROM LOT_IN_PGH INTO @CurrLotTach                                  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                       BEGIN                           SET @_KTPC  = CHARINDEX('-', @CurrLotTach)                                                    IF @_KTPC > 1                           BEGIN                               SET @_LOTOK = SUBSTRING(@CurrLotTach, 1, @_KTPC - 1)                               SET @_SLOK  = CAST(RIGHT(@CurrLotTach, LEN(@CurrLotTach) - @_KTPC) AS INT)                                          SET @_SLCONLAI = 0;                               SELECT @_SLCONLAI = ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0)                               FROM STOCKTP                               WHERE SUBSTRING(LOT, 1, 12) = SUBSTRING(@_LOTOK, 1, 12)                                          IF EXISTS (                                   SELECT 1 FROM STOCKTP                                   WHERE SUBSTRING(LOT, 1, 12) = SUBSTRING(@_LOTOK, 1, 12))                               BEGIN                                   IF @_SLCONLAI >= @_SLOK                                       INSERT INTO #TMPUPDATE (STT, MH, LOT, SOLUONG, STATUS)                                       VALUES (@STT, @MH, @_LOTOK, @_SLOK, 'OK')                                   ELSE                                       INSERT INTO #STNG (MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)                                       VALUES (@MH, @_LOTOK, @_SLOK, @_SLCONLAI, (@_SLOK - @_SLCONLAI), N'Không đủ tồn kho ban đầu')                               END                               ELSE                                   INSERT INTO #STNG (MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)                                   VALUES (@MH, @_LOTOK, @_SLOK, 0, @_SLOK, N'Không tồn tại LOT trong STOCKTP')                           END                           ELSE                           BEGIN                               INSERT INTO #STNG (MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)                               VALUES (@MH, @CurrLotTach, 0, 0, 0, N'Định dạng chuỗi LOT-SL không hợp lệ')                           END                                      FETCH NEXT FROM LOT_IN_PGH INTO @CurrLotTach                       END                       CLOSE LOT_IN_PGH                       DEALLOCATE LOT_IN_PGH                   END                            FETCH NEXT FROM PGH INTO @STT, @_LOT, @MH               END               CLOSE PGH               DEALLOCATE PGH                      -- =====================================================================               -- 2. TIẾN HÀNH CẬP NHẬT KHO CHO CÁC DÒNG HỢP LỆ               -- =====================================================================               IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #TMPUPDATE WHERE STATUS = 'OK')               BEGIN                   DECLARE                       @_LOTUD  NVARCHAR(500),                       @_SLUD   INT,                       @_STTUD  INT,                       @_STUP   NVARCHAR(15),                 @_MHUD   NVARCHAR(60)                    DELETE #STOK                          -- ─── LỚP PHÒNG THỦ LỖI: TÍNH TOÁN CHI TIẾT SỐ LƯỢNG CẦN, TỒN, THIẾU TRƯỚC KHI UPDATE ───             -- Tạo bảng gom nhóm tổng lượng cần xuất theo từng cặp Mã Hàng + LOT để đối chiếu tổng thể với kho gốc             IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#GomNhomCheck') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GomNhomCheck CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_Update_Stock2405]       @GIOGIAOFCC  NVARCHAR(250) = N'',       @NHAMAY      NVARCHAR(250) = N'',       @TMPTABLE    NVARCHAR(128) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',       @DOCQRTABLE  NVARCHAR(128) = N'DOCQRCODE',     @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NVARCHAR(20) = N'INPUT'   AS   BEGIN       SET NOCOUNT ON;          /*           ================================================================           QUY ƯỚC LOT           ================================================================              STOCKTP.LOT đầy đủ là định danh chính xác của LOT vật lý.          - Nếu đầu vào dài hơn 13 ký tự: chỉ khớp RTRIM(STOCKTP.LOT) = RTRIM(@LOT).         - Nếu đầu vào chỉ có mã gốc 13 ký tự: chỉ chấp nhận khi mã gốc ánh xạ tới           đúng một LOT vật lý; nếu có nhiều LOT vật lý thì ghi lỗi và dừng trước           mọi cập nhật tồn.         - Tuyệt đối không cộng tồn của nhiều LOT vật lý theo tiền tố rồi trừ một           LOT bất kỳ. Kiểm tra khả dụng và bước trừ kho phải dùng cùng quy tắc.     */          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 1. WHITELIST TÊN BẢNG       --------------------------------------------------------------------       IF @TMPTABLE NOT IN       (           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_SP',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANGDB',         N'SP_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100002',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100003'       )       BEGIN           RAISERROR(               N'Tên bảng TMPTABLE không hợp lệ: %s',               16,               1,               @TMPTABLE           );           RETURN;       END;          IF @DOCQRTABLE NOT IN       (           N'DOCQRCODE',           N'DOCQRCODE_SP',         N'DOCQRCODE_DB',         N'SP_DOCQRCODE',         N'YMVN_DOCQRCODE',         N'DOCQRCODE_100002',         N'DOCQRCODE_100003'       )       BEGIN           RAISERROR(               N'Tên bảng DOCQRTABLE không hợp lệ: %s',               16,               1,               @DOCQRTABLE           );           RETURN;       END;          IF @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NOT IN (N'INPUT', N'FIFO_SP')     BEGIN         RAISERROR(N'LOTRESOLUTIONMODE không hợp lệ: %s', 16, 1, @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE);         RETURN;     END;      --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 2. KHAI BÁO BIẾN       --------------------------------------------------------------------       DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);     DECLARE @StartedTransaction BIT = 0;     DECLARE @ErrMH NVARCHAR(60) = NULL;   -- mã hàng đang xử lý khi lỗi nghiệp vụ FIFO_SP     DECLARE @ErrQty INT = NULL;           -- số lượng cần giao của dòng đó     DECLARE @ErrTon INT = NULL;           -- tổng tồn khả dụng của mã hàng (chỉ để hiển thị)     DECLARE @SavepointCreated BIT = 0;          DECLARE           @_LOT          NVARCHAR(MAX),           @_SLCONLAI     INT,           @STT           INT,           @MH            NVARCHAR(60),           @_LOTSL_Tach   NVARCHAR(500),           @_LOTOK        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLOK         INT,           @_KTPC         INT,           @_LOTUD        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLUD         INT,           @_STTUD        INT,           @_STUP         NVARCHAR(15),           @LotThuc       NVARCHAR(500),         @LockResource  NVARCHAR(255),         @LockResult    INT,         @StockRowsUpdated INT;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 3. XÓA TEMP TABLE CŨ       --------------------------------------------------------------------       IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#TMPUPDATE') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #TMPUPDATE;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STOK') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #STOK;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STNG') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #STNG;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#PHIEU') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #PHIEU;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#GomNhomCheck') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #GomNhomCheck;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SplitResult') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #SplitResult;        IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#StockByLot') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #StockByLot;      IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#LotKeyCount') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #LotKeyCount;        --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 4. TEMP TABLE       --------------------------------------------------------------------       CREATE TABLE #TMPUPDATE       (           STT     INT,           MH      NVARCHAR(60),           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STOK       (           STT     INT,           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STNG       (           MH       NVARCHAR(100),           LOT      NVARCHAR(MAX),           SLCAN    INT,           SLCO     INT,           SLTHIEU  INT,           STATUS   NVARCHAR(500)       );          CREATE TABLE #PHIEU       (           STT INT,           LOT NVARCHAR(MAX),           MH  NVARCHAR(60)       );          BEGIN TRY          -- Own a transaction when called directly; otherwise participate in the         -- repository UnitOfWork through a savepoint. Start before the idempotency         -- check so concurrent confirmations serialize before reading/writing stock.         IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0         BEGIN             BEGIN TRANSACTION;             SET @StartedTransaction = 1;         END         ELSE         BEGIN             SAVE TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             SET @SavepointCreated = 1;         END;            ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 5. NẠP PHIẾU           ----------------------------------------------------------------           SET @sql = N'               INSERT INTO #PHIEU               (                   STT,                   LOT,                   MH               )               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   MAHANG               FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']               WHERE ISNULL(LOT, '''') <> ''''   -- chỉ xử lý dòng ĐÃ có LOT (đã thống kê); dòng chưa có LOT bỏ qua, kể cả FIFO_SP               AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);           ';              EXEC sp_executesql @sql,             N'@LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NVARCHAR(20)',             @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- Không có phiếu           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #PHIEU)           BEGIN             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 COMMIT TRANSACTION;                SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 6. DUYỆT PHIẾU           ----------------------------------------------------------------           DECLARE PGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   MH               FROM #PHIEU;              OPEN PGH;              FETCH NEXT FROM PGH           INTO @STT, @_LOT, @MH;              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0           BEGIN               DECLARE @DaTon BIT = 0;                  DECLARE @CheckResult TABLE               (                   Found INT               );                  ------------------------------------------------------------             -- 6.1. Serialize the complete delivery identity before checking for             -- an existing confirmation. The lock is transaction-owned and therefore             -- remains held through STOCKTP, ledger, and pending-delivery writes.             ------------------------------------------------------------             SET @LockResource = NULL;             SET @sql = N'                 SELECT @Resource =                     N''PCTP_DELIVERY:'' +                     CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64), HASHBYTES(''SHA2_256'', CONCAT(                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(MAHANG, N''''))), N''|'',                         ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS DATE), 23), N''''), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(CUA, N''''))), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(TRUYEN, N''''))), N''|'',                         ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), SOLUONG), N''''), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(GIOGIAO, N''''))), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(ISNULL(@NHAMAY, N''''), 50)))                     )), 2)                 FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']                 WHERE STT = @STT;';              EXEC sp_executesql                 @sql,                 N'@STT INT, @NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250), @Resource NVARCHAR(255) OUTPUT',                 @STT = @STT,                 @NHAMAY = @NHAMAY,                 @Resource = @LockResource OUTPUT;              IF @LockResource IS NULL                 RAISERROR(N'Không tạo được khóa chống xác nhận giao hàng trùng.', 16, 1);              EXEC @LockResult = sys.sp_getapplock                 @Resource = @LockResource,                 @LockMode = N'Exclusive',                 @LockOwner = N'Transaction',                 @LockTimeout = 10000;              IF @LockResult < 0                 RAISERROR(N'Không lấy được khóa xác nhận giao hàng; vui lòng thử lại.', 16, 1);              ------------------------------------------------------------             -- 6.1. KIỂM TRA PHIẾU ĐÃ LƯU             ------------------------------------------------------------             SET @sql = N'                   SELECT TOP 1 1                   FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] tmp                   INNER JOIN LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG luu                       ON RTRIM(luu.MAHANG) =                          RTRIM(tmp.MAHANG)                         AND CAST(luu.NGAYGIAO AS DATE) =                          CAST(tmp.NGAYGIAO AS DATE)                         AND RTRIM(luu.CUA) =                          RTRIM(tmp.CUA)                         AND RTRIM(luu.TRUYEN) =                          RTRIM(tmp.TRUYEN)                         AND luu.SOLUONG =                          tmp.SOLUONG                         AND RTRIM(luu.GIOGIAO) =                          RTRIM(tmp.GIOGIAO)                         AND RTRIM(luu.NHAMAY) =                          RTRIM(LEFT(@NHAMAY, 50))                      WHERE tmp.STT = @STT;               ';                  INSERT INTO @CheckResult               EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'@NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250), @STT INT',                   @NHAMAY,                   @STT;                  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @CheckResult)                   SET @DaTon = 1;                  DELETE FROM @CheckResult;                  ------------------------------------------------------------               -- 6.2. ĐÃ TỒN TẠI               ------------------------------------------------------------               IF @DaTon = 1               BEGIN                   INSERT INTO #STNG                   (                       MH,                       LOT,                       SLCAN,                       SLCO,                       SLTHIEU,                       STATUS                   )                   VALUES                   (                       @MH,                       @_LOT,                  0,                       0,                       0,                       N'Mã hàng này đã được lưu trước đó!'                   );               END               ELSE               BEGIN                      --------------------------------------------------------                    --------------------------------------------------------                 -- 6.2a. FIFO_SP: chọn một LOT vật lý đủ tồn trong cùng transaction.                 --------------------------------------------------------                 IF @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = N'FIFO_SP' AND ISNULL(@_LOT, N'') = N''   -- không ghi đè LOT đã thống kê                 BEGIN                     DECLARE @FifoLot NVARCHAR(500) = NULL;                     DECLARE @FifoQty INT = NULL;                      SET @sql = N'                         SELECT @Qty = TRY_CONVERT(INT, SOLUONG)                         FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)                         WHERE STT = @STT                           AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);                          SELECT TOP (1) @Lot = s.LOT                         FROM STOCKTP s WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK)                         WHERE COALESCE(                               NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.SP)), N''''),                               NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.PART)), N'''')                           ) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@MaHang))                           AND ISNULL(s.SLCONLAI, 0) >= @Qty                           AND LEN(ISNULL(s.LOT, N'''')) >= 7                           AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LEFT(s.LOT, 6), 12) IS NOT NULL                           AND SUBSTRING(s.LOT, 7, 1) IN (N''0'', N''1'', N''2'', N''3'')                         ORDER BY LEFT(s.LOT, 6) ASC,                             CASE SUBSTRING(s.LOT, 7, 1)                                 WHEN N''0'' THEN 0 WHEN N''1'' THEN 1                                 WHEN N''2'' THEN 2 WHEN N''3'' THEN 3                             END ASC, s.LOT ASC;';                      EXEC sp_executesql @sql,                         N'@STT INT, @MaHang NVARCHAR(60), @Qty INT OUTPUT, @Lot NVARCHAR(500) OUTPUT',                         @STT=@STT, @MaHang=@MH,                         @Qty=@FifoQty OUTPUT, @Lot=@FifoLot OUTPUT;                      IF @FifoQty IS NULL OR @FifoQty <= 0                     BEGIN                         SET @ErrMH = @MH;                         SET @ErrQty = @FifoQty;                         THROW 51035, N'Số lượng giao SP phải lớn hơn 0.', 1;                     END;                     IF @FifoLot IS NULL                     BEGIN                         SET @ErrMH = @MH;                         SET @ErrQty = @FifoQty;                         THROW 51036, N'Không tìm được một LOT FIFO đủ tồn cho mã hàng SP (cần đủ trong MỘT LOT, đúng định dạng yyMMdd + [0-3]).', 1;                     END;                      SET @_LOT = @FifoLot + N'-' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @FifoQty);                     DECLARE @FifoTmpRows INT = 0;                     SET @sql = N'UPDATE [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] SET LOT=@Lot                                  WHERE STT=@STT AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);                                  SET @Rows = @@ROWCOUNT;';                     EXEC sp_executesql @sql,                         N'@STT INT, @Lot NVARCHAR(500), @Rows INT OUTPUT',                         @STT=@STT, @Lot=@FifoLot, @Rows=@FifoTmpRows OUTPUT;                     IF @FifoTmpRows <> 1                         THROW 51037, N'Phiếu TMP đã thay đổi; không thể gán LOT FIFO.', 1;                 END;                  -- 6.3. TÁCH LOT-SL                   --------------------------------------------------------                   IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SplitResult') IS NOT NULL                       DROP TABLE #SplitResult;                      CREATE TABLE #SplitResult                   (                       LotTach NVARCHAR(500)                   );                      INSERT INTO #SplitResult                   SELECT *                   FROM dbo.Split(@_LOT, ',');                      DECLARE LOT_IN_PGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                       SELECT LotTach                       FROM #SplitResult;                      OPEN LOT_IN_PGH;                      FETCH NEXT FROM LOT_IN_PGH                   INTO @_LOTSL_Tach;                      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                   BEGIN                       ----------------------------------------------------                       -- 6.4. TÁCH LOT-SL                       ----------------------------------------------------                       SET @_KTPC =                           CHARINDEX('-', @_LOTSL_Tach);                          IF @_KTPC > 1                       BEGIN                           SET @_LOTOK =                               SUBSTRING(                                   @_LOTSL_Tach,                                   1,                                   @_KTPC - 1                               );                              SET @_SLOK =                               TRY_CAST(                                   RIGHT(                                       @_LOTSL_Tach,                                       LEN(@_LOTSL_Tach) - @_KTPC                                   )                                   AS INT                               );                              ------------------------------------------------                           -- SL không hợp lệ                           ------------------------------------------------                           IF @_SLOK IS NULL                           BEGIN                               INSERT INTO #STNG                               (                                   MH,                                   LOT,                                   SLCAN,                                   SLCO,                                   SLTHIEU,                                   STATUS                               )                               VALUES                               (                                   @MH,                                   @_LOTSL_Tach,                                   0,                                   0,                                   0,                                   N'Số lượng trong chuỗi LOT-SL không hợp lệ'                               );                           END                           ELSE                           BEGIN                                  ------------------------------------------------                               -- 6.5. TÌM TỒN THEO LOT KEY 13 KÝ TỰ                               ------------------------------------------------                               SET @_SLCONLAI = 0;                              -- Full physical LOT is the exact identity. A 13-character                             -- root is accepted only when it maps to one physical LOT.                             IF LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTOK)) > 13                             BEGIN                                 SELECT @_SLCONLAI = ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0)                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTOK);                             END                             ELSE IF (                                 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT))                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13)                             ) = 1                             BEGIN                                 SELECT TOP (1) @_SLCONLAI = ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0)                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13)                                 ORDER BY LOT ASC;                             END                             ELSE IF (                                 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT))                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13)                             ) > 1                             BEGIN                                 INSERT INTO #STNG(MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)                                 VALUES(@MH, @_LOTOK, @_SLOK, 0, @_SLOK,                                        N'Mã LOT gốc ánh xạ nhiều LOT vật lý; vui lòng cung cấp LOT đầy đủ');                             END;                                  ------------------------------------------------                               -- 6.6. KIỂM TRA LOT TỒN TẠI. Skip duplicate diagnostics if root is ambiguous.                             IF NOT EXISTS                             (                                 SELECT 1 FROM #STNG                                 WHERE RTRIM(MH) = RTRIM(@MH)                                   AND RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTOK)                                   AND STATUS = N'Mã LOT gốc ánh xạ nhiều LOT vật lý; vui lòng cung cấp LOT đầy đủ'                             )                             AND EXISTS                             (                                 SELECT 1                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE (LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTOK)) > 13 AND RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTOK))                                    OR (LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTOK)) <= 13 AND LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13))                             )                             BEGIN                                      ------------------------------------------------                                   -- ĐỦ TỒN                                   ------------------------------------------------                                   IF @_SLCONLAI >= @_SLOK                                   BEGIN                                       INSERT INTO #TMPUPDATE                                       (                                           STT,                                           MH,                                           LOT,                                           SOLUONG,                                           STATUS                                       )                                       VALUES                                       (                                           @STT,                                           @MH,                                           @_LOTOK,                                           @_SLOK,                                           'OK'                                       );                                   END                                   ELSE                                   BEGIN                                          ------------------------------------------------                                       -- KHÔNG ĐỦ TỒN                                       ------------------------------------------------                                       INSERT INTO #STNG                                       (                                           MH,                                           LOT,                                           SLCAN,                                           SLCO,                                           SLTHIEU,                                           STATUS                                       )                                       VALUES                                       (                                           @MH,                                           @_LOTOK,                                           @_SLOK,                                           @_SLCONLAI,                                           @_SLOK - @_SLCONLAI,                                           N'Không đủ tồn kho ban đầu'                                       );                               END;                           END;                       END                       ELSE                       BEGIN                              ----------------------------------------------------                           -- FORMAT LOT-SL KHÔNG HỢP LỆ      ----------------------------------------------------                           INSERT INTO #STNG                           (                               MH,                               LOT,                               SLCAN,                               SLCO,                               SLTHIEU,                               STATUS                           )                           VALUES                           (                               @MH,                               @_LOTSL_Tach,                               0,                               0,                               0,                               N'Định dạng chuỗi LOT-SL không hợp lệ'                           );               END;                  FETCH NEXT FROM PGH               INTO @STT, @_LOT, @MH;           END;              CLOSE PGH;           DEALLOCATE PGH;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 7. KIỂM TRA TỔNG SL CẦN XUẤT VS TỒN           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #TMPUPDATE               WHERE STATUS = 'OK'           )           BEGIN                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SUM(SOLUONG) AS TONG_CAN_XUAT               INTO #GomNhomCheck               FROM #TMPUPDATE T             WHERE T.STATUS = 'OK'               AND NOT EXISTS               (                   SELECT 1                   FROM #STNG E                   WHERE RTRIM(E.MH) = RTRIM(T.MH)                     AND RTRIM(E.LOT) = RTRIM(T.LOT)               )             GROUP BY                 MH,                 LOT;                  ------------------------------------------------------------             -- Aggregate STOCKTP once (not once per delivery line).             --             -- The previous form LEFT JOINed the aggregate with an ON clause that             -- contained OR plus a correlated COUNT(DISTINCT ...) over STOCKTP. NẾU CÓ LỖI → KHÔNG UPDATE STOCK           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #STNG           )           BEGIN               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                -- Roll back this procedure's work before returning business errors.             -- A doomed caller transaction must be rolled back by its owner.             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @SavepointCreated = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = -1                 THROW 51034, N'Giao dịch bên ngoài đã ở trạng thái không thể commit; bên gọi phải ROLLBACK transaction.', 1;              RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 9. KHÔNG CÓ DỮ LIỆU UPDATE           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF NOT EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #TMPUPDATE               WHERE STT NOT IN               (                   SELECT DISTINCT STT                   FROM #STNG               )           )           BEGIN               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                -- No stock rows are eligible: release this invocation's savepoint             -- and transaction-owned application locks before returning.             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @SavepointCreated = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = -1                 THROW 51034, N'Giao dịch bên ngoài đã ở trạng thái không thể commit; bên gọi phải ROLLBACK transaction.', 1;              RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 10. TRANSACTION           ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- The transaction/savepoint was established before the duplicate check;         -- all stock writes below remain inside that same transaction scope.            DECLARE UPDATETMP CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #TMPUPDATE               WHERE STT NOT IN               (                   SELECT DISTINCT STT                   FROM #STNG               );              OPEN UPDATETMP;              FETCH NEXT FROM UPDATETMP           INTO @_STTUD, @_LOTUD, @_SLUD, @_STUP;              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0           BEGIN                  SET @LotThuc = NULL;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 10.1. TÌM LOT VẬT LÝ THẬT               --               -- Input:               --     @_LOTUD = 2609100101410               --               -- STOCKTP:               --     26091001014100861700               --               -- Match:               --     LEFT(LOT,13) = LEFT(@_LOTUD,13)               --               -- Sau khi tìm được mới UPDATE WHERE LOT = @LotThuc.               ----------------------------------------------------------------               IF LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTUD)) > 13             BEGIN                 -- Lock the exact physical LOT while choosing it. Different delivery                 -- identities can still compete for this same stock row.                 SELECT @LotThuc = LOT                 FROM STOCKTP WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK)                 WHERE RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTUD)                   AND ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) >= @_SLUD;             END             ELSE IF (                 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT))                 FROM STOCKTP WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTUD), 13)             ) = 1             BEGIN                 SELECT TOP (1) @LotThuc = LOT                 FROM STOCKTP WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK)                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTUD), 13)                   AND ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) >= @_SLUD                 ORDER BY NGAYNHAP ASC, LOT ASC;             END                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 10.2. Không tìm được LOT vật lý               ----------------------------------------------------------------               IF @LotThuc IS NULL               BEGIN                   INSERT INTO #STNG                   (                       MH,                       LOT,                       SLCAN,                       SLCO,                       SLTHIEU,                       STATUS                   )                   VALUES                   (                       @MH,                       @_LOTUD,                       @_SLUD,                       0,                       @_SLUD,                       N'Không xác định được LOT tồn kho hợp lệ khi trừ kho'                   );               END               ELSE               BEGIN                      ----------------------------------------------------------------                   -- 10.3. UPDATE ĐÚNG LOT VẬT LÝ                   ----------------------------------------------------------------                   UPDATE STOCKTP                 SET                     SLCONLAI = ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) - @_SLUD,                     SLXUAT = ISNULL(SLXUAT, 0) + @_SLUD,                     NGAYXUAT = CASE                         WHEN @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = N'FIFO_SP' THEN GETDATE()                         ELSE NGAYXUAT                     END                 WHERE LOT = @LotThuc                   AND ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) >= @_SLUD;                  SET @StockRowsUpdated = @@ROWCOUNT;                  IF @StockRowsUpdated <> 1                 BEGIN                     INSERT INTO #STNG (MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)                     VALUES                     (                         @MH,                         @_LOTUD,                         @_SLUD,                         ISNULL((SELECT SLCONLAI FROM STOCKTP WHERE LOT = @LotThuc), 0),                         @_SLUD - ISNULL((SELECT SLCONLAI FROM STOCKTP WHERE LOT = @LotThuc), 0),                         N'Tồn kho LOT đã thay đổi trong lúc xác nhận giao; vui lòng thử lại'                     );                 END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     ----------------------------------------------------------------                     -- 10.4. LƯU LOT VẬT LÝ THẬT CHỈ KHI ĐÃ TRỪ ĐÚNG MỘT DÒNG                     ----------------------------------------------------------------                     IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #STOK WHERE STT = @_STTUD)                     BEGIN                         INSERT INTO #STOK (STT, LOT, SOLUONG, STATUS)                         VALUES (@_STTUD, @LotThuc, @_SLUD, 'OK');                     END;                 END;               END;                  FETCH NEXT FROM UPDATETMP               INTO @_STTUD, @_LOTUD, @_SLUD, @_STUP;           END;              CLOSE UPDATETMP;           DEALLOCATE UPDATETMP;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 11. KIỂM TRA LỖI PHÁT SINH TRONG TRANSACTION           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS         (             SELECT 1             FROM #STNG         )         BEGIN             -- Preserve business diagnostics across rollback. The temp-table writes             -- are transactional, but the table variable snapshot survives rollback.             DECLARE @ErrorSnapshot TABLE             (                 MH NVARCHAR(100),                 LOT NVARCHAR(MAX),                 SLCAN INT,                 SLCO INT,                 SLTHIEU INT,                 STATUS NVARCHAR(500)             );              INSERT INTO @ErrorSnapshot(MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)             SELECT MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS             FROM #STNG;              IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;              INSERT INTO #STNG(MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)             SELECT MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS             FROM @ErrorSnapshot;                SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                  RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 12. LƯU LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #STOK               WHERE STATUS = 'OK'           )           BEGIN                  -- PO_NO / PO_ITEM: chi sao chep khi bang TMP cua khach hang co cot nay             -- (HVN MP/SP, 100003). Tranh mat PO trong ledger ma khong vo bang khong co cot.             DECLARE @LuuPoCols NVARCHAR(100) = N'', @LuuPoSel NVARCHAR(200) = N'';             IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.' + @TMPTABLE, N'PO_NO') IS NOT NULL                 SELECT @LuuPoCols += N', PO_NO', @LuuPoSel += N', LEFT(tmp.PO_NO, 50)';             IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.' + @TMPTABLE, N'PO_ITEM') IS NOT NULL                 SELECT @LuuPoCols += N', PO_ITEM', @LuuPoSel += N', LEFT(tmp.PO_ITEM, 50)';              SET @sql = N'                   INSERT INTO LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                   (                       STT,                       CUA,                       TRUYEN,                       MAHANG,                       TENHANG,                       LOT,                       DV,                       SOLUONG,                       NGAYGIAO,                       GIOGIAO,                       STATUS,                       TTPHIEU,                       NHAMAY,                       GIOGIAOFCC,                       HOP,                       STATUSDOC,                       Note' + @LuuPoCols + N'                   )                   SELECT                       tmp.STT,                       LEFT(tmp.CUA, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.TRUYEN, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.MAHANG, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.TENHANG, 60),                       LEFT(tmp.LOT, 500),                       LEFT(tmp.DV, 50),                       tmp.SOLUONG,                       tmp.NGAYGIAO,                       LEFT(tmp.GIOGIAO, 50),                       ''OK'',                       LEFT(tmp.TTPHIEU, 50),                       LEFT(@NHAMAY, 60),                       LEFT(@GIOGIAOFCC, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.HOP, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.STATUSDOC, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.Note, 250)' + @LuuPoSel + N'                   FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] tmp                   WHERE tmp.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   );               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'@NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250),                     @GIOGIAOFCC NVARCHAR(250)',                   @NHAMAY,                   @GIOGIAOFCC;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 13. LƯU LUUDOCQRCODE               ----------------------------------------------------------------               SET @sql = N'                   INSERT INTO LUUDOCQRCODE                   (                       LOTFCC,                       MAHANGFCC,                       SLTEMFCC,                       LOTHVN,                       MAHANGHVN,                       SLTEMHVN,                       STATUS,                       MAFCC,                       STT,                       KETQUA,                       NGAYXUAT,                       GIOXUAT,                       NHAMAY                   )                   SELECT                       LEFT(DQ.LOTFCC, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGFCC, 60),                      DQ.SLTEMFCC,                       LEFT(DQ.LOTHVN, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGHVN, 60),                       DQ.SLTEMHVN,                       DQ.STATUS,                       LEFT(DQ.MAFCC, 50),                       DQ.STT,                       LEFT(DQ.KETQUA, 30),                       PG.NGAYGIAO,                       LEFT(@GIOGIAOFCC, 30),                       LEFT(@NHAMAY, 60)                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON PG.STT =                          TRY_CAST(DQ.GIO AS INT)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') <> '''';                      INSERT INTO LUUDOCQRCODE                   (                       LOTFCC,                       MAHANGFCC,                       SLTEMFCC,                       LOTHVN,                       MAHANGHVN,                       SLTEMHVN,                       STATUS,                       MAFCC,                       STT,                       KETQUA,                       NGAYXUAT,                       GIOXUAT,                       NHAMAY                   )                   SELECT                       LEFT(DQ.LOTFCC, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGFCC, 60),                       DQ.SLTEMFCC,                       LEFT(DQ.LOTHVN, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGHVN, 60),                       DQ.SLTEMHVN,                       DQ.STATUS,                       LEFT(DQ.MAFCC, 50),                       DQ.STT,                       LEFT(DQ.KETQUA, 30),                       PG.NGAYGIAO,                       LEFT(@GIOGIAOFCC, 30),                       LEFT(@NHAMAY, 60)                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON RTRIM(DQ.MAHANGFCC) =                          RTRIM(PG.MAHANG)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') = '''';               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'                     @GIOGIAOFCC NVARCHAR(250),                     @NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250)',                   @GIOGIAOFCC,                   @NHAMAY;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 14. UPDATE TMP STATUS               ----------------------------------------------------------------               SET @sql = N'                   UPDATE [' + @TMPTABLE + N']                   SET STATUS = ''OK''                   WHERE STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   );               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql @sql;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 15. DELETE DOCQRCODE ĐÃ XỬ LÝ               ----------------------------------------------------------------               SET @sql = N'                   DELETE DQ                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON PG.STT =                          TRY_CAST(DQ.GIO AS INT)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') <> '''';                      DELETE DQ                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON RTRIM(DQ.MAHANGFCC) =                          RTRIM(PG.MAHANG)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') = '''';               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql @sql;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------             -- 16. END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 18. COMMIT           ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- Only commit a transaction opened by this procedure. If a caller owns         -- the transaction, leave final commit/rollback to the caller.         IF @StartedTransaction = 1             COMMIT TRANSACTION;        END TRY       BEGIN CATCH              IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0         BEGIN             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;               DEALLOCATE PGH;           END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'UPDATETMP') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE UPDATETMP;               DEALLOCATE UPDATETMP;           END;              IF @ErrMH IS NOT NULL         BEGIN             SELECT @ErrTon = SUM(ISNULL(s.SLCONLAI, 0))             FROM STOCKTP s             WHERE COALESCE(                     NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.SP)), N''),                     NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.PART)), N'')                   ) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@ErrMH))               AND ISNULL(s.SLCONLAI, 0) > 0;      END CATCH;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 19. TRẢ KẾT QUẢ       --------------------------------------------------------------------       SELECT           STT,           LOT,           SOLUONG,           STATUS       FROM #STOK;          SELECT           MH,           LOT,           SLCAN AS SLC,           SLCO AS SLTK,           SLTHIEU AS SLT,           STATUS       FROM #STNG;      END;

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_Update_Stock2405]       @GIOGIAOFCC  NVARCHAR(250) = N'',       @NHAMAY      NVARCHAR(250) = N'',       @TMPTABLE    NVARCHAR(128) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',       @DOCQRTABLE  NVARCHAR(128) = N'DOCQRCODE'   AS   BEGIN       SET NOCOUNT ON;          /*           ================================================================           QUY ƯỚC LOT           ================================================================              STOCKTP.LOT đầy đủ là định danh chính xác của LOT vật lý.          - Nếu đầu vào dài hơn 13 ký tự: chỉ khớp RTRIM(STOCKTP.LOT) = RTRIM(@LOT).         - Nếu đầu vào chỉ có mã gốc 13 ký tự: chỉ chấp nhận khi mã gốc ánh xạ tới           đúng một LOT vật lý; nếu có nhiều LOT vật lý thì ghi lỗi và dừng trước           mọi cập nhật tồn.         - Tuyệt đối không cộng tồn của nhiều LOT vật lý theo tiền tố rồi trừ một           LOT bất kỳ. Kiểm tra khả dụng và bước trừ kho phải dùng cùng quy tắc.     */          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 1. WHITELIST TÊN BẢNG       --------------------------------------------------------------------       IF @TMPTABLE NOT IN       (           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_SP',           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100003'       )       BEGIN           RAISERROR(               N'Tên bảng TMPTABLE không hợp lệ: %s',               16,               1,               @TMPTABLE           );           RETURN;       END;          IF @DOCQRTABLE NOT IN       (           N'DOCQRCODE',           N'DOCQRCODE_SP',           N'DOCQRCODE_100003'       )       BEGIN           RAISERROR(               N'Tên bảng DOCQRTABLE không hợp lệ: %s',               16,               1,               @DOCQRTABLE           );           RETURN;       END;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 2. KHAI BÁO BIẾN       --------------------------------------------------------------------       DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);     DECLARE @StartedTransaction BIT = 0;     DECLARE @SavepointCreated BIT = 0;          DECLARE           @_LOT          NVARCHAR(MAX),           @_SLCONLAI     INT,           @STT           INT,           @MH            NVARCHAR(60),           @_LOTSL_Tach   NVARCHAR(500),           @_LOTOK        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLOK         INT,           @_KTPC         INT,           @_LOTUD        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLUD         INT,           @_STTUD        INT,           @_STUP         NVARCHAR(15),           @LotThuc       NVARCHAR(500),         @LockResource  NVARCHAR(255),         @LockResult    INT,         @StockRowsUpdated INT;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 3. XÓA TEMP TABLE CŨ       --------------------------------------------------------------------       IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#TMPUPDATE') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #TMPUPDATE;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STOK') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #STOK;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STNG') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #STNG;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#PHIEU') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #PHIEU;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#GomNhomCheck') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #GomNhomCheck;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SplitResult') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #SplitResult;        IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#StockByLot') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #StockByLot;      IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#LotKeyCount') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #LotKeyCount;        --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 4. TEMP TABLE       --------------------------------------------------------------------       CREATE TABLE #TMPUPDATE       (           STT     INT,           MH      NVARCHAR(60),           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STOK       (           STT     INT,           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STNG       (           MH       NVARCHAR(100),           LOT      NVARCHAR(MAX),           SLCAN    INT,           SLCO     INT,           SLTHIEU  INT,           STATUS   NVARCHAR(500)       );          CREATE TABLE #PHIEU       (           STT INT,           LOT NVARCHAR(MAX),           MH  NVARCHAR(60)       );          BEGIN TRY          -- Own a transaction when called directly; otherwise participate in the         -- repository UnitOfWork through a savepoint. Start before the idempotency         -- check so concurrent confirmations serialize before reading/writing stock.         IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0         BEGIN             BEGIN TRANSACTION;             SET @StartedTransaction = 1;         END         ELSE         BEGIN             SAVE TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             SET @SavepointCreated = 1;         END;            ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 5. NẠP PHIẾU           ----------------------------------------------------------------           SET @sql = N'               INSERT INTO #PHIEU               (                   STT,                   LOT,                   MH               )               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   MAHANG               FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']               WHERE ISNULL(LOT, '''') <> ''''                 AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);           ';              EXEC sp_executesql @sql;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- Không có phiếu           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #PHIEU)           BEGIN             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 COMMIT TRANSACTION;                SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 6.
