IF @StartedTransaction = 1             COMMIT TRANSACTION;        END TRY       BEGIN CATCH              IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0         BEGIN             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @SavepointCreated = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = -1                 THROW; -- the caller must roll back the doomed outer transaction         END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'LOT_IN_PGH') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE LOT_IN_PGH;               DEALLOCATE LOT_IN_PGH;           END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'PGH') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE PGH;               DEALLOCATE PGH;           END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'UPDATETMP') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE UPDATETMP;               DEALLOCATE UPDATETMP;           END;              INSERT INTO #STNG           (               MH,               LOT,               SLCAN,               SLCO,               SLTHIEU,               STATUS           )           VALUES           (               N'SYSTEM ERROR',               N'Line ' +                   CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10)),               0,               0,               0,               LEFT               (                   N'Lỗi dòng ' +                   CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10)) +                   N': ' +                   ERROR_MESSAGE(),                   500               )           );          END CATCH;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 19. TRẢ KẾT QUẢ       --------------------------------------------------------------------       SELECT           STT,           LOT,           SOLUONG,           STATUS       FROM #STOK;          SELECT           MH,           LOT,           SLCAN AS SLC,           SLCO AS SLTK,           SLTHIEU AS SLT,           STATUS       FROM #STNG;      END;

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_Update_Stock2405]       @GIOGIAOFCC  NVARCHAR(250) = N'',       @NHAMAY      NVARCHAR(250) = N'',       @TMPTABLE    NVARCHAR(128) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',       @DOCQRTABLE  NVARCHAR(128) = N'DOCQRCODE',     @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NVARCHAR(20) = N'INPUT'   AS   BEGIN       SET NOCOUNT ON;          /*           ================================================================           QUY ƯỚC LOT           ================================================================              STOCKTP.LOT đầy đủ là định danh chính xác của LOT vật lý.          - Nếu đầu vào dài hơn 13 ký tự: chỉ khớp RTRIM(STOCKTP.LOT) = RTRIM(@LOT).         - Nếu đầu vào chỉ có mã gốc 13 ký tự: chỉ chấp nhận khi mã gốc ánh xạ tới           đúng một LOT vật lý; nếu có nhiều LOT vật lý thì ghi lỗi và dừng trước           mọi cập nhật tồn.         - Tuyệt đối không cộng tồn của nhiều LOT vật lý theo tiền tố rồi trừ một           LOT bất kỳ. Kiểm tra khả dụng và bước trừ kho phải dùng cùng quy tắc.     */          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 1. WHITELIST TÊN BẢNG       --------------------------------------------------------------------       IF @TMPTABLE NOT IN       (           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_SP',         N'SP_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100002',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100003'       )       BEGIN           RAISERROR(               N'Tên bảng TMPTABLE không hợp lệ: %s',               16,               1,               @TMPTABLE           );           RETURN;       END;          IF @DOCQRTABLE NOT IN       (           N'DOCQRCODE',           N'DOCQRCODE_SP',         N'SP_DOCQRCODE',         N'YMVN_DOCQRCODE',         N'DOCQRCODE_100002',         N'DOCQRCODE_100003'       )       BEGIN           RAISERROR(               N'Tên bảng DOCQRTABLE không hợp lệ: %s',               16,               1,               @DOCQRTABLE           );           RETURN;       END;          IF @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NOT IN (N'INPUT', N'FIFO_SP')     BEGIN         RAISERROR(N'LOTRESOLUTIONMODE không hợp lệ: %s', 16, 1, @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE);         RETURN;     END;      --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 2. KHAI BÁO BIẾN       --------------------------------------------------------------------       DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);     DECLARE @StartedTransaction BIT = 0;     DECLARE @SavepointCreated BIT = 0;          DECLARE           @_LOT          NVARCHAR(MAX),           @_SLCONLAI     INT,           @STT           INT,           @MH            NVARCHAR(60),           @_LOTSL_Tach   NVARCHAR(500),           @_LOTOK        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLOK         INT,           @_KTPC         INT,           @_LOTUD        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLUD         INT,           @_STTUD        INT,           @_STUP         NVARCHAR(15),           @LotThuc       NVARCHAR(500),         @LockResource  NVARCHAR(255),         @LockResult    INT,         @StockRowsUpdated INT;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 3. XÓA TEMP TABLE CŨ       --------------------------------------------------------------------       IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#TMPUPDATE') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #TMPUPDATE;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STOK') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #STOK;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STNG') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #STNG;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#PHIEU') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #PHIEU;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#GomNhomCheck') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #GomNhomCheck;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SplitResult') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #SplitResult;        IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#StockByLot') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #StockByLot;      IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#LotKeyCount') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #LotKeyCount;        --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 4. TEMP TABLE       --------------------------------------------------------------------       CREATE TABLE #TMPUPDATE       (           STT     INT,           MH      NVARCHAR(60),           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STOK       (           STT     INT,           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STNG       (           MH       NVARCHAR(100),           LOT      NVARCHAR(MAX),           SLCAN    INT,           SLCO     INT,           SLTHIEU  INT,           STATUS   NVARCHAR(500)       );          CREATE TABLE #PHIEU       (           STT INT,           LOT NVARCHAR(MAX),           MH  NVARCHAR(60)       );          BEGIN TRY          -- Own a transaction when called directly; otherwise participate in the         -- repository UnitOfWork through a savepoint. Start before the idempotency         -- check so concurrent confirmations serialize before reading/writing stock.         IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0         BEGIN             BEGIN TRANSACTION;             SET @StartedTransaction = 1;         END         ELSE         BEGIN             SAVE TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             SET @SavepointCreated = 1;         END;            ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 5. NẠP PHIẾU           ----------------------------------------------------------------           SET @sql = N'               INSERT INTO #PHIEU               (                   STT,                   LOT,                   MH               )               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   MAHANG               FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']               WHERE (ISNULL(LOT, '''') <> '''' OR @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = N''FIFO_SP'')               AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);           ';              EXEC sp_executesql @sql,             N'@LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NVARCHAR(20)',             @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- Không có phiếu           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #PHIEU)           BEGIN             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 COMMIT TRANSACTION;                SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 6. DUYỆT PHIẾU           ----------------------------------------------------------------           DECLARE PGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   MH               FROM #PHIEU;              OPEN PGH;              FETCH NEXT FROM PGH           INTO @STT, @_LOT, @MH;              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0           BEGIN               DECLARE @DaTon BIT = 0;                  DECLARE @CheckResult TABLE               (                   Found INT               );                  ------------------------------------------------------------             -- 6.1. Serialize the complete delivery identity before checking for             -- an existing confirmation. The lock is transaction-owned and therefore             -- remains held through STOCKTP, ledger, and pending-delivery writes.             ------------------------------------------------------------             SET @LockResource = NULL;             SET @sql = N'                 SELECT @Resource =                     N''PCTP_DELIVERY:'' +                     CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64), HASHBYTES(''SHA2_256'', CONCAT(                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(MAHANG, N''''))), N''|'',                         ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS DATE), 23), N''''), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(CUA, N''''))), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(TRUYEN, N''''))), N''|'',                         ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), SOLUONG), N''''), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(GIOGIAO, N''''))), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(ISNULL(@NHAMAY, N''''), 50)))                     )), 2)                 FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']                 WHERE STT = @STT;';              EXEC sp_executesql                 @sql,                 N'@STT INT, @NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250), @Resource NVARCHAR(255) OUTPUT',                 @STT = @STT,                 @NHAMAY = @NHAMAY,                 @Resource = @LockResource OUTPUT;              IF @LockResource IS NULL                 RAISERROR(N'Không tạo được khóa chống xác nhận giao hàng trùng.', 16, 1);              EXEC @LockResult = sys.sp_getapplock                 @Resource = @LockResource,                 @LockMode = N'Exclusive',                 @LockOwner = N'Transaction',                 @LockTimeout = 10000;              IF @LockResult < 0                 RAISERROR(N'Không lấy được khóa xác nhận giao hàng; vui lòng thử lại.', 16, 1);              ------------------------------------------------------------             -- 6.1. KIỂM TRA PHIẾU ĐÃ LƯU             ------------------------------------------------------------             SET @sql = N'                   SELECT TOP 1 1                   FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] tmp                   INNER JOIN LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG luu                       ON RTRIM(luu.MAHANG) =                          RTRIM(tmp.MAHANG)                         AND CAST(luu.NGAYGIAO AS DATE) =                          CAST(tmp.NGAYGIAO AS DATE)                         AND RTRIM(luu.CUA) =                          RTRIM(tmp.CUA)                         AND RTRIM(luu.TRUYEN) =                          RTRIM(tmp.TRUYEN)                         AND luu.SOLUONG =                          tmp.SOLUONG                         AND RTRIM(luu.GIOGIAO) =                          RTRIM(tmp.GIOGIAO)                         AND RTRIM(luu.NHAMAY) =                          RTRIM(LEFT(@NHAMAY, 50))                      WHERE tmp.STT = @STT;               ';                  INSERT INTO @CheckResult               EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'@NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250), @STT INT',                   @NHAMAY,                   @STT;                  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @CheckResult)                   SET @DaTon = 1;                  DELETE FROM @CheckResult;                  ------------------------------------------------------------               -- 6.2. ĐÃ TỒN TẠI               ------------------------------------------------------------               IF @DaTon = 1               BEGIN                   INSERT INTO #STNG                   (                       MH,                       LOT,                       SLCAN,                       SLCO,                       SLTHIEU,                       STATUS                   )                   VALUES                   (                       @MH,                       @_LOT,                  0,                       0,                       0,                       N'Mã hàng này đã được lưu trước đó!'                   );               END               ELSE               BEGIN                      --------------------------------------------------------                    --------------------------------------------------------                 -- 6.2a. FIFO_SP: chọn một LOT vật lý đủ tồn trong cùng transaction.                 --------------------------------------------------------                 IF @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = N'FIFO_SP'                 BEGIN                     DECLARE @FifoLot NVARCHAR(500) = NULL;                     DECLARE @FifoQty INT = NULL;                      SET @sql = N'                         SELECT @Qty = TRY_CONVERT(INT, SOLUONG)                         FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)                         WHERE STT = @STT                           AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);                          SELECT TOP (1) @Lot = s.LOT                         FROM STOCKTP s WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK)                         WHERE COALESCE(                               NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.SP)), N''''),                               NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.PART)), N'''')                           ) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@MaHang))                           AND ISNULL(s.SLCONLAI, 0) >= @Qty                           AND LEN(ISNULL(s.LOT, N'''')) >= 7                           AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LEFT(s.LOT, 6), 12) IS NOT NULL                           AND SUBSTRING(s.LOT, 7, 1) IN (N''0'', N''1'', N''2'', N''3'')                         ORDER BY LEFT(s.LOT, 6) ASC,                             CASE SUBSTRING(s.LOT, 7, 1)                                 WHEN N''0'' THEN 0 WHEN N''1'' THEN 1                                 WHEN N''2'' THEN 2 WHEN N''3'' THEN 3                             END ASC, s.LOT ASC;';                      EXEC sp_executesql @sql,                         N'@STT INT, @MaHang NVARCHAR(60), @Qty INT OUTPUT, @Lot NVARCHAR(500) OUTPUT',                         @STT=@STT, @MaHang=@MH,                         @Qty=@FifoQty OUTPUT, @Lot=@FifoLot OUTPUT;                      IF @FifoQty IS NULL OR @FifoQty <= 0                         THROW 51035, N'Số lượng giao SP phải lớn hơn 0.', 1;                     IF @FifoLot IS NULL                         THROW 51036, N'Không tìm được một LOT FIFO đủ tồn cho mã hàng SP.', 1;                      SET @_LOT = @FifoLot + N'-' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @FifoQty);                     DECLARE @FifoTmpRows INT = 0;                     SET @sql = N'UPDATE [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] SET LOT=@Lot                                  WHERE STT=@STT AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);                                  SET @Rows = @@ROWCOUNT;';                     EXEC sp_executesql @sql,                         N'@STT INT, @Lot NVARCHAR(500), @Rows INT OUTPUT',                         @STT=@STT, @Lot=@FifoLot, @Rows=@FifoTmpRows OUTPUT;                     IF @FifoTmpRows <> 1                         THROW 51037, N'Phiếu TMP đã thay đổi; không thể gán LOT FIFO.', 1;                 END;                  -- 6.3. TÁCH LOT-SL                   --------------------------------------------------------                   IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SplitResult') IS NOT NULL                       DROP TABLE #SplitResult;                      CREATE TABLE #SplitResult                   (                       LotTach NVARCHAR(500)                   );                      INSERT INTO #SplitResult                   SELECT *                   FROM dbo.Split(@_LOT, ',');                      DECLARE LOT_IN_PGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                       SELECT LotTach                       FROM #SplitResult;                      OPEN LOT_IN_PGH;                      FETCH NEXT FROM LOT_IN_PGH                   INTO @_LOTSL_Tach;                      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                   BEGIN                       ----------------------------------------------------                       -- 6.4. TÁCH LOT-SL                       ----------------------------------------------------                       SET @_KTPC =                           CHARINDEX('-', @_LOTSL_Tach);                          IF @_KTPC > 1                       BEGIN                           SET @_LOTOK =                               SUBSTRING(                                   @_LOTSL_Tach,                                   1,                                   @_KTPC - 1                               );                              SET @_SLOK =                               TRY_CAST(                                   RIGHT(                                       @_LOTSL_Tach,                                       LEN(@_LOTSL_Tach) - @_KTPC                                   )                                   AS INT                               );                              ------------------------------------------------                           -- SL không hợp lệ                           ------------------------------------------------                           IF @_SLOK IS NULL                           BEGIN                               INSERT INTO #STNG                               (                                   MH,                                   LOT,                                   SLCAN,                                   SLCO,                                   SLTHIEU,                                   STATUS                               )                               VALUES                               (                                   @MH,                                   @_LOTSL_Tach,                                   0,                                   0,                                   0,                                   N'Số lượng trong chuỗi LOT-SL không hợp lệ'                               );                           END                           ELSE                           BEGIN                                  ------------------------------------------------                               -- 6.5. TÌM TỒN THEO LOT KEY 13 KÝ TỰ                               ------------------------------------------------                               SET @_SLCONLAI = 0;                              -- Full physical LOT is the exact identity. A 13-character                             -- root is accepted only when it maps to one physical LOT.                             IF LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTOK)) > 13                             BEGIN                                 SELECT @_SLCONLAI = ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0)                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTOK);                             END                             ELSE IF (                                 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT))                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13)                             ) = 1                             BEGIN                                 SELECT TOP (1) @_SLCONLAI = ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0)                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13)                                 ORDER BY LOT ASC;                             END                             ELSE IF (                                 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT))                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13)                             ) > 1                             BEGIN                                 INSERT INTO #STNG(MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)                                 VALUES(@MH, @_LOTOK, @_SLOK, 0, @_SLOK,                                        N'Mã LOT gốc ánh xạ nhiều LOT vật lý; vui lòng cung cấp LOT đầy đủ');                             END;                                  ------------------------------------------------                               -- 6.6. KIỂM TRA LOT TỒN TẠI. Skip duplicate diagnostics if root is ambiguous.                             IF NOT EXISTS                             (                                 SELECT 1 FROM #STNG                                 WHERE RTRIM(MH) = RTRIM(@MH)                                   AND RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTOK)                                   AND STATUS = N'Mã LOT gốc ánh xạ nhiều LOT vật lý; vui lòng cung cấp LOT đầy đủ'                             )                             AND EXISTS                             (                                 SELECT 1                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE (LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTOK)) > 13 AND RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTOK))                                    OR (LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTOK)) <= 13 AND LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13))                             )                             BEGIN                                      ------------------------------------------------                                   -- ĐỦ TỒN                                   ------------------------------------------------                                   IF @_SLCONLAI >= @_SLOK                                   BEGIN                                       INSERT INTO #TMPUPDATE                                       (                                           STT,                                           MH,                                           LOT,                                           SOLUONG,                                           STATUS                                       )                                       VALUES                                       (                                           @STT,                                           @MH,                                           @_LOTOK,                                           @_SLOK,                                           'OK'                                       );                                   END                                   ELSE                                   BEGIN                                          ------------------------------------------------                                       -- KHÔNG ĐỦ TỒN                                       ------------------------------------------------                                       INSERT INTO #STNG                                       (                                           MH,                                           LOT,                                           SLCAN,                                           SLCO,                                           SLTHIEU,                                           STATUS                                       )                                       VALUES                                       (                                           @MH,                                           @_LOTOK,                                           @_SLOK,                                           @_SLCONLAI,                                           @_SLOK - @_SLCONLAI,                                           N'Không đủ tồn kho ban đầu'                                       );                                   END;                               END                               ELSE                               BEGIN                                      ------------------------------------------------                                   -- KHÔNG TỒN TẠI LOT                                   ------------------------------------------------                                   INSERT INTO #STNG                                   (                                       MH,                                       LOT,                                       SLCAN,                                       SLCO,                                       SLTHIEU,                                       STATUS                                   )                                   VALUES                                   (                                       @MH,                                       @_LOTOK,                                       @_SLOK,                                       0,                                       @_SLOK,                                       N'Không tồn tại LOT trong STOCKTP'                                   );                               END;                           END;                       END                       ELSE                       BEGIN                              ----------------------------------------------------                           -- FORMAT LOT-SL KHÔNG HỢP LỆ      ----------------------------------------------------                           INSERT INTO #STNG                           (                               MH,                               LOT,                               SLCAN,                               SLCO,                               SLTHIEU,                               STATUS                           )                           VALUES                           (                               @MH,                               @_LOTSL_Tach,                               0,                               0,                               0,                               N'Định dạng chuỗi LOT-SL không hợp lệ'                           );                       END;                          FETCH NEXT FROM LOT_IN_PGH                       INTO @_LOTSL_Tach;                   END;                      CLOSE LOT_IN_PGH;                   DEALLOCATE LOT_IN_PGH;               END;                  FETCH NEXT FROM PGH               INTO @STT, @_LOT, @MH;           END;              CLOSE PGH;           DEALLOCATE PGH;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 7. KIỂM TRA TỔNG SL CẦN XUẤT VS TỒN           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #TMPUPDATE               WHERE STATUS = 'OK'           )           BEGIN                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SUM(SOLUONG) AS TONG_CAN_XUAT               INTO #GomNhomCheck               FROM #TMPUPDATE T             WHERE T.STATUS = 'OK'               AND NOT EXISTS               (                   SELECT 1                   FROM #STNG E                   WHERE RTRIM(E.MH) = RTRIM(T.MH)                     AND RTRIM(E.LOT) = RTRIM(T.LOT)               )             GROUP BY                 MH,                 LOT;                  ------------------------------------------------------------             -- Aggregate STOCKTP once (not once per delivery line).             --             -- The previous form LEFT JOINed the aggregate with an ON clause that             -- contained OR plus a correlated COUNT(DISTINCT ...) over STOCKTP. SQL             -- Server could not hash/merge-join it, so it compared every delivery             -- line with every physical LOT and re-ran that sub-query each time             -- (minutes on ~66k STOCKTP rows). Same rules, computed once:             --   * input LOT longer than 13 chars -> exact physical LOT only;             --   * 13-char root -> only when it maps to exactly ONE physical LOT             --     in all of STOCKTP (counted without the SLCONLAI > 0 filter).             ------------------------------------------------------------             SELECT                 RTRIM(LOT) AS PhysicalLot,                 LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) AS LotKey,                 SUM(ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0)) AS SLCONLAI             INTO #StockByLot             FROM STOCKTP             WHERE ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) > 0             GROUP BY RTRIM(LOT), LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13);              CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockByLot_PhysicalLot ON #StockByLot(PhysicalLot);             CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockByLot_LotKey ON #StockByLot(LotKey);              SELECT                 LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) AS LotKey,                 COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT)) AS PhysicalLotCount             INTO #LotKeyCount             FROM STOCKTP             GROUP BY LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13);              CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_LotKeyCount_LotKey ON #LotKeyCount(LotKey);              INSERT INTO #STNG             (                 MH,                 LOT,                 SLCAN,                 SLCO,                 SLTHIEU,                 STATUS             )             SELECT                 G.MH,                 G.LOT,                 G.TONG_CAN_XUAT,                 X.SLCONLAI,                 G.TONG_CAN_XUAT - X.SLCONLAI,                 N'Không đủ tồn kho (kiểm tra lần 2)'             FROM #GomNhomCheck G             CROSS APPLY             (                 SELECT ISNULL(                     CASE                         WHEN LEN(RTRIM(G.LOT)) > 13                             THEN (SELECT SUM(S.SLCONLAI)                                   FROM #StockByLot S                                   WHERE S.PhysicalLot = RTRIM(G.LOT))                         WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1                                      FROM #LotKeyCount K                                      WHERE K.LotKey = LEFT(RTRIM(G.LOT), 13)                                        AND K.PhysicalLotCount = 1)                             THEN (SELECT SUM(S.SLCONLAI)                                   FROM #StockByLot S                                   WHERE S.LotKey = LEFT(RTRIM(G.LOT), 13))                     END, 0) AS SLCONLAI             ) X             WHERE                 X.SLCONLAI -                 G.TONG_CAN_XUAT < 0;              DROP TABLE #StockByLot;             DROP TABLE #LotKeyCount;                DROP TABLE #GomNhomCheck;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 8. NẾU CÓ LỖI → KHÔNG UPDATE STOCK           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #STNG           )           BEGIN               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                -- Roll back this procedure's work before returning business errors.             -- A doomed caller transaction must be rolled back by its owner.             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @SavepointCreated = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = -1                 THROW 51034, N'Giao dịch bên ngoài đã ở trạng thái không thể commit; bên gọi phải ROLLBACK transaction.', 1;              RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 9. KHÔNG CÓ DỮ LIỆU UPDATE           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF NOT EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #TMPUPDATE               WHERE STT NOT IN               (                   SELECT DISTINCT STT                   FROM #STNG               )           )           BEGIN               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                -- No stock rows are eligible: release this invocation's savepoint             -- and transaction-owned application locks before returning.             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @SavepointCreated = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = -1                 THROW 51034, N'Giao dịch bên ngoài đã ở trạng thái không thể commit; bên gọi phải ROLLBACK transaction.', 1;              RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 10. TRANSACTION           ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- The transaction/savepoint was established before the duplicate check;         -- all stock writes below remain inside that same transaction scope.            DECLARE UPDATETMP CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #TMPUPDATE               WHERE STT NOT IN               (                   SELECT DISTINCT STT                   FROM #STNG               );              OPEN UPDATETMP;              FETCH NEXT FROM UPDATETMP           INTO @_STTUD, @_LOTUD, @_SLUD, @_STUP;              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0           BEGIN                  SET @LotThuc = NULL;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 10.1. TÌM LOT VẬT LÝ THẬT               --               -- Input:               --     @_LOTUD = 2609100101410               --               -- STOCKTP:               --     26091001014100861700               --               -- Match:               --     LEFT(LOT,13) = LEFT(@_LOTUD,13)               --               -- Sau khi tìm được mới UPDATE WHERE LOT = @LotThuc.               ----------------------------------------------------------------               IF LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTUD)) > 13             BEGIN                 -- Lock the exact physical LOT while choosing it. Different delivery                 -- identities can still compete for this same stock row. LƯU LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #STOK               WHERE STATUS = 'OK'           )           BEGIN                  -- PO_NO / PO_ITEM: chi sao chep khi bang TMP cua khach hang co cot nay             -- (HVN MP/SP, 100003).               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'@NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250),                     @GIOGIAOFCC NVARCHAR(250)',                   @NHAMAY,                   @GIOGIAOFCC;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 13. LƯU LUUDOCQRCODE               ----------------------------------------------------------------               SET @sql = N'                   INSERT INTO LUUDOCQRCODE                   (                       LOTFCC,                       MAHANGFCC,                       SLTEMFCC,                       LOTHVN,                       MAHANGHVN,                       SLTEMHVN,                       STATUS,                       MAFCC,                       STT,                       KETQUA,                       NGAYXUAT,                       GIOXUAT,                       NHAMAY                   )                   SELECT                       LEFT(DQ.LOTFCC, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGFCC, 60),                      DQ.SLTEMFCC,                       LEFT(DQ.LOTHVN, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGHVN, 60),                       DQ.SLTEMHVN,                       DQ.STATUS,                       LEFT(DQ.MAFCC, 50),                       DQ.STT,                       LEFT(DQ.KETQUA, 30),                       PG.NGAYGIAO,                       LEFT(@GIOGIAOFCC, 30),                       LEFT(@NHAMAY, 60)                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON PG.STT =                          TRY_CAST(DQ.GIO AS INT)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') <> '''';                      INSERT INTO LUUDOCQRCODE                   (                       LOTFCC,                       MAHANGFCC,                       SLTEMFCC,                       LOTHVN,                       MAHANGHVN,                       SLTEMHVN,                       STATUS,                       MAFCC,                       STT,                       KETQUA,                       NGAYXUAT,                       GIOXUAT,                       NHAMAY                   )                   SELECT                       LEFT(DQ.LOTFCC, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGFCC, 60),                       DQ.SLTEMFCC,                       LEFT(DQ.LOTHVN, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGHVN, 60),                       DQ.SLTEMHVN,                       DQ.STATUS,                       LEFT(DQ.MAFCC, 50),                       DQ.STT,                       LEFT(DQ.KETQUA, 30),                       PG.NGAYGIAO,                       LEFT(@GIOGIAOFCC, 30),                       LEFT(@NHAMAY, 60)                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON RTRIM(DQ.MAHANGFCC) =                          RTRIM(PG.MAHANG)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') = '''';               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'                     @GIOGIAOFCC NVARCHAR(250),                     @NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250)',                   @GIOGIAOFCC,                   @NHAMAY;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 14. UPDATE TMP STATUS               ----------------------------------------------------------------               SET @sql = N'                   UPDATE [' + @TMPTABLE + N']                   SET STATUS = ''OK''                   WHERE STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   );               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql @sql;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 15. END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 18. COMMIT           ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- Only commit a transaction opened by this procedure. If a caller owns         -- the transaction, leave final commit/rollback to the caller.         IF @StartedTransaction = 1             COMMIT TRANSACTION;        END TRY       BEGIN CATCH              IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0         BEGIN             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @SavepointCreated = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = -1                 THROW; -- the caller must roll back the doomed outer transaction         END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'LOT_IN_PGH') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE LOT_IN_PGH;               DEALLOCATE LOT_IN_PGH;           END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'PGH') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE PGH;               DEALLOCATE PGH;           END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'UPDATETMP') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE UPDATETMP;               DEALLOCATE UPDATETMP;           END;              INSERT INTO #STNG           (               MH,               LOT,               SLCAN,               SLCO,               SLTHIEU,               STATUS           )           VALUES           (               N'SYSTEM ERROR',               N'Line ' +                   CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10)),               0,               0,               0,               LEFT               (                   N'Lỗi dòng ' +                   CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10)) +                   N': ' +                   ERROR_MESSAGE(),                   500               )           );          END CATCH;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 19. TRẢ KẾT QUẢ       --------------------------------------------------------------------       SELECT           STT,           LOT,           SOLUONG,           STATUS       FROM #STOK;          SELECT           MH,           LOT,           SLCAN AS SLC,           SLCO AS SLTK,           SLTHIEU AS SLT,           STATUS       FROM #STNG;      END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_BaoCao_DeliveryTrace (     @CustomerNo   nvarchar(20),     @CustomerName nvarchar(200) = NULL,     @FromDate     date,     @ToDate       date ) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SET XACT_ABORT ON;      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 1. VALIDATE     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     IF @CustomerNo NOT IN (N'100001', N'100002')     BEGIN         THROW 50001,               N'CustomerNo không được hỗ trợ. Chỉ hỗ trợ 100001 / 100002.',               1;     END;      IF @FromDate IS NULL OR @ToDate IS NULL     BEGIN         THROW 50002,               N'@FromDate và @ToDate không được NULL.',               1;     END;      IF @FromDate > @ToDate     BEGIN         THROW 50003,               N'@FromDate không được lớn hơn @ToDate.',               1;     END;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 2. CUSTOMER DISPLAY NAME     --     -- Application mapping:     --     -- 100001 -> HON DA - VIET NAM     -- 100002 -> YAMAHA - VIET NAM     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     DECLARE @CustomerDisplayName nvarchar(200);      SET @CustomerDisplayName =         CASE @CustomerNo             WHEN N'100001' THEN N'HON DA - VIET NAM'             WHEN N'100002' THEN N'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'         END;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 3. CUSTOMER FACTORY FILTER     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE TABLE #CustomerFactory     (         NhaMay nvarchar(200) NOT NULL             PRIMARY KEY     );      IF @CustomerNo = N'100001'     BEGIN         INSERT INTO #CustomerFactory         (             NhaMay         )         VALUES             (N'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY VP)'),             (N'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY HN)');     END     ELSE     BEGIN         INSERT INTO #CustomerFactory         (             NhaMay         )         VALUES             (N'YAMAHA - VIET NAM');     END;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 4. DELIVERY SOURCE     --     -- Normalize:     --     -- 01     -> 1     -- 001    -> 1     -- 0001   -> 1     -- J0663  -> J0663     -- 0J0663 -> J0663     --     -- KHÔNG TRY_CONVERT(INT)     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH DeliverySource AS     (         SELECT             P.STT,             P.CUA,             P.TRUYEN,             P.MAHANG,             P.TENHANG,             P.LOT,             P.DV,             P.SOLUONG,             P.NGAYGIAO,             P.GIOGIAO,             P.STATUS,             P.TTPHIEU,             P.NHAMAY,             P.GIOGIAOFCC,             P.GearYMVN,             P.HOP,             P.STATUSDOC,             P.Note,             P.TGLUU,             P.PO_NO,             P.PO_ITEM,              NormalizedGioGiao =                 CASE                     WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO)), N'') IS NULL                         THEN NULL                      WHEN PATINDEX                     (                         N'%[^0]%',                         LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO))                     ) = 0                         THEN N'0'                      ELSE SUBSTRING                     (                         LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO)),                         PATINDEX                         (                             N'%[^0]%',                             LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO))                         ),                         LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO)))                     )                 END          FROM dbo.LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG P          INNER JOIN #CustomerFactory CF             ON CF.NhaMay = P.NHAMAY          WHERE P.NGAYGIAO >= @FromDate           AND P.NGAYGIAO < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @ToDate)     ),      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 5. QR SOURCE     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     QrSource AS     (         SELECT             D.LOTFCC,             D.MAHANGFCC,             D.SLTEMFCC,              D.LOTHVN,             D.MAHANGHVN,             D.SLTEMHVN,              D.STATUS,             D.MAFCC,             D.STT,             D.KETQUA,              D.NGAYXUAT,             D.GIOXUAT,             D.NHAMAY,             D.GIOGIAO,              D.TGLUU,             D.TGLuuDuLieu,              NormalizedGioGiao =                 CASE                     WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO)), N'') IS NULL                         THEN NULL                      WHEN PATINDEX                     (                         N'%[^0]%',                         LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO))                     ) = 0                         THEN N'0'                      ELSE SUBSTRING                     (                         LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO)),                         PATINDEX                         (                             N'%[^0]%',                             LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO))                         ),                         LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO)))                     )                 END          FROM dbo.LUUDOCQRCODE D     ),      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 6. MATCH DELIVERY <-> QR     --     -- Common:     --     -- D.NHAMAY      = P.NHAMAY     -- D.MAHANGFCC   = P.MAHANG     -- D.NGAYXUAT    = P.NGAYGIAO     --     -- Honda:     -- D.GIOXUAT     = P.GIOGIAOFCC     --     -- Yamaha:     -- Normalize(D.GIOGIAO) = Normalize(P.CUA)     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     DeliveryMatched AS     (         SELECT             @CustomerNo AS CustomerNo,              @CustomerDisplayName AS CustomerName,              P.NHAMAY AS Factory,              P.STT AS PhieuSTT,              P.CUA,             P.TRUYEN,              P.MAHANG,             P.TENHANG,             P.LOT AS DeliveryLot,              P.DV,             P.SOLUONG AS DeliveryQuantity,              P.NGAYGIAO,             P.GIOGIAO,             P.GIOGIAOFCC,              P.GearYMVN,             P.HOP,              P.STATUS AS DeliveryStatus,             P.TTPHIEU,             P.STATUSDOC,             P.Note,              P.PO_NO,             P.PO_ITEM,              D.STT AS QrSTT,              D.MAFCC,              D.LOTFCC,             D.MAHANGFCC,             D.SLTEMFCC,              D.LOTHVN,             D.MAHANGHVN,             D.SLTEMHVN,              D.KETQUA AS QrKetQua,              D.NGAYXUAT,             D.GIOXUAT,             D.GIOGIAO AS QrGioGiao,              CONCAT             (                 P.NHAMAY,                 N'|',                 CONVERT(char(8), P.NGAYGIAO, 112),                 N'|',                 ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAOFCC)), N''),                 N'|',                 ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.CUA)), N''),                 N'|',                 CONVERT(nvarchar(50), P.SOLUONG)             ) AS DeliveryKey,              CASE                 WHEN @CustomerNo = N'100002'                     THEN N'YAMAHA: GIOGIAO = CUA'                 ELSE                     N'HONDA: GIOXUAT = GIOGIAOFCC'             END AS MatchType          FROM DeliverySource P          INNER JOIN QrSource D             ON D.NHAMAY = P.NHAMAY             AND D.MAHANGFCC = P.MAHANG             AND D.NGAYXUAT = P.NGAYGIAO             AND            (                 (                     @CustomerNo <> N'100002'                      AND                     LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOXUAT))                         =                     LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAOFCC))                 )                  OR                  (                     @CustomerNo = N'100002'                      AND                     D.NormalizedGioGiao                         =                     P.NormalizedGioGiao                 )            )     )      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 7. MATERIALIZE DELIVERY EVIDENCE     --     -- Không dùng CTE DeliveryMatched cho các statement phía sau.     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     SELECT         *     INTO #DeliveryEvidence     FROM DeliveryMatched;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 8. INDEX     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryEvidence_QrSTT         ON #DeliveryEvidence(QrSTT);      CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryEvidence_LotFCC         ON #DeliveryEvidence(LOTFCC);      CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryEvidence_LotHVN         ON #DeliveryEvidence(LOTHVN);      CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryEvidence_Item         ON #DeliveryEvidence(MAHANG);       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- RESULT SET #1     --     -- DELIVERY EVIDENCE     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     SELECT         CustomerNo,         CustomerName,         Factory,          DeliveryKey,          PhieuSTT,         CUA,         TRUYEN,          MAHANG,         TENHANG,         DeliveryLot,          DV,         DeliveryQuantity,          NGAYGIAO,         GIOGIAO,         GIOGIAOFCC,          GearYMVN,         HOP,          DeliveryStatus,         TTPHIEU,         STATUSDOC,         Note,          PO_NO,         PO_ITEM,          QrSTT,         MAFCC,          LOTFCC,         MAHANGFCC,         SLTEMFCC,          LOTHVN,         MAHANGHVN,         SLTEMHVN,          QrKetQua,          NGAYXUAT,         GIOXUAT,         QrGioGiao,          MatchType      FROM #DeliveryEvidence      ORDER BY         NGAYGIAO,         Factory,         MAHANG,         PhieuSTT,         QrSTT;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 9. DELIVERY LOTS     --     -- Một dòng QR có thể có:     --     -- LOTFCC =     --     -- LotA-160,     -- LotB-30,     -- LotC-160     --     -- Phải tách thành:     --     -- LotA     -- LotB     -- LotC     --     -- Lot13 = LEFT(token, 13)     --     -- KHÔNG dùng PRIMARY KEY chứa nullable columns.     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE TABLE #DeliveryLots     (         Lot13 nvarchar(13) NOT NULL,          ItemCode nvarchar(100) NULL,          CustomerNo nvarchar(20) NOT NULL,          CustomerName nvarchar(200) NOT NULL,          Factory nvarchar(200) NULL,          DeliveryKey nvarchar(500) NULL,          DeliveryQuantity int NULL,          NgayGiao date NULL,          PhieuSTT smallint NULL,          QrSTT smallint NULL     );       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 10. SPLIT LOTFCC     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH DeliveryLotSource AS     (         SELECT             D.CustomerNo,             D.CustomerName,             D.Factory,             D.DeliveryKey,             D.DeliveryQuantity,             D.NGAYGIAO,             D.PhieuSTT,             D.QrSTT,             D.MAHANG AS ItemCode,             D.LOTFCC AS LotList          FROM #DeliveryEvidence D          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(D.LOTFCC)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL          UNION ALL          ---------------------------------------------------------------------         -- 11. SPLIT LOTHVN         ---------------------------------------------------------------------         SELECT             D.CustomerNo,             D.CustomerName,             D.Factory,             D.DeliveryKey,             D.DeliveryQuantity,             D.NGAYGIAO,             D.PhieuSTT,             D.QrSTT,             D.MAHANG AS ItemCode,             D.LOTHVN AS LotList          FROM #DeliveryEvidence D          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(D.LOTHVN)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL     ),      DeliveryLotTokens AS     (         SELECT             S.CustomerNo,             S.CustomerName,             S.Factory,             S.DeliveryKey,             S.DeliveryQuantity,             S.NGAYGIAO,             S.PhieuSTT,             S.QrSTT,             S.ItemCode,              LTRIM(RTRIM(SS.value)) AS LotToken          FROM DeliveryLotSource S          CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT         (             S.LotList,             N','         ) SS          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(SS.value)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL     )      INSERT INTO #DeliveryLots     (         Lot13,         ItemCode,         CustomerNo,         CustomerName,         Factory,         DeliveryKey,         DeliveryQuantity,         NgayGiao,         PhieuSTT,         QrSTT     )     SELECT DISTINCT          LEFT(LotToken, 13) AS Lot13,          ItemCode,          CustomerNo,         CustomerName,         Factory,          DeliveryKey,          DeliveryQuantity,          NGAYGIAO,          PhieuSTT,         QrSTT      FROM DeliveryLotTokens      WHERE LEN(LotToken) >= 13;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 12. INDEX DELIVERY LOT     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryLots_Lot13         ON #DeliveryLots(Lot13);      CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryLots_ItemCode         ON #DeliveryLots(ItemCode);       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 13. STOCK HISTORY -> LOT13 MOVEMENT     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE TABLE #StockLotMovement     (         StockHistoryId bigint NOT NULL,          Lot13 nvarchar(13) NOT NULL,          SlotId int NULL,          FromSlotId int NULL,          ToSlotId int NULL,          ActionType nvarchar(100) NULL,          MovementQuantity int NULL,          MovementDate datetime NULL,          ItemCode nvarchar(100) NULL,          TemCode nvarchar(500) NULL,          MaPhieu nvarchar(100) NULL,          PerformedBy nvarchar(200) NULL,          QrData nvarchar(max) NULL     );       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 14. STOCK HISTORY LOT SPLIT     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH SHBase AS     (         SELECT             SH.Id,             SH.ActionType,             SH.ItemCode,             SH.TemCode,             SH.LotNo,             SH.Quantity,             SH.Date,             SH.SlotId,             SH.PerformedBy,             SH.QrData,             SH.MaPhieu,             SH.FromSlotId,             SH.ToSlotId          FROM dbo.StockHistory SH          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(SH.LotNo)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL     ),      SplitLot AS     (         SELECT             SH.*,              LTRIM(RTRIM(SS.value)) AS LotToken          FROM SHBase SH          CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT         (             SH.LotNo,             N','         ) SS          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(SS.value)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL     ),      Parsed AS     (         SELECT             S.*,              LEFT             (                 S.LotToken,                 13             ) AS LotRaw,              CASE                 WHEN CHARINDEX(N'-', S.LotToken) > 13                 THEN                     SUBSTRING                     (                         S.LotToken,                         CHARINDEX(N'-', S.LotToken) + 1,                         LEN(S.LotToken)                     )                 ELSE NULL             END AS QuantitySuffix          FROM SplitLot S     ),      ParsedQuantity AS     (         SELECT             P.*,              CASE                  -----------------------------------------------------------------                 -- LOT-160                 -----------------------------------------------------------------                 WHEN P.QuantitySuffix IS NOT NULL                       AND P.QuantitySuffix <> N''                       AND P.QuantitySuffix NOT LIKE N'%[^0-9]%'                  THEN TRY_CONVERT                 (                     int,                     P.QuantitySuffix                 )                  -----------------------------------------------------------------                 -- Chỉ có đúng một LOT trong StockHistory                 -----------------------------------------------------------------                 WHEN P.LotToken NOT LIKE N'%,%'                       AND P.Quantity IS NOT NULL                  THEN P.Quantity                  -----------------------------------------------------------------                 -- Nhiều LOT nhưng không có quantity suffix:                 -- Không được chia Quantity một cách võ đoán.                 -----------------------------------------------------------------                 ELSE NULL              END AS MovementQty          FROM Parsed P     )      INSERT INTO #StockLotMovement     (         StockHistoryId,         Lot13,          SlotId,         FromSlotId,         ToSlotId,          ActionType,          MovementQuantity,          MovementDate,          ItemCode,         TemCode,          MaPhieu,         PerformedBy,          QrData     )      SELECT         Id,          LotRaw,          SlotId,         FromSlotId,         ToSlotId,          ActionType,          MovementQty,          Date,          ItemCode,         TemCode,          MaPhieu,         PerformedBy,          QrData      FROM ParsedQuantity      WHERE LEN(LotRaw) = 13;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 15. INDEX STOCK MOVEMENT     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE INDEX IX_StockLotMovement_Lot13         ON #StockLotMovement(Lot13);      CREATE INDEX CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetCurrentStockStatus] AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      /*       Match physical LOT identity consistently with delivery confirmation:       full LOT (>13 chars) matches exactly; a 13-character root is accepted       only when it maps to one physical LOT. Multiple slot allocations for the       same physical LOT remain separate location rows.        Every LOT with SLCONLAI > 0 is always reported: the rows of one LOT add up       to STOCKTP.SLCONLAI. Quantity that is not covered by an active SlotLot row       (legacy / imported stock, or a partial put-away) is reported as one extra       row with LocationCode = N'Chua gan slot' so the report never silently       drops location information.        QrData is the full QR of the SlotLot row (falls back to the TemCode when       the QR text was not stored).     */     ;WITH StockLotKeys AS     (         SELECT             LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) AS LotKey,             COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT)) AS PhysicalLotCount         FROM dbo.STOCKTP         GROUP BY LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13)     ),     Slotted AS     (         SELECT             stp.LOT AS StockLot,             sl.ItemCode AS SlotItemCode,             sl.Quantity AS SlotQuantity,             sl.ImportDate AS SlotImportDate,             sl.MaPhieu AS SlotMaPhieu,             ISNULL(NULLIF(sl.QrData, N''), sl.TemCode) AS SlotQr,             CASE WHEN s.SlotId IS NOT NULL                  THEN w.Name + N'-' + r.RackName + N'-Slot' + CAST(s.SlotNumber AS NVARCHAR(20))                  ELSE NULL END AS SlotLocation,             r.RackName AS RackName,             s.SlotNumber AS SlotNumber,             w.Name AS WarehouseName         FROM dbo.STOCKTP AS stp         LEFT JOIN StockLotKeys AS lk             ON lk.LotKey = LEFT(RTRIM(stp.LOT), 13)         INNER JOIN dbo.SlotLot AS sl             ON sl.PhieuStatus = 0            AND            (                 (LEN(RTRIM(stp.LOT)) > 13 AND RTRIM(sl.LotNo) = RTRIM(stp.LOT))                 OR                 (LEN(RTRIM(stp.LOT)) <= 13                  AND lk.PhysicalLotCount = 1                  AND LEFT(RTRIM(sl.LotNo), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(stp.LOT), 13))            )         LEFT JOIN dbo.Slot AS s ON s.SlotId = sl.SlotId         LEFT JOIN dbo.Rack AS r ON r.RackId = s.RackId         LEFT JOIN dbo.Warehouse AS w ON w.WarehouseId = r.WarehouseId         WHERE ISNULL(stp.SLCONLAI, 0) > 0     ),     SlottedTotal AS     (         SELECT StockLot, SUM(SlotQuantity) AS SlotQty         FROM Slotted         GROUP BY StockLot     )     SELECT         u.ItemCode,         u.LotNo,         u.QrData,         u.Quantity,         u.LocationCode,         u.Status,         u.ItemName,         u.Model,         u.NgaySX,         u.CaSX,         u.SlSanXuat,         u.SlDaNhap,         u.SlDaXuat,         u.SlTonLot,         u.NgayNhap,         u.NgayXuat,         u.SlotImportDate,         u.SlotMaPhieu     FROM     (         SELECT             ISNULL(sd.SlotItemCode, stp.PART) AS ItemCode,             stp.LOT AS LotNo,             sd.SlotQr AS QrData,             sd.SlotQuantity AS Quantity,             sd.SlotLocation AS LocationCode,             CASE WHEN stp.SATUS = 1 THEN N'Da ket thuc' ELSE N'Dang mo' END AS Status,             stp.NAME AS ItemName,             stp.MODEL AS Model,             stp.NGAYSX AS NgaySX,             stp.CASX AS CaSX,             stp.SLSX AS SlSanXuat,             stp.SLNHAP AS SlDaNhap,             stp.SLXUAT AS SlDaXuat,             stp.SLCONLAI AS SlTonLot,             stp.NGAYNHAP AS NgayNhap,             stp.NGAYXUAT AS NgayXuat,             sd.SlotImportDate AS SlotImportDate,             sd.SlotMaPhieu AS SlotMaPhieu,             sd.WarehouseName AS SortWarehouse,             sd.RackName AS SortRack,             sd.SlotNumber AS SortSlot         FROM dbo.STOCKTP AS stp         INNER JOIN Slotted AS sd ON sd.StockLot = stp.LOT         WHERE ISNULL(stp.SLCONLAI, 0) > 0          UNION ALL          SELECT             stp.PART AS ItemCode,             stp.LOT AS LotNo,             CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS QrData,             stp.SLCONLAI - ISNULL(st.SlotQty, 0) AS Quantity,             N'Chua gan slot' AS LocationCode,             CASE WHEN stp.SATUS = 1 THEN N'Da ket thuc' ELSE N'Dang mo' END AS Status,             stp.NAME AS ItemName,             stp.MODEL AS Model,             stp.NGAYSX AS NgaySX,             stp.CASX AS CaSX,             stp.SLSX AS SlSanXuat,             stp.SLNHAP AS SlDaNhap,             stp.SLXUAT AS SlDaXuat,             stp.SLCONLAI AS SlTonLot,             stp.NGAYNHAP AS NgayNhap,             stp.NGAYXUAT AS NgayXuat,             CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS SlotImportDate,             CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS SlotMaPhieu,             N'~' AS SortWarehouse,             N'~' AS SortRack,             2147483647 AS SortSlot         FROM dbo.STOCKTP AS stp         LEFT JOIN SlottedTotal AS st ON st.StockLot = stp.LOT         WHERE ISNULL(stp.SLCONLAI, 0) > 0           AND stp.SLCONLAI - ISNULL(st.SlotQty, 0) > 0     ) AS u     ORDER BY u.LotNo, u.SortWarehouse, u.SortRack, u.SortSlot; END;

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_BarCodeView_ThongKe_Tmp1]                        @_Id INT = NULL,                        @_DocDate SMALLDATETIME ='',                        @_ReceiptItemCode NVARCHAR(24) ='',                        @_ReceiptQty NUMERIC(18,0) = 0,                        @_QuantityTmp1 NUMERIC(18,0) = 0,                        @_ShiftCode NVARCHAR(24) = '',                        @_LinesCode NVARCHAR(24) = N'',                  @_MachinesCode NVARCHAR(24) = N'',                @_GearCode nvarchar(10) = '0'                   AS                       BEGIN                           SET NOCOUNT ON;     -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════     -- Usp_BarCodeView_ThongKe_Tmp1 — sinh TEM TỔNG (master tag) khi Kiểm tra/Nhập kho.     -- Đây là nơi DUY NHẤT phát sinh ItemLotCode gốc cho 1 lô hàng — LOT này sẽ được     -- lưu vào STOCKTP.LOT (qua NhapTpReceivingService + LotNoHelper.NormalizeLot bên     -- C#) và về sau, khi giao hàng, phải khớp lại đúng LOT này (qua tem thùng —     -- Usp_DAT_BarCodeView_ThongKe). Vì vậy CẤU TRÚC 27 KÝ TỰ dưới đây là chuẩn tham     -- chiếu — mọi nơi khác build/parse LOT (Usp_DAT_BarCodeView_ThongKe,     -- QRCodeParser, LotNoHelper.NormalizeLot, CapNhapKhoYMVN...) phải cùng hiểu     -- đúng layout này, nếu không LOT sẽ không khớp được với STOCKTP.     -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════      IF OBJECT_ID ('TempDb..#CtTmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CtTmp                                    -- Tạo bảng tạm #CtTmp theo đúng schema chuẩn của hệ thống (kế thừa từ B00CtTmp,     -- default value do usp_sys_DefaultTable set) — đây là bảng kết quả trả về cho     -- report in tem, mỗi dòng = 1 tem (tem chẵn hoặc tem lẻ).     SELECT TOP 0 stt, ItemCode AS Model, ItemCode AS ShiftCode, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS Quantity9,                              DocDate, ItemCode, ItemName, CAST(N'' AS nvarchar(100)) AS ItemLotCode, EmployeeCode, CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS Group1,                              DeptName, CAST(N'' AS nvarchar(256)) AS QRCODE                           INTO #CtTmp                           FROM dbo.B00CtTmp                                    EXECUTE dbo.usp_sys_DefaultTable '#CtTmp'                                DECLARE @_ItemLotCode NVARCHAR(100), @_Id_Item INT, @_Numrow INT, @_QuantityLe NUMERIC(18,0), @_STT INT, @_TemCounter INT, @_LineID_Int INT                  -- ── BƯỚC 1: Tra ID nội bộ của Mã hàng và Line ─────────────────────────────────     -- ID (số) được dùng thay cho Code (chuỗi) khi build LOT vì cần độ dài cố định     -- (pad 5 ký tự) — Code có thể dài ngắn tuỳ ý nên không nhét được vào layout LOT.     -- Dùng biến riêng @_LineID_Int (không tái sử dụng tham số @_LinesCode) để tránh     -- ghi đè tham số đầu vào — @_LinesCode vẫn có thể cần dùng nguyên bản ở chỗ khác     -- nếu proc được mở rộng sau này.     SELECT @_Id_Item = Id FROM dbo.B20Item WHERE Code = @_ReceiptItemCode                           SELECT @_LineID_Int = id FROM B20Lines WHERE Code = @_LinesCode                               -- ── BƯỚC 2: Cấp số thứ tự tem (TEM_COUNTER) ───────────────────────────────────     -- Bộ đếm tem RIÊNG cho từng tổ hợp (Ngày SX, Ca, Mã hàng) — đảm bảo trong cùng     -- 1 ngày + 1 ca + 1 mã hàng, mỗi lần gọi proc sẽ ra số thứ tự tem KHÁC NHAU     -- (STT tem, 4 chữ số, vị trí 20-23 trong LOT — xem BƯỚC 3), tránh trùng LOT giữa     -- các lần in tem khác nhau trong cùng ca/ngày cho cùng 1 mã hàng.     SELECT TOP 1 @_TemCounter = Total FROM TEM_COUNTER          WHERE DocDate = @_DocDate AND ShiftCode = @_ShiftCode AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ItemCode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@_ReceiptItemCode))              IF(@_TemCounter IS NULL)                                 BEGIN                                     -- Chưa có bộ đếm cho tổ hợp (Ngày, Ca, Mã hàng) này → khởi tạo = 1         SET @_TemCounter = 1                                     INSERT INTO TEM_COUNTER(DocDate, ShiftCode, Total, ItemCode)              VALUES (@_DocDate, @_ShiftCode, 1, @_ReceiptItemCode)                                 END                                 ELSE                                 BEGIN                                     -- Đã có → tăng thêm 1, reset về 0 nếu vượt 9999 (giới hạn 4 chữ số của ô STT         -- trong LOT — xem RIGHT('0000'+...,4) ở BƯỚC 3). Vòng lặp 0-9999 chấp nhận         -- được vì số tem in ra trong 1 ca/ngày/mã hàng thực tế không vượt mức này.         SET @_TemCounter = (@_TemCounter + 1) % 10000 -- Reset nếu quá 9999             UPDATE TEM_COUNTER SET Total = @_TemCounter                                     WHERE DocDate = @_DocDate AND ShiftCode = @_ShiftCode AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ItemCode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@_ReceiptItemCode))         END                                                  -- ── BƯỚC 3: Build ItemLotCode chuẩn — 27 ký tự, vị trí CỐ ĐỊNH ────────────────     -- Dùng RIGHT('padding'+giá trị, N) thay cho STUFF(...) để tránh lỗi khi giá trị     -- rỗng/NULL bị STUFF trả về NULL toàn chuỗi (bug đã gặp ở phiên bản cũ).     --     -- Bảng vị trí (đúng thứ tự nối chuỗi bên dưới):     --   Vị trí  1- 2 (2 ký tự) : YY            — 2 số cuối năm sản xuất     --   Vị trí  3- 4 (2 ký tự) : MM            — tháng sản xuất (pad 0)     --   Vị trí  5- 6 (2 ký tự) : DD            — ngày sản xuất (pad 0)     --   Vị trí  7-11 (5 ký tự) : Id_Item       — ID nội bộ mã hàng (B20Item.Id, pad 0)     --   Vị trí 12    (1 ký tự) : ShiftCode     — mã ca sản xuất     --   Vị trí 13    (1 ký tự) : GearCode      — mã Gear (mặc định '0' nếu không có)     --   Vị trí 14-16 (3 ký tự) : LineID_Int    — ID nội bộ chuyền (B20Lines.Id, pad 0)     --   Vị trí 17-20 (3 ký tự) : MachinesCode  — mã máy (pad 0, KHÔNG phải ID)     --   Vị trí 20-23 (4 ký tự) : TemCounter    — STT tem trong ca/ngày/mã hàng (BƯỚC 2)     --   Vị trí 24-27 (4 ký tự) : QuantityTmp1  — số lượng đóng gói / tem (SL trên tem)     --     -- LƯU Ý QUAN TRỌNG cho việc khớp LOT khi giao hàng (STOCKTP.LOT):     --   LotNoHelper.NormalizeLot (C#) chuẩn hoá LOT bằng cách giữ 19 ký tự đầu     --   (vị trí 1-19: Ngày+Id_Item+Ca+Gear+Line+Machine) + 4 ký tự cuối (vị trí     --   24-27: SL) = 23 ký tự, LOẠI BỎ vị trí 20-23 (TemCounter) — vì STT tem chỉ có     --   ý nghĩa phân biệt CÁC TEM trong cùng 1 lô, không phải một phần định danh của     --   LÔ SẢN XUẤT. (không có quy cách đóng gói thì không tự chia tem tại đây).     --     -- QRCODE build ra có 6 phần, cách nhau bởi ':' — đúng định dạng "tem tổng" mà     -- QRCodeParser.ParseQRCode (C#) nhận diện CAST(MONTH(@_DocDate) AS NVARCHAR), 2) +             RIGHT('0' + CAST(DAY(@_DocDate) AS NVARCHAR), 2) +              RIGHT('00000' + CAST(ISNULL(@_Id_Item,0) AS NVARCHAR), 5) +              ISNULL(@_ShiftCode,'9') + ISNULL(@_GearCode,'0') +              RIGHT('000' + CAST(ISNULL(@_LineID_Int,0) AS NVARCHAR), 3) +              RIGHT('0000' + ISNULL(@_MachinesCode,'0000'), 4)    	DECLARE + 1      END     ELSE     BEGIN         -- Chưa có dữ liệu: Khởi tạo bắt đầu từ 1         SET @_STT = 1     END       -- SET @_STT = 1                                                   WHILE @_Numrow > 0                           BEGIN                               INSERT INTO #CtTmp (stt, Model, ShiftCode, Quantity9, DocDate, ItemCode, ItemName, ItemLotCode, EmployeeCode, Group1, DeptName,
