CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_BaoCao_DeliveryTrace (     @CustomerNo   nvarchar(20),     @CustomerName nvarchar(200) = NULL,     @FromDate     date,     @ToDate       date ) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SET XACT_ABORT ON;      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 1. VALIDATE     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     IF @CustomerNo NOT IN (N'100001', N'100002')     BEGIN         THROW 50001,               N'CustomerNo không được hỗ trợ. Chỉ hỗ trợ 100001 / 100002.',               1;     END;      IF @FromDate IS NULL OR @ToDate IS NULL     BEGIN         THROW 50002,               N'@FromDate và @ToDate không được NULL.',               1;     END;      IF @FromDate > @ToDate     BEGIN         THROW 50003,               N'@FromDate không được lớn hơn @ToDate.',               1;     END;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 2. CUSTOMER DISPLAY NAME     --     -- Application mapping:     --     -- 100001 -> HON DA - VIET NAM     -- 100002 -> YAMAHA - VIET NAM     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     DECLARE @CustomerDisplayName nvarchar(200);      SET @CustomerDisplayName =         CASE @CustomerNo             WHEN N'100001' THEN N'HON DA - VIET NAM'             WHEN N'100002' THEN N'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'         END;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 3. CUSTOMER FACTORY FILTER     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE TABLE #CustomerFactory     (         NhaMay nvarchar(200) NOT NULL             PRIMARY KEY     );      IF @CustomerNo = N'100001'     BEGIN         INSERT INTO #CustomerFactory         (             NhaMay         )         VALUES             (N'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY VP)'),             (N'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY HN)');     END     ELSE     BEGIN         INSERT INTO #CustomerFactory         (             NhaMay         )         VALUES             (N'YAMAHA - VIET NAM');     END;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 4. DELIVERY SOURCE     --     -- Normalize:     --     -- 01     -> 1     -- 001    -> 1     -- 0001   -> 1     -- J0663  -> J0663     -- 0J0663 -> J0663     --     -- KHÔNG TRY_CONVERT(INT)     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH DeliverySource AS     (         SELECT             P.STT,             P.CUA,             P.TRUYEN,             P.MAHANG,             P.TENHANG,             P.LOT,             P.DV,             P.SOLUONG,             P.NGAYGIAO,             P.GIOGIAO,             P.STATUS,             P.TTPHIEU,             P.NHAMAY,             P.GIOGIAOFCC,             P.GearYMVN,             P.HOP,             P.STATUSDOC,             P.Note,             P.TGLUU,             P.PO_NO,             P.PO_ITEM,              NormalizedGioGiao =                 CASE                     WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO)), N'') IS NULL                         THEN NULL                      WHEN PATINDEX                     (                         N'%[^0]%',                         LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO))                     ) = 0                         THEN N'0'                      ELSE SUBSTRING                     (                         LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO)),                         PATINDEX                         (                             N'%[^0]%',                             LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO))                         ),                         LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO)))                     )                 END          FROM dbo.LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG P          INNER JOIN #CustomerFactory CF             ON CF.NhaMay = P.NHAMAY          WHERE P.NGAYGIAO >= @FromDate           AND P.NGAYGIAO < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @ToDate)     ),      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 5. QR SOURCE     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     QrSource AS     (         SELECT             D.LOTFCC,             D.MAHANGFCC,             D.SLTEMFCC,              D.LOTHVN,             D.MAHANGHVN,             D.SLTEMHVN,              D.STATUS,             D.MAFCC,             D.STT,             D.KETQUA,              D.NGAYXUAT,             D.GIOXUAT,             D.NHAMAY,             D.GIOGIAO,              D.TGLUU,             D.TGLuuDuLieu,              NormalizedGioGiao =                 CASE                     WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO)), N'') IS NULL                         THEN NULL                      WHEN PATINDEX                     (                         N'%[^0]%',                         LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO))                     ) = 0                         THEN N'0'                      ELSE SUBSTRING                     (                         LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO)),                         PATINDEX                         (                             N'%[^0]%',                             LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO))                         ),                         LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO)))                     )                 END          FROM dbo.LUUDOCQRCODE D     ),      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 6. MATCH DELIVERY <-> QR     --     -- Common:     --     -- D.NHAMAY      = P.NHAMAY     -- D.MAHANGFCC   = P.MAHANG     -- D.NGAYXUAT    = P.NGAYGIAO     --     -- Honda:     -- D.GIOXUAT     = P.GIOGIAOFCC     --     -- Yamaha:     -- Normalize(D.GIOGIAO) = Normalize(P.CUA)     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     DeliveryMatched AS     (         SELECT             @CustomerNo AS CustomerNo,              @CustomerDisplayName AS CustomerName,              P.NHAMAY AS Factory,              P.STT AS PhieuSTT,              P.CUA,             P.TRUYEN,              P.MAHANG,             P.TENHANG,             P.LOT AS DeliveryLot,              P.DV,             P.SOLUONG AS DeliveryQuantity,              P.NGAYGIAO,             P.GIOGIAO,             P.GIOGIAOFCC,              P.GearYMVN,             P.HOP,              P.STATUS AS DeliveryStatus,             P.TTPHIEU,             P.STATUSDOC,             P.Note,              P.PO_NO,             P.PO_ITEM,              D.STT AS QrSTT,              D.MAFCC,              D.LOTFCC,             D.MAHANGFCC,             D.SLTEMFCC,              D.LOTHVN,             D.MAHANGHVN,             D.SLTEMHVN,              D.KETQUA AS QrKetQua,              D.NGAYXUAT,             D.GIOXUAT,             D.GIOGIAO AS QrGioGiao,              CONCAT             (                 P.NHAMAY,                 N'|',                 CONVERT(char(8), P.NGAYGIAO, 112),                 N'|',                 ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAOFCC)), N''),                 N'|',                 ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.CUA)), N''),                 N'|',                 CONVERT(nvarchar(50), P.SOLUONG)             ) AS DeliveryKey,              CASE                 WHEN @CustomerNo = N'100002'                     THEN N'YAMAHA: GIOGIAO = CUA'                 ELSE                     N'HONDA: GIOXUAT = GIOGIAOFCC'             END AS MatchType          FROM DeliverySource P          INNER JOIN QrSource D             ON D.NHAMAY = P.NHAMAY             AND D.MAHANGFCC = P.MAHANG             AND D.NGAYXUAT = P.NGAYGIAO             AND            (                 (                     @CustomerNo <> N'100002'                      AND                     LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOXUAT))                         =                     LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAOFCC))                 )                  OR                  (                     @CustomerNo = N'100002'                      AND                     D.NormalizedGioGiao                         =                     P.NormalizedGioGiao                 )            )     )      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 7. MATERIALIZE DELIVERY EVIDENCE     --     -- Không dùng CTE DeliveryMatched cho các statement phía sau.     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     SELECT         *     INTO #DeliveryEvidence     FROM DeliveryMatched;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 8. INDEX     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryEvidence_QrSTT         ON #DeliveryEvidence(QrSTT);      CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryEvidence_LotFCC         ON #DeliveryEvidence(LOTFCC);      CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryEvidence_LotHVN         ON #DeliveryEvidence(LOTHVN);      CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryEvidence_Item         ON #DeliveryEvidence(MAHANG);       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- RESULT SET #1     --     -- DELIVERY EVIDENCE     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     SELECT         CustomerNo,         CustomerName,         Factory,          DeliveryKey,          PhieuSTT,         CUA,         TRUYEN,          MAHANG,         TENHANG,         DeliveryLot,          DV,         DeliveryQuantity,          NGAYGIAO,         GIOGIAO,         GIOGIAOFCC,          GearYMVN,         HOP,          DeliveryStatus,         TTPHIEU,         STATUSDOC,         Note,          PO_NO,         PO_ITEM,          QrSTT,         MAFCC,          LOTFCC,         MAHANGFCC,         SLTEMFCC,          LOTHVN,         MAHANGHVN,         SLTEMHVN,          QrKetQua,          NGAYXUAT,         GIOXUAT,         QrGioGiao,          MatchType      FROM #DeliveryEvidence      ORDER BY         NGAYGIAO,         Factory,         MAHANG,         PhieuSTT,         QrSTT;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 9. DELIVERY LOTS     --     -- Một dòng QR có thể có:     --     -- LOTFCC =     --     -- LotA-160,     -- LotB-30,     -- LotC-160     --     -- Phải tách thành:     --     -- LotA     -- LotB     -- LotC     --     -- Lot13 = LEFT(token, 13)     --     -- KHÔNG dùng PRIMARY KEY chứa nullable columns.     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE TABLE #DeliveryLots     (         Lot13 nvarchar(13) NOT NULL,          ItemCode nvarchar(100) NULL,          CustomerNo nvarchar(20) NOT NULL,          CustomerName nvarchar(200) NOT NULL,          Factory nvarchar(200) NULL,          DeliveryKey nvarchar(500) NULL,          DeliveryQuantity int NULL,          NgayGiao date NULL,          PhieuSTT smallint NULL,          QrSTT smallint NULL     );       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 10. SPLIT LOTFCC     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH DeliveryLotSource AS     (         SELECT             D.CustomerNo,             D.CustomerName,             D.Factory,             D.DeliveryKey,             D.DeliveryQuantity,             D.NGAYGIAO,             D.PhieuSTT,             D.QrSTT,             D.MAHANG AS ItemCode,             D.LOTFCC AS LotList          FROM #DeliveryEvidence D          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(D.LOTFCC)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL          UNION ALL          ---------------------------------------------------------------------         -- 11. SPLIT LOTHVN         ---------------------------------------------------------------------         SELECT             D.CustomerNo,             D.CustomerName,             D.Factory,             D.DeliveryKey,             D.DeliveryQuantity,             D.NGAYGIAO,             D.PhieuSTT,             D.QrSTT,             D.MAHANG AS ItemCode,             D.LOTHVN AS LotList          FROM #DeliveryEvidence D          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(D.LOTHVN)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL     ),      DeliveryLotTokens AS     (         SELECT             S.CustomerNo,             S.CustomerName,             S.Factory,             S.DeliveryKey,             S.DeliveryQuantity,             S.NGAYGIAO,             S.PhieuSTT,             S.QrSTT,             S.ItemCode,              LTRIM(RTRIM(SS.value)) AS LotToken          FROM DeliveryLotSource S          CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT         (             S.LotList,             N','         ) SS          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(SS.value)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL     )      INSERT INTO #DeliveryLots     (         Lot13,         ItemCode,         CustomerNo,         CustomerName,         Factory,         DeliveryKey,         DeliveryQuantity,         NgayGiao,         PhieuSTT,         QrSTT     )     SELECT DISTINCT          LEFT(LotToken, 13) AS Lot13,          ItemCode,          CustomerNo,         CustomerName,         Factory,          DeliveryKey,          DeliveryQuantity,          NGAYGIAO,          PhieuSTT,         QrSTT      FROM DeliveryLotTokens      WHERE LEN(LotToken) >= 13;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 12. INDEX DELIVERY LOT     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryLots_Lot13         ON #DeliveryLots(Lot13);      CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryLots_ItemCode         ON #DeliveryLots(ItemCode);       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 13. STOCK HISTORY -> LOT13 MOVEMENT     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE TABLE #StockLotMovement     (         StockHistoryId bigint NOT NULL,          Lot13 nvarchar(13) NOT NULL,          SlotId int NULL,          FromSlotId int NULL,          ToSlotId int NULL,          ActionType nvarchar(100) NULL,          MovementQuantity int NULL,          MovementDate datetime NULL,          ItemCode nvarchar(100) NULL,          TemCode nvarchar(500) NULL,          MaPhieu nvarchar(100) NULL,          PerformedBy nvarchar(200) NULL,          QrData nvarchar(max) NULL     );       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 14. STOCK HISTORY LOT SPLIT     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH SHBase AS     (         SELECT             SH.Id,             SH.ActionType,             SH.ItemCode,             SH.TemCode,             SH.LotNo,             SH.Quantity,             SH.Date,             SH.SlotId,             SH.PerformedBy,             SH.QrData,             SH.MaPhieu,             SH.FromSlotId,             SH.ToSlotId          FROM dbo.StockHistory SH          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(SH.LotNo)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL     ),      SplitLot AS     (         SELECT             SH.*,              LTRIM(RTRIM(SS.value)) AS LotToken          FROM SHBase SH          CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT         (             SH.LotNo,             N','         ) SS          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(SS.value)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL     ),      Parsed AS     (         SELECT             S.*,              LEFT             (                 S.LotToken,                 13             ) AS LotRaw,              CASE                 WHEN CHARINDEX(N'-', S.LotToken) > 13                 THEN                     SUBSTRING                     (                         S.LotToken,                         CHARINDEX(N'-', S.LotToken) + 1,                         LEN(S.LotToken)     N'Remove'                         )                      THEN -ISNULL                     (                         SLM.MovementQuantity,                         0                     )                      ELSE 0                  END             ) AS EstimatedQuantity,              MAX             (                 SLM.SlotId             ) AS LastSlotId          FROM #StockLotMovement SLM          INNER JOIN         (             SELECT DISTINCT Lot13             FROM #DeliveryLots         ) DL             ON DL.Lot13 = SLM.Lot13          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(SLM.MaPhieu)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL          GROUP BY              SLM.Lot13,              SLM.MaPhieu     )      SELECT          P.Lot13,          P.MaPhieu,     ORDER BY          P.Lot13,          P.LastMovementDate DESC,          P.MaPhieu;  END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetStockHistory]     @FromDate DATETIME = NULL,     @ToDate DATETIME = NULL,     @ItemCode NVARCHAR(100) = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      SELECT          SH.Id,         SH.ActionType,         SH.ItemCode,         SH.TemCode,         SH.LotNo,         SH.Quantity,         SH.Date,         SH.SlotId,         WH.Name as whName,         R.RackName,         S.SlotNumber,         SH.PerformedBy     FROM          StockHistory SH     LEFT JOIN          Slot S ON SH.SlotId = S.SlotId     LEFT JOIN          Rack R ON S.RackId = R.RackId     LEFT JOIN          Warehouse WH ON R.WarehouseId = WH.WarehouseId     WHERE          (@FromDate IS NULL OR SH.Date >= @FromDate) AND         (@ToDate IS NULL OR SH.Date <= @ToDate) AND         (@ItemCode IS NULL OR SH.ItemCode = @ItemCode)     ORDER BY          SH.Date DESC END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetCurrentStockStatus] AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      /*       Match physical LOT identity consistently with delivery confirmation:       full LOT (>13 chars) matches exactly; a 13-character root is accepted       only when it maps to one physical LOT. Multiple slot allocations for the       same physical LOT remain separate location rows.        Every LOT with SLCONLAI > 0 is always reported: the rows of one LOT add up       to STOCKTP.SLCONLAI. Quantity that is not covered by an active SlotLot row       (legacy / imported stock, or a partial put-away) is reported as one extra       row with LocationCode = N'Chua gan slot' so the report never silently       drops location information.        QrData is the full QR of the SlotLot row (falls back to the TemCode when       the QR text was not stored).     */     ;WITH StockLotKeys AS     (         SELECT             LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) AS LotKey,             COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT)) AS PhysicalLotCount         FROM dbo.STOCKTP         GROUP BY LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13)     ),     Slotted AS     (         SELECT             stp.LOT AS StockLot,             sl.ItemCode AS SlotItemCode,             sl.Quantity AS SlotQuantity,             sl.ImportDate AS SlotImportDate,             sl.MaPhieu AS SlotMaPhieu,             ISNULL(NULLIF(sl.QrData, N''), sl.TemCode) AS SlotQr,             CASE WHEN s.SlotId IS NOT NULL                  THEN w.Name + N'-' + r.RackName + N'-Slot' + CAST(s.SlotNumber AS NVARCHAR(20))                  ELSE NULL END AS SlotLocation,             r.RackName AS RackName,             s.SlotNumber AS SlotNumber,             w.Name AS WarehouseName         FROM dbo.STOCKTP AS stp         LEFT JOIN StockLotKeys AS lk             ON lk.LotKey = LEFT(RTRIM(stp.LOT), 13)         INNER JOIN dbo.SlotLot AS sl             ON sl.PhieuStatus = 0            AND            (                 (LEN(RTRIM(stp.LOT)) > 13 AND RTRIM(sl.LotNo) = RTRIM(stp.LOT))                 OR                 (LEN(RTRIM(stp.LOT)) <= 13                  AND lk.PhysicalLotCount = 1                  AND LEFT(RTRIM(sl.LotNo), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(stp.LOT), 13))            )         LEFT JOIN dbo.Slot AS s ON s.SlotId = sl.SlotId         LEFT JOIN dbo.Rack AS r ON r.RackId = s.RackId         LEFT JOIN dbo.Warehouse AS w ON w.WarehouseId = r.WarehouseId         WHERE ISNULL(stp.SLCONLAI, 0) > 0     ),     SlottedTotal AS     (         SELECT StockLot, SUM(SlotQuantity) AS SlotQty         FROM Slotted         GROUP BY StockLot     )     SELECT         u.ItemCode,         u.LotNo,         u.QrData,         u.Quantity,         u.LocationCode,         u.Status,         u.ItemName,         u.Model,         u.NgaySX,         u.CaSX,         u.SlSanXuat,         u.SlDaNhap,         u.SlDaXuat,         u.SlTonLot,         u.NgayNhap,         u.NgayXuat,         u.SlotImportDate,         u.SlotMaPhieu     FROM     (         SELECT             ISNULL(sd.SlotItemCode, stp.PART) AS ItemCode,             stp.LOT AS LotNo,             sd.SlotQr AS QrData,             sd.SlotQuantity AS Quantity,             sd.SlotLocation AS LocationCode,             CASE WHEN stp.SATUS = 1 THEN N'Da ket thuc' ELSE N'Dang mo' END AS Status,             stp.NAME AS ItemName,             stp.MODEL AS Model,             stp.NGAYSX AS NgaySX,             stp.CASX AS CaSX,             stp.SLSX AS SlSanXuat,             stp.SLNHAP AS SlDaNhap,             stp.SLXUAT AS SlDaXuat,             stp.SLCONLAI AS SlTonLot,             stp.NGAYNHAP AS NgayNhap,             stp.NGAYXUAT AS NgayXuat,             sd.SlotImportDate AS SlotImportDate,             sd.SlotMaPhieu AS SlotMaPhieu,             sd.WarehouseName AS SortWarehouse,             sd.RackName AS SortRack,             sd.SlotNumber AS SortSlot         FROM dbo.STOCKTP AS stp         INNER JOIN Slotted AS sd ON sd.StockLot = stp.LOT         WHERE ISNULL(stp.SLCONLAI, 0) > 0          UNION ALL          SELECT             stp.PART AS ItemCode,             stp.LOT AS LotNo,             CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS QrData,             stp.SLCONLAI - ISNULL(st.SlotQty, 0) AS Quantity,             N'Chua gan slot' AS LocationCode,             CASE WHEN stp.SATUS = 1 THEN N'Da ket thuc' ELSE N'Dang mo' END AS Status,             stp.NAME AS ItemName,             stp.MODEL AS Model,             stp.NGAYSX AS NgaySX,             stp.CASX AS CaSX,             stp.SLSX AS SlSanXuat,             stp.SLNHAP AS SlDaNhap,             stp.SLXUAT AS SlDaXuat,             stp.SLCONLAI AS SlTonLot,             stp.NGAYNHAP AS NgayNhap,             stp.NGAYXUAT AS NgayXuat,             CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS SlotImportDate,             CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS SlotMaPhieu,             N'~' AS SortWarehouse,             N'~' AS SortRack,             2147483647 AS SortSlot         FROM dbo.STOCKTP AS stp         LEFT JOIN SlottedTotal AS st ON st.StockLot = stp.LOT         WHERE ISNULL(stp.SLCONLAI, 0) > 0           AND stp.SLCONLAI - ISNULL(st.SlotQty, 0) > 0     ) AS u     ORDER BY u.LotNo, u.SortWarehouse, u.SortRack, u.SortSlot; END;

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_BarCodeView_ThongKe_Tmp1]                        @_Id INT = NULL,                        @_DocDate SMALLDATETIME ='',                        @_ReceiptItemCode NVARCHAR(24) ='',                        @_ReceiptQty NUMERIC(18,0) = 0,                        @_QuantityTmp1 NUMERIC(18,0) = 0,                        @_ShiftCode NVARCHAR(24) = '',                        @_LinesCode NVARCHAR(24) = N'',                  @_MachinesCode NVARCHAR(24) = N'',                @_GearCode nvarchar(10) = '0'                   AS                       BEGIN                           SET NOCOUNT ON;     -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════     -- Usp_BarCodeView_ThongKe_Tmp1 — sinh TEM TỔNG (master tag) khi Kiểm tra/Nhập kho.     -- Đây là nơi DUY NHẤT phát sinh ItemLotCode gốc cho 1 lô hàng — LOT này sẽ được     -- lưu vào STOCKTP.LOT (qua NhapTpReceivingService + LotNoHelper.NormalizeLot bên     -- C#) và về sau, khi giao hàng, phải khớp lại đúng LOT này (qua tem thùng —     -- Usp_DAT_BarCodeView_ThongKe). Vì vậy CẤU TRÚC 27 KÝ TỰ dưới đây là chuẩn tham     -- chiếu — mọi nơi khác build/parse LOT (Usp_DAT_BarCodeView_ThongKe,     -- QRCodeParser, LotNoHelper.NormalizeLot, CapNhapKhoYMVN...) phải cùng hiểu     -- đúng layout này, nếu không LOT sẽ không khớp được với STOCKTP.     -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════      IF OBJECT_ID ('TempDb..#CtTmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CtTmp                                    -- Tạo bảng tạm #CtTmp theo đúng schema chuẩn của hệ thống (kế thừa từ B00CtTmp,     -- default value do usp_sys_DefaultTable set) — đây là bảng kết quả trả về cho     -- report in tem, mỗi dòng = 1 tem (tem chẵn hoặc tem lẻ).     SELECT TOP 0 stt, ItemCode AS Model, ItemCode AS ShiftCode, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS Quantity9,                              DocDate, ItemCode, ItemName, CAST(N'' AS nvarchar(100)) AS ItemLotCode, EmployeeCode, CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS Group1,                              DeptName, CAST(N'' AS nvarchar(256)) AS QRCODE                           INTO #CtTmp                           FROM dbo.B00CtTmp                                    EXECUTE dbo.usp_sys_DefaultTable '#CtTmp'                                DECLARE @_ItemLotCode NVARCHAR(100), @_Id_Item INT, @_Numrow INT, @_QuantityLe NUMERIC(18,0), @_STT INT, @_TemCounter INT, @_LineID_Int INT                  -- ── BƯỚC 1: Tra ID nội bộ của Mã hàng và Line ─────────────────────────────────     -- ID (số) được dùng thay cho Code (chuỗi) khi build LOT vì cần độ dài cố định     -- (pad 5 ký tự) — Code có thể dài ngắn tuỳ ý nên không nhét được vào layout LOT.     -- Dùng biến riêng @_LineID_Int (không tái sử dụng tham số @_LinesCode) để tránh     -- ghi đè tham số đầu vào — @_LinesCode vẫn có thể cần dùng nguyên bản ở chỗ khác     -- nếu proc được mở rộng sau này.     SELECT @_Id_Item = Id FROM dbo.B20Item WHERE Code = @_ReceiptItemCode                           SELECT @_LineID_Int = id FROM B20Lines WHERE Code = @_LinesCode                               -- ── BƯỚC 2: Cấp số thứ tự tem (TEM_COUNTER) ───────────────────────────────────     -- Bộ đếm tem RIÊNG cho từng tổ hợp (Ngày SX, Ca, Mã hàng) — đảm bảo trong cùng     -- 1 ngày + 1 ca + 1 mã hàng, mỗi lần gọi proc sẽ ra số thứ tự tem KHÁC NHAU     -- (STT tem, 4 chữ số, vị trí 20-23 trong LOT — xem BƯỚC 3), tránh trùng LOT giữa     -- các lần in tem khác nhau trong cùng ca/ngày cho cùng 1 mã hàng.     SELECT TOP 1 @_TemCounter = Total FROM TEM_COUNTER          WHERE DocDate = @_DocDate AND ShiftCode = @_ShiftCode AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ItemCode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@_ReceiptItemCode))              IF(@_TemCounter IS NULL)                                 BEGIN                                     -- Chưa có bộ đếm cho tổ hợp (Ngày, Ca, Mã hàng) này → khởi tạo = 1         SET @_TemCounter = 1                                     INSERT INTO TEM_COUNTER(DocDate, ShiftCode, Total, ItemCode)              VALUES (@_DocDate, @_ShiftCode, 1, @_ReceiptItemCode)                                 END                                 ELSE                                 BEGIN                                     -- Đã có → tăng thêm 1, reset về 0 nếu vượt 9999 (giới hạn 4 chữ số của ô STT         -- trong LOT — xem RIGHT('0000'+...,4) ở BƯỚC 3). Vòng lặp 0-9999 chấp nhận         -- được vì số tem in ra trong 1 ca/ngày/mã hàng thực tế không vượt mức này.         SET @_TemCounter = (@_TemCounter + 1) % 10000 -- Reset nếu quá 9999             UPDATE TEM_COUNTER SET Total = @_TemCounter                                     WHERE DocDate = @_DocDate AND ShiftCode = @_ShiftCode AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ItemCode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@_ReceiptItemCode))         END                                                  -- ── BƯỚC 3: Build ItemLotCode chuẩn — 27 ký tự, vị trí CỐ ĐỊNH ────────────────     -- Dùng RIGHT('padding'+giá trị, N) thay cho STUFF(...) để tránh lỗi khi giá trị     -- rỗng/NULL bị STUFF trả về NULL toàn chuỗi (bug đã gặp ở phiên bản cũ).     --     -- Bảng vị trí (đúng thứ tự nối chuỗi bên dưới):     --   Vị trí  1- 2 (2 ký tự) : YY            — 2 số cuối năm sản xuất     --   Vị trí  3- 4 (2 ký tự) : MM            — tháng sản xuất (pad 0)     --   Vị trí  5- 6 (2 ký tự) : DD            — ngày sản xuất (pad 0)     --   Vị trí  7-11 (5 ký tự) : Id_Item       — ID nội bộ mã hàng (B20Item.Id, pad 0)     --   Vị trí 12    (1 ký tự) : ShiftCode     — mã ca sản xuất     --   Vị trí 13    (1 ký tự) : GearCode      — mã Gear (mặc định '0' nếu không có)     --   Vị trí 14-16 (3 ký tự) : LineID_Int    — ID nội bộ chuyền (B20Lines.Id, pad 0)     --   Vị trí 17-20 (3 ký tự) : MachinesCode  — mã máy (pad 0, KHÔNG phải ID)     --   Vị trí 20-23 (4 ký tự) : TemCounter    — STT tem trong ca/ngày/mã hàng (BƯỚC 2)     --   Vị trí 24-27 (4 ký tự) : QuantityTmp1  — số lượng đóng gói / tem (SL trên tem)     --     -- LƯU Ý QUAN TRỌNG cho việc khớp LOT khi giao hàng (STOCKTP.LOT):     --   LotNoHelper.NormalizeLot (C#) chuẩn hoá LOT bằng cách giữ 19 ký tự đầu     --   (vị trí 1-19: Ngày+Id_Item+Ca+Gear+Line+Machine) + 4 ký tự cuối (vị trí     --   24-27: SL) = 23 ký tự, LOẠI BỎ vị trí 20-23 (TemCounter) — vì STT tem chỉ có     --   ý nghĩa phân biệt CÁC TEM trong cùng 1 lô, không phải một phần định danh của     --   LÔ SẢN XUẤT. Khop dong bang MAHANG+SOLUONG+NGAYGIAO+GIOGIAO, danh so RN trong nhom            trung de chi loai dung so dong da OK (dong trung chua giao van duoc xu ly).         8) MOI: #IFSCursorTable nap theo NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO => gio som lay lot truoc.     Chi tra DUNG 1 result set cuoi cung (MH, GG, LG[, GearName]). */ CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_gheplot]     @TMPTABLE nvarchar(128) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',     @IFSTABLE nvarchar(128) = N'IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG',     @USEGEAR bit = 0,     @EXPECTEDTMPTABLE nvarchar(128) = NULL,     @VIEWTABLEPREFIX nvarchar(128) = NULL AS BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;      /* ======================= NHANH GEAR (@USEGEAR = 1) ======================= */     IF @USEGEAR = 1     BEGIN         IF @EXPECTEDTMPTABLE IS NULL OR @VIEWTABLEPREFIX IS NULL            OR (@TMPTABLE <> @EXPECTEDTMPTABLE                AND LEFT(@TMPTABLE, LEN(@VIEWTABLEPREFIX) + 1) <> @VIEWTABLEPREFIX + N'_'                AND @TMPTABLE <> N'YMVN_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG')             THROW 51221, N'Tên TMP không khớp CustomerTableConfig cho xử lý Gear.', 1;          DECLARE @GearObjectId int = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE));         IF @GearObjectId IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS            (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = @GearObjectId AND type IN (N'U', N'V'))             THROW 51222, N'Không tìm thấy bảng/VIEW TMP dùng cho xử lý Gear.', 1;          -- Chon cot Gear theo cot thuc su ton tai trong bang/VIEW         DECLARE @TmpFull nvarchar(300) = N'dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE);          DECLARE @GearCol sysname =             CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH(@TmpFull, N'GEAR')    IS NOT NULL THEN N'GEAR'                  WHEN COL_LENGTH(@TmpFull, N'TTPHIEU') IS NOT NULL THEN N'TTPHIEU'                  ELSE N'GEAR' END;          DECLARE @MissingCols nvarchar(500) = N'';         SELECT @MissingCols = @MissingCols + N',' + c.ColName         FROM (VALUES (N'MAHANG'),(N'SOLUONG'),(N'NGAYGIAO'),(N'GIOGIAO'),(@GearCol)) AS c(ColName)         WHERE COL_LENGTH(@TmpFull, c.ColName) IS NULL;          IF @MissingCols <> N''         BEGIN             DECLARE @Msg nvarchar(600) =                 N'TMP Gear thiếu cột: ' + STUFF(@MissingCols, 1, 1, N'') + N' (' + @TMPTABLE + N')';             THROW 51223, @Msg, 1;         END;          CREATE TABLE #GearSrc         (             MAHANG nvarchar(56) NOT NULL,             SOLUONG int NOT NULL,             NGAYGIAO datetime NULL,             GIOGIAO nvarchar(50) NULL,             GearText nvarchar(1000) NULL         );          -- Bo qua dong da Cap nhat kho (STATUS = OK) neu TMP co cot STATUS         DECLARE @GearStatusFilter nvarchar(200) =             CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH(@TmpFull, N'STATUS') IS NOT NULL                  THEN N' AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([STATUS], N'''')))) <> N''OK'''                  ELSE N'' END;          DECLARE @GearSql nvarchar(max) =             N'INSERT INTO #GearSrc(MAHANG,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,GearText)               SELECT MAHANG, TRY_CONVERT(int,SOLUONG), NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO,' + QUOTENAME(@GearCol) +               N' FROM dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) +               N' WHERE ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(int,SOLUONG),0) > 0 AND ISNULL(MAHANG,'''') <> ''''' +               @GearStatusFilter + N';';         EXEC sys.sp_executesql @GearSql;          CREATE TABLE #GearStock         (             StockId int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,             PART nvarchar(100) NOT NULL,             LOT13 nvarchar(20) NOT NULL,             GearCode nvarchar(10) NULL,             Qty int NOT NULL,             SortKey decimal(38,0) NULL         );          INSERT INTO #GearStock (PART, LOT13, GearCode, Qty, SortKey)         SELECT             s.PART,             LEFT(s.LOT, 20),                           -- 20 ky tu dau lam khoa LOT             SUBSTRING(s.LOT, 13, 1),                   -- ky tu thu 13 = B20Gear.Code             CONVERT(int, s.SLCONLAI),             TRY_CONVERT(decimal(38,0), LEFT(s.LOT, 20))         FROM dbo.STOCKTP s         WHERE s.SLCONLAI > 0           AND LEN(ISNULL(s.LOT, '')) >= 20           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GearSrc src WHERE src.MAHANG = s.PART);          CREATE TABLE #GearResult         (             ResultId int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,             MH nvarchar(56) NOT NULL,             GG nvarchar(50) NULL,             LG nvarchar(1000) NOT NULL,             GearName nvarchar(100) NULL         );          CREATE TABLE #GearItems         (             ItemId int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,             ItemQty int NOT NULL,             GearName nvarchar(100) NOT NULL,             GearCode nvarchar(10) NOT NULL         );          DECLARE @Part nvarchar(56), @OrderQty int, @DeliveryDate datetime, @DeliveryTime nvarchar(50),                 @GearTextValue nvarchar(1000), @PackQty int, @GearToken nvarchar(400),                 @ResolvedGearName nvarchar(100), @ResolvedGearCode nvarchar(10),                 @ItemQty int, @ItemGearName nvarchar(100), @ItemGearCode nvarchar(10),                 @LotKey nvarchar(20), @StockQty int, @Pending int,                 @LotList nvarchar(1000), @Need int, @ParsedQty int, @DigitStart int, @GearPartialQty int,                 @Digits nvarchar(40), @StockId int;          DECLARE GearOrderCur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR             SELECT MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO, GearText             FROM #GearSrc             ORDER BY MAHANG, NGAYGIAO, GearText, GIOGIAO;          OPEN GearOrderCur;         FETCH NEXT FROM GearOrderCur INTO @Part,@OrderQty,@DeliveryDate,@DeliveryTime,@GearTextValue;         WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0         BEGIN             SET @PackQty = NULL;             SELECT TOP(1) @PackQty = TRY_CONVERT(int,MinCloseQty)             FROM dbo.B20Item WHERE Code=@Part;             IF ISNULL(@PackQty,0) <= 0 SET @PackQty = 1;              TRUNCATE TABLE #GearItems;              /*               Vi du chuoi Gear: "Gear D : 5000pcs, Gear E : 300pcs"               Chu cai = B20Gear.Name ; LOT[13] = B20Gear.Code.             */             IF CHARINDEX(N',',ISNULL(@GearTextValue,N'')) > 0             BEGIN                 DECLARE GearTokenCur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                     SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(strval))                     FROM dbo.Split(@GearTextValue, N',')                     WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(strval)) <> N'';                 OPEN GearTokenCur;                 FETCH NEXT FROM GearTokenCur INTO @GearToken;                 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0                 BEGIN                     SET @ResolvedGearName = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@GearToken,6,1)));                     SET @DigitStart = PATINDEX('%[0-9]%',@GearToken);                     SET @Digits = CASE WHEN @DigitStart > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@GearToken,@DigitStart,40) ELSE N'' END;                     SET @ParsedQty = TRY_CONVERT(int,LEFT(@Digits,                         CASE WHEN PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%',@Digits+N'X') > 0                              THEN PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%',@Digits+N'X')-1 ELSE LEN(@Digits) END));                      SET @ResolvedGearCode = NULL;                     SELECT TOP(1) @ResolvedGearCode = CONVERT(nvarchar(10),Code)                     FROM dbo.B20Gear                     WHERE Name=@ResolvedGearName AND ISNULL(IsActive,1)=1                     ORDER BY Id;                      IF @ResolvedGearCode IS NULL OR @ParsedQty IS NULL OR @ParsedQty <= 0                     BEGIN                         CLOSE GearTokenCur; DEALLOCATE GearTokenCur;                         CLOSE GearOrderCur; DEALLOCATE GearOrderCur;                         THROW 51224, N'Không phân tích được Gear hoặc số lượng trong TMP YMVN. Kiểm tra B20Gear.Name/Code và chuỗi GEAR.', 1;                     END;                      INSERT INTO #GearItems(ItemQty,GearName,GearCode)                     VALUES(@ParsedQty,@ResolvedGearName,@ResolvedGearCode);                      FETCH NEXT FROM GearTokenCur INTO @GearToken;                 END;                 CLOSE GearTokenCur;                 DEALLOCATE GearTokenCur;             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 SET @ResolvedGearName = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(ISNULL(@GearTextValue,N''),6,1)));                 SET @ResolvedGearCode = NULL;                 SELECT TOP(1) @ResolvedGearCode = CONVERT(nvarchar(10),Code)                 FROM dbo.B20Gear                 WHERE Name=@ResolvedGearName AND ISNULL(IsActive,1)=1                 ORDER BY Id;                  IF @ResolvedGearCode IS NULL                 BEGIN                     CLOSE GearOrderCur; DEALLOCATE GearOrderCur;                     THROW 51224, N'Không ánh xạ được Gear.Name sang Gear.Code trong B20Gear.', 1;                 END;                  INSERT INTO #GearItems(ItemQty,GearName,GearCode)                 VALUES(@OrderQty,@ResolvedGearName,@ResolvedGearCode);             END;              DECLARE GearItemCur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                 SELECT ItemQty,GearName,GearCode FROM #GearItems ORDER BY ItemId;             OPEN GearItemCur;             FETCH NEXT FROM GearItemCur INTO @ItemQty,@ItemGearName,@ItemGearCode;             WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0             BEGIN                 -- Reset trang thai ghep cho MOI gear item                 SET @Need = @ItemQty;                 SET @Pending = 0;                 SET @LotList = N'';                  DECLARE GearLotCur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                     SELECT StockId,LOT13,Qty                     FROM #GearStock                     WHERE PART=@Part AND GearCode=@ItemGearCode AND Qty>0                     ORDER BY SortKey,LOT13,StockId;                 OPEN GearLotCur;                 FETCH NEXT FROM GearLotCur INTO @StockId,@LotKey,@StockQty;                 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0                 BEGIN                     IF @StockQty < @Need                     BEGIN                         IF @Pending > 0                         BEGIN                             IF @StockQty < @Pending                             BEGIN                                 SET @LotList = @LotList + N',' + @LotKey + N'-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20),@StockQty);                                 SET @Pending = @Pending - @StockQty;                                 SET @Need = @Need - @StockQty;                                 UPDATE #GearStock SET Qty=0 WHERE StockId=@StockId;                             END                             ELSE                             BEGIN                                 SET @LotList = @LotList + N',' + @LotKey + N'-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20),@Pending);                                 INSERT INTO #GearResult(MH,GG,LG,GearName)                                 VALUES(@Part,@DeliveryTime,@LotList,@ItemGearName);                                 SET @LotList = N'';                                 SET @GearPartialQty = (@StockQty - @Pending) % @PackQty;                                 IF @GearPartialQty = 0                                     SET @Pending = 0;                                 ELSE                                 BEGIN                                     SET @Pending = @PackQty - @GearPartialQty;                                     SET @LotList = @LotKey + N'-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20),@GearPartialQty);                                 END;                                 SET @Need = @Need - @StockQty;                                 UPDATE #GearStock SET Qty=0 WHERE StockId=@StockId;                             END;                         END                         ELSE                         BEGIN                             SET @GearPartialQty = @StockQty % @PackQty;                             IF @GearPartialQty = 0                                 SET @Pending = 0;                             ELSE                                 SET @Pending = @PackQty - @GearPartialQty;                              IF @GearPartialQty > 0                             BEGIN                                 IF @LotList = N''                                 BEGIN                                     SET @LotList = @LotKey + N'-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20),@GearPartialQty);                                     SET @Need = @Need - @StockQty;                                 END                                 ELSE                                 BEGIN                                     SET @LotList = @LotList + N',' + @LotKey + N'-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20),@GearPartialQty);                                 END;                                 UPDATE #GearStock SET Qty=0 WHERE StockId=@StockId;                             END                             ELSE                             BEGIN                                 SET @Pending = 0;                                 SET @Need = @Need - @StockQty;                             END;                         END;                     END                     ELSE                     BEGIN                         IF @Pending > 0                         BEGIN                             SET @LotList = @LotList + N',' + @LotKey + N'-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20),@Pending);                             INSERT INTO #GearResult(MH,GG,LG,GearName)                             VALUES(@Part,@DeliveryTime,@LotList,@ItemGearName);                             SET @LotList = N'';                             SET @Pending = 0;                             UPDATE #GearStock SET Qty=@StockQty-@Need WHERE StockId=@StockId;                             SET @Need = 0;                             BREAK;                         END                         ELSE                         BEGIN                             UPDATE #GearStock SET Qty=@StockQty-@Need WHERE StockId=@StockId;                             BREAK;                         END;                     END;                      FETCH NEXT FROM GearLotCur INTO @StockId,@LotKey,@StockQty;                 END;                 CLOSE GearLotCur;                 DEALLOCATE GearLotCur;                  FETCH NEXT FROM GearItemCur INTO @ItemQty,@ItemGearName,@ItemGearCode;             END;             CLOSE GearItemCur;             DEALLOCATE GearItemCur;              FETCH NEXT FROM GearOrderCur INTO @Part,@OrderQty,@DeliveryDate,@DeliveryTime,@GearTextValue;         END;         CLOSE GearOrderCur;         DEALLOCATE GearOrderCur;          SELECT MH,GG,LG,GearName         FROM #GearResult         WHERE CHARINDEX(N',',LG)>0         ORDER BY ResultId;         RETURN;     END;      /* ======================= NHANH HVN (@USEGEAR = 0) ======================= */     SET NOCOUNT ON;       DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);     DECLARE @MAHANG NVARCHAR(56), @CUA NVARCHAR(10), @TRUYEN NVARCHAR(10), @SOLUONG INT,             @NGAYGIAO SMALLDATETIME, @GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50), @QCDG INT, @STT INT,             @HT_LOT NVARCHAR(30), @HT_SL INT,             @LOTGHEP NVARCHAR(MAX), @SLCANGHEP INT, @SLGHEP INT;     SET @STT = 0;       IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#TMPGHEPLOT') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TMPGHEPLOT;     CREATE TABLE #TMPGHEPLOT (MH NVARCHAR(56), GG NVARCHAR(50), LG NVARCHAR(MAX));       -- Đặt lại tồn tạm theo tồn thực tế     SET @SQL = N'UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = SLCONLAI         WHERE PART IN (SELECT MAHANG FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE) + N' GROUP BY MAHANG) AND SLCONLAI > 0';     EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;       -- Dùng bảng tạm (#) thay vì biến bảng (@) để dùng được bên trong sp_executesql     IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#IFSCursorTable') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #IFSCursorTable;     CREATE TABLE #IFSCursorTable (         ID INT IDENTITY(1,1),         MAHANG NVARCHAR(56),          SOLUONG INT,          NGAYGIAO SMALLDATETIME,          GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50)     );           SET @SQL = N'INSERT INTO #IFSCursorTable (MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO)                  SELECT MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE);     EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;       DECLARE IFSPGH CURSOR FOR         SELECT MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO FROM #IFSCursorTable ORDER BY ID;       OPEN IFSPGH;     FETCH NEXT FROM IFSPGH INTO @MAHANG, @SOLUONG, @NGAYGIAO, @GIOGIAO;     WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0     BEGIN         SET @STT = @STT + 1;                  IF EXISTS (SELECT CAST(MinCloseQty AS INT) FROM B20Item WHERE Code = @MAHANG)             SELECT @QCDG = CAST(MinCloseQty AS INT) FROM B20Item WHERE Code = @MAHANG;         ELSE             SET @QCDG = -1;           -- Cập nhật số lượng hộp trên bảng tạm         SET @SQL = N'UPDATE ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'             SET STT = @p_stt, HOP = CASE WHEN @p_qcdg > 0 THEN CEILING(CAST(@p_sl AS FLOAT) / @p_qcdg) ELSE 1 END             WHERE MAHANG = @p_mahang AND SOLUONG = @p_sl AND GIOGIAO = @p_giogiao';         EXEC sp_executesql @SQL,             N'@p_stt INT, @p_sl INT, @p_qcdg INT, @p_mahang NVARCHAR(56), @p_giogiao NVARCHAR(50)',             @STT, @SOLUONG, @QCDG, @MAHANG, @GIOGIAO;           ---- Duyệt ghép lô cho từng mốc số lượng (giữ quy cách đóng gói)         SET @LOTGHEP = '';         SET @SLCANGHEP = 0;         SET @SLGHEP = 0;          DECLARE DHT CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FORWARD_ONLY READ_ONLY FOR             SELECT LEFT(b.LOT, 20) AS LotKey, b.SLCONLAITMP             FROM STOCKTP b             WHERE b.PART = @MAHANG AND b.SLCONLAI > 0             ORDER BY TRY_CAST(LEFT(b.LOT, 20) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)), b.LOT;           OPEN DHT;         FETCH NEXT FROM DHT INTO @HT_LOT, @HT_SL;           -- VÒNG LẶP DUYỆT LÔ: Chỉ chạy khi còn hàng trong lô và số lượng cần xuất (@SOLUONG) lớn hơn 0         WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @SOLUONG > 0         BEGIN             IF (@HT_SL <= 0)             BEGIN                 FETCH NEXT FROM DHT INTO @HT_LOT, @HT_SL;                 CONTINUE;             END              IF (@QCDG IS NULL OR @QCDG <= 0)             BEGIN                 IF @HT_SL >= @SOLUONG                 BEGIN                     IF @LOTGHEP = '' SET @LOTGHEP = @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SOLUONG AS NVARCHAR);                     ELSE SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SOLUONG AS NVARCHAR);                      UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = SLCONLAITMP - @SOLUONG WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                     SET @SOLUONG = 0;                 END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     IF @LOTGHEP = '' SET @LOTGHEP = @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@HT_SL AS NVARCHAR);                     ELSE SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@HT_SL AS NVARCHAR);                      SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                     UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                 END             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 -- CÓ QUY CÁCH ĐÓNG GÓI (@QCDG > 0)                 IF (@HT_SL < @SOLUONG)                 BEGIN                     IF (@SLCANGHEP > 0)                     BEGIN                         IF (@HT_SL < @SLCANGHEP)                         BEGIN                             SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@HT_SL AS NVARCHAR);                             SET @SLCANGHEP = @SLCANGHEP - @HT_SL;                             SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                             UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                         END                         ELSE                         BEGIN                             SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SLCANGHEP AS NVARCHAR);                                                          DECLARE @DuDuoi INT = (@HT_SL - @SLCANGHEP) % @QCDG;                             IF (@DuDuoi = 0)                                 SET @SLCANGHEP = 0;                             ELSE                             BEGIN                                 SET @SLCANGHEP = @QCDG - @DuDuoi;                                 SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@DuDuoi AS NVARCHAR);                             END                                                          SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                             UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                         END                     END                     ELSE                     BEGIN                         SET @SLGHEP = @HT_SL % @QCDG;                         IF (@SLGHEP > 0)                         BEGIN                             SET @SLCANGHEP = (@SOLUONG % @QCDG) - @SLGHEP;                             IF @SLCANGHEP < 0 SET @SLCANGHEP = @QCDG - @SLGHEP;                              IF @LOTGHEP = ''                                 SET @LOTGHEP = @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SLGHEP AS NVARCHAR);                             ELSE                                 SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SLGHEP AS NVARCHAR);                         END                                                  SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                         UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                     END                 END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     -- LÔ NÀY ĐỦ HOẶC DƯ SỐ LƯỢNG CÒN LẠI CỦA ĐƠN HÀNG                     IF (@SLCANGHEP > 0)                     BEGIN                         IF (@HT_SL >= @SLCANGHEP)                         BEGIN                             SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SLCANGHEP AS NVARCHAR);                             UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = @HT_SL - @SLCANGHEP WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                             SET @SLCANGHEP = 0;                             -- Đã hoàn thành, trừ hết số lượng cần thiết và ngắt vòng lặp                             SET @SOLUONG = 0;                             BREAK;                         END                     END                     ELSE                     BEGIN                         -- Bốc trực tiếp phần số lượng còn thiếu từ lô này và chốt hạ                         IF @LOTGHEP = '' SET @LOTGHEP = @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SOLUONG AS NVARCHAR);                         ELSE SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SOLUONG AS NVARCHAR);                          UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = @HT_SL - @SOLUONG WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                         SET @SOLUONG = 0;                         BREAK; -- CẮT ĐỨT NGAY LẬP TỨC, KHÔNG CHO DUYỆT SANG CÁC LÔ PHÍA SAU NỮA!                     END                 END             END               FETCH NEXT FROM DHT INTO @HT_LOT, @HT_SL;         END           CLOSE DHT;         DEALLOCATE DHT;          -- CHỈ INSERT DUY NHẤT 1 DÒNG VÀO BẢNG TẠM SAU KHI ĐÃ GOM ĐỦ CHUỖI LÔ CHO MÃ HÀNG ĐÓ         IF @LOTGHEP <> ''         BEGIN             INSERT INTO #TMPGHEPLOT (MH, GG, LG) VALUES (@MAHANG, @GIOGIAO, @LOTGHEP);         END          -------------------------------         FETCH NEXT FROM IFSPGH INTO @MAHANG, @SOLUONG, @NGAYGIAO, @GIOGIAO;     END     CLOSE IFSPGH;     DEALLOCATE IFSPGH;       SELECT * FROM #TMPGHEPLOT WHERE CHARINDEX(',', LG, 1) > 0; END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_gheplot]     @TMPTABLE NVARCHAR(128) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',     @IFSTABLE NVARCHAR(128) = N'IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG' AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;       DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);     DECLARE @MAHANG NVARCHAR(56), @CUA NVARCHAR(10), @TRUYEN NVARCHAR(10), @SOLUONG INT,             @NGAYGIAO SMALLDATETIME, @GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50), @QCDG INT, @STT INT,             @HT_LOT NVARCHAR(30), @HT_SL INT,             @LOTGHEP NVARCHAR(500), @SLCANGHEP INT, @SLGHEP INT, @SLGIAO_CONLAI INT;     SET @STT = 0;       IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#TMPGHEPLOT') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TMPGHEPLOT;     CREATE TABLE #TMPGHEPLOT (MH NVARCHAR(56), GG NVARCHAR(50), LG NVARCHAR(500));       -- Duyet: dat lai ton tam theo ton that     SET @SQL = N'UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = SLCONLAI         WHERE PART IN (SELECT MAHANG FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE) + N' GROUP BY MAHANG) AND SLCONLAI > 0';     EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;       DECLARE @IFSCursorTable TABLE (MAHANG NVARCHAR(56), SOLUONG INT, NGAYGIAO SMALLDATETIME, GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50));     SET @SQL = N'SELECT MAHANG, SUM(SOLUONG), NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE)              + N' GROUP BY MAHANG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO';      -- ── Nguồn: đúng tập dòng của phiên (đã lọc giờ + bỏ dòng OK khi nạp TMP) ─────────────     CREATE TABLE #Src (MAHANG nvarchar(56) NULL, SOLUONG int NOT NULL, NGAYGIAO datetime NULL,                        GIOGIAO nvarchar(50) NULL, TTGEAR nvarchar(256) NULL);     DECLARE @sql nvarchar(max) = N'         INSERT INTO #Src (MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO, TTGEAR)         SELECT MAHANG, ISNULL(TRY_CAST(SOLUONG AS int), 0), NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO, ' + QUOTENAME(@gearCol) + N'         FROM ' + @tbl + N';';     EXEC sp_executesql @sql;      -- ── Tồn tạm trong bộ nhớ (thay cho STOCKTP.SLCONLAITMP) ────────────────────────────────     CREATE TABLE #Stk (Id int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, PART nvarchar(100) NULL, LOT13 nvarchar(13) NULL,                        GEARCH nvarchar(1) NULL, SLTMP int NOT NULL, SORTKEY float NULL);     INSERT INTO #Stk (PART, LOT13, GEARCH, SLTMP, SORTKEY)     SELECT b.PART, SUBSTRING(b.LOT, 1, 13), RIGHT(SUBSTRING(b.LOT, 1, 13), 1),            CAST(b.SLCONLAI AS int), TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(b.LOT, 1, 13) AS float)     FROM dbo.STOCKTP b     WHERE b.SLCONLAI > 0 AND b.PART IN (SELECT MAHANG FROM #Src);      CREATE TABLE #Res (Id int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, MH nvarchar(56), GG nvarchar(50),                        LG nvarchar(1000), GearName nvarchar(1));      DECLARE @MAHANG nvarchar(56), @SOLUONG int, @NGAYGIAO datetime, @GIOGIAO nvarchar(50),             @TTGEAR nvarchar(256), @GearCode nvarchar(1), @GearName nvarchar(1),             @QCDG int, @LOTGHEP nvarchar(1000), @SLCANGHEP int, @SLGHEP int,             @ItemSL int, @ItemGear nvarchar(1), @HT_LOT nvarchar(13), @HT_SL int,             @nItems int;                             SET @LOTGHEP = N'';                             SET @SLGHEP = (@HT_SL - @SLCANGHEP) % @QCDG;                             IF @SLGHEP = 0                             BEGIN                                 SET @SLCANGHEP = 0;                             END                             ELSE                             BEGIN                                 SET @SLCANGHEP = @QCDG - @SLGHEP;                                 SET @LOTGHEP = @HT_LOT + N'-' + CAST(@SLGHEP AS nvarchar(20));                             END;                             SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                             UPDATE #Stk SET SLTMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LOT13 = @HT_LOT;                         END;                     END                     ELSE                     BEGIN                         SET @SLGHEP = @HT_SL % @QCDG;                         IF @SLGHEP = 0                         BEGIN                             SET @SLCANGHEP = 0;                         END                         ELSE                         BEGIN                             SET @SLCANGHEP = @QCDG - @SLGHEP;                         END;                         IF @SLGHEP > 0                         BEGIN                             IF @LOTGHEP = N''                             BEGIN                                 SET @LOTGHEP = @HT_LOT + N'-' + CAST(@SLGHEP AS nvarchar(20)); SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + N',' + @HT_LOT + N'-' + CAST(@SLGHEP AS nvarchar(20));                                 UPDATE #Stk SET SLTMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LOT13 = @HT_LOT;                             END;                         END                         ELSE                         BEGIN                             SET @SLCANGHEP = 0;                             SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                         END;                     END;                 END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     IF @SLCANGHEP > 0                     BEGIN                         SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + N',' + @HT_LOT + N'-' + CAST(@SLCANGHEP AS nvarchar(20));                         INSERT INTO #Res (MH, GG, LG, GearName) VALUES (@MAHANG, @GIOGIAO, @LOTGHEP, @GearName);                         SET @LOTGHEP = N'';                         SET @SLCANGHEP = 0;                         UPDATE #Stk SET SLTMP = @HT_SL - @SOLUONG WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LOT13 = @HT_LOT;                         SET @SOLUONG = 0;                         BREAK;                     END                     ELSE                     BEGIN                         SET @SLCANGHEP = 0;                         UPDATE #Stk SET SLTMP = @HT_SL - @SOLUONG WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LOT13 = @HT_LOT;                         BREAK;                     END;                 END;                  FETCH NEXT FROM LotCur INTO @HT_LOT, @HT_SL;             END;             CLOSE LotCur;             DEALLOCATE LotCur;              FETCH NEXT FROM ItemCur INTO @ItemSL, @ItemGear;         END;         CLOSE ItemCur;         DEALLOCATE ItemCur;          FETCH NEXT FROM RowCur INTO @MAHANG, @SOLUONG, @NGAYGIAO, @GIOGIAO, @TTGEAR, @GearCode, @GearName;     END;     CLOSE RowCur;     DEALLOCATE RowCur;      SELECT MH, GG, LG, GearName FROM #Res WHERE CHARINDEX(N',', LG, 1) > 0 ORDER BY Id; END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_LOAD_HANGTHIEUView]         @TENBAN NVARCHAR(100) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANGView' -- ← Tên bảng động của máy trạm AS     BEGIN         SET NOCOUNT ON;          -- ── 1. KHỞI TẠO BẢNG CHỨA KẾT QUẢ ĐỘNG (BẢNG VẬT LÝ THEO MÁY TRẠM) ──────     DECLARE @sqlCreateResult NVARCHAR(MAX)     SET @sqlCreateResult = N'         CREATE TABLE [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + '] (             MH NVARCHAR(56),             SLGIAO INT,             SLTHIEU INT,             GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50)         )'     EXEC sp_executesql @sqlCreateResult      -- ── 3. TÍNH TOÁN @MaxDaGiao BẰNG DYNAMIC SQL ────────────────────────────     DECLARE @MaxDaGiao INT = 0     DECLARE @sqlMax NVARCHAR(MAX)      SET @sqlMax = N'         IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG WHERE NGAYGIAO = (SELECT TOP 1 NGAYGIAO FROM TBL_TT_MA) AND LEN(GIOGIAO) < 4)           BEGIN               SELECT @MaxOut = MAX(CAST(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(''h'', GIOGIAO, 1) > 0                                               THEN SUBSTRING(GIOGIAO, 1, CHARINDEX(''h'', GIOGIAO, 1) - 1)                                              ELSE GIOGIAO                                         END AS INT))              FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG               WHERE NGAYGIAO <= (SELECT TOP 1 NGAYGIAO FROM TBL_TT_MAView) AND LEN(GIOGIAO) < 4           END'          EXEC sp_executesql @sqlMax, N'@MaxOut INT OUTPUT', @MaxOut = @MaxDaGiao OUTPUT     SET @MaxDaGiao = ISNULL(@MaxDaGiao, 0)      -- ── 4. THỰC THI LOGIC DUYỆT DỮ LIỆU SỬ DỤNG DYNAMIC SQL TOÀN BỘ ────────     DECLARE @sqlMain NVARCHAR(MAX)     SET @sqlMain = N'         DECLARE @MAHANG NVARCHAR(56), @TTSLGIAO INT, @GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50)         DECLARE @TK INT, @SLT INT, @SLGIAO INT          DECLARE IFSPGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR           SELECT MAHANG, SUM(TTSLG) as TTSLG          FROM TBL_TT_MAView           WHERE CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) > @MaxDaGiao          GROUP BY MAHANG            OPEN IFSPGH           FETCH NEXT FROM IFSPGH INTO @MAHANG, @TTSLGIAO           WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0           BEGIN               SELECT @TK = ISNULL(SUM(slconlai), 0) FROM STOCKTP WHERE SLCONLAI > 0 AND PART = @MAHANG                            IF (@TK < @TTSLGIAO)               BEGIN                   DECLARE DUYETHT CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                   SELECT MAHANG, SUM(TTSLG) as TTSLG, GIOGIAO                   FROM TBL_TT_MAView                   WHERE CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) > @MaxDaGiao AND MAHANG = @MAHANG                  GROUP BY MAHANG, GIOGIAO                  ORDER BY CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) ASC                    OPEN DUYETHT                   FETCH NEXT FROM DUYETHT INTO @MAHANG, @SLGIAO, @GIOGIAO                   WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                   BEGIN                       IF (@TK > 0)                       BEGIN                           IF (@SLGIAO < @TK)                           BEGIN                               SET @TK = @TK - @SLGIAO                               SET @TTSLGIAO = @TTSLGIAO - @SLGIAO                           END                           ELSE                           BEGIN                               SET @SLT = @SLGIAO - @TK                               SET @TK = 0                               INSERT INTO [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + '] VALUES(@MAHANG, @SLGIAO, @SLT, @GIOGIAO)                           END                       END                       ELSE                       BEGIN                           INSERT INTO [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + '] VALUES(@MAHANG, @SLGIAO, @SLGIAO, @GIOGIAO)                       END                        FETCH NEXT FROM DUYETHT INTO @MAHANG, @SLGIAO, @GIOGIAO                   END                   CLOSE DUYETHT                   DEALLOCATE DUYETHT               END                FETCH NEXT FROM IFSPGH INTO @MAHANG, @TTSLGIAO           END                    CLOSE IFSPGH           DEALLOCATE IFSPGH     '      -- Thực thi chuỗi lệnh để đổ dữ liệu vào bảng vật lý động riêng biệt     EXEC sp_executesql @sqlMain, N'@MaxDaGiao INT', @MaxDaGiao = @MaxDaGiao      -- ── 5. CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_Update_Stock]           @GIOGIAOFCC NVARCHAR(250) = N'',           @NHAMAY     NVARCHAR(250) = N''      AS       BEGIN           SET NOCOUNT ON;                  DECLARE @NgayGiao SMALLDATETIME = CAST(GETDATE() AS SMALLDATETIME)                  DECLARE               @_LOT        NVARCHAR(MAX),               @_STTPHIEU   INT,               @_SL         INT,               @_STATUS     NVARCHAR(5),               @_SLCONLAI   INT,               @STT         INT,               @MH          NVARCHAR(60),               @_LOTSL_Tach NVARCHAR(500),               @_LOTOK      NVARCHAR(500),               @_SLOK       INT,               @_KTPC       INT                  -- =====================================================================           -- KHỞI TẠO CÁC BẢNG TẠM           -- =====================================================================           IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#TMPUPDATE') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TMPUPDATE           CREATE TABLE #TMPUPDATE (             STT     INT,             MH      NVARCHAR(60),             LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),             SOLUONG INT,             STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)         )              IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STOK') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #STOK         CREATE TABLE #STOK (             STT     INT,             LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),             SOLUONG INT,             STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)         )              IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STNG') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #STNG         CREATE TABLE #STNG (             MH      NVARCHAR(100),             LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),             SLCAN   INT,            -- Số lượng cần xuất         SLCO    INT,            -- Số lượng tồn kho hiện tại         SLTHIEU INT,            -- Số lượng hụt thiếu         STATUS  NVARCHAR(500)         )                  BEGIN TRY                  -- 1. CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_Update_Stock2405]       @GIOGIAOFCC  NVARCHAR(250) = N'',       @NHAMAY      NVARCHAR(250) = N'',       @TMPTABLE    NVARCHAR(128) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',       @DOCQRTABLE  NVARCHAR(128) = N'DOCQRCODE',     @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NVARCHAR(20) = N'INPUT'   AS   BEGIN       SET NOCOUNT ON;          /*           ================================================================           QUY ƯỚC LOT           ================================================================              STOCKTP.LOT đầy đủ là định danh chính xác của LOT vật lý.          - Nếu đầu vào dài hơn 13 ký tự: chỉ khớp RTRIM(STOCKTP.LOT) = RTRIM(@LOT).         - Nếu đầu vào chỉ có mã gốc 13 ký tự: chỉ chấp nhận khi mã gốc ánh xạ tới           đúng một LOT vật lý; nếu có nhiều LOT vật lý thì ghi lỗi và dừng trước           mọi cập nhật tồn.         - Tuyệt đối không cộng tồn của nhiều LOT vật lý theo tiền tố rồi trừ một           LOT bất kỳ. Kiểm tra khả dụng và bước trừ kho phải dùng cùng quy tắc.     */          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 1. WHITELIST TÊN BẢNG       --------------------------------------------------------------------       IF @TMPTABLE NOT IN       (           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_SP',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANGDB',         N'SP_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100002',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100003'       )       BEGIN           RAISERROR(               N'Tên bảng TMPTABLE không hợp lệ: %s',               16,               1,               @TMPTABLE           );           RETURN;       END;          IF @DOCQRTABLE NOT IN       (           N'DOCQRCODE',           N'DOCQRCODE_SP',         N'DOCQRCODE_DB',         N'SP_DOCQRCODE',         N'YMVN_DOCQRCODE',         N'DOCQRCODE_100002',         N'DOCQRCODE_100003'       )       BEGIN           RAISERROR(               N'Tên bảng DOCQRTABLE không hợp lệ: %s',               16,               1,               @DOCQRTABLE           );           RETURN;       END;          IF @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NOT IN (N'INPUT', N'FIFO_SP')     BEGIN         RAISERROR(N'LOTRESOLUTIONMODE không hợp lệ: %s', 16, 1, @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE);         RETURN;     END;      --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 2. KHAI BÁO BIẾN       --------------------------------------------------------------------       DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);     DECLARE @StartedTransaction BIT = 0;     DECLARE @ErrMH NVARCHAR(60) = NULL;   -- mã hàng đang xử lý khi lỗi nghiệp vụ FIFO_SP     DECLARE @ErrQty INT = NULL;           -- số lượng cần giao của dòng đó     DECLARE @ErrTon INT = NULL;           -- tổng tồn khả dụng của mã hàng (chỉ để hiển thị)     DECLARE @SavepointCreated BIT = 0;          DECLARE           @_LOT          NVARCHAR(MAX),           @_SLCONLAI     INT,           @STT           INT,           @MH            NVARCHAR(60),           @_LOTSL_Tach   NVARCHAR(500),           @_LOTOK        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLOK         INT,           @_KTPC         INT,           @_LOTUD        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLUD         INT,           @_STTUD        INT,           @_STUP         NVARCHAR(15),           @LotThuc       NVARCHAR(500),         @LockResource  NVARCHAR(255),         @LockResult    INT,         @StockRowsUpdated INT;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 3. XÓA TEMP TABLE CŨ       --------------------------------------------------------------------       IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#TMPUPDATE') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #TMPUPDATE;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STOK') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #STOK;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STNG') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #STNG;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#PHIEU') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #PHIEU;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#GomNhomCheck') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #GomNhomCheck;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SplitResult') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #SplitResult;        IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#StockByLot') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #StockByLot;      IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#LotKeyCount') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #LotKeyCount;        --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 4. TEMP TABLE       --------------------------------------------------------------------       CREATE TABLE #TMPUPDATE       (           STT     INT,           MH      NVARCHAR(60),           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STOK       (           STT     INT,           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STNG       (           MH       NVARCHAR(100),           LOT      NVARCHAR(MAX),           SLCAN    INT,           SLCO     INT,           SLTHIEU  INT,           STATUS   NVARCHAR(500)       );          CREATE TABLE #PHIEU       (           STT INT,           LOT NVARCHAR(MAX),           MH  NVARCHAR(60)       );          BEGIN TRY          -- Own a transaction when called directly; otherwise participate in the         -- repository UnitOfWork through a savepoint. Start before the idempotency         -- check so concurrent confirmations serialize before reading/writing stock.         IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0         BEGIN             BEGIN TRANSACTION;             SET @StartedTransaction = 1;         END         ELSE         BEGIN             SAVE TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             SET @SavepointCreated = 1;         END;            ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 5. NẠP PHIẾU           ----------------------------------------------------------------           SET @sql = N'               INSERT INTO #PHIEU               (                   STT,                   LOT,                   MH               )               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   MAHANG               FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']               WHERE ISNULL(LOT, '''') <> ''''   -- chỉ xử lý dòng ĐÃ có LOT (đã thống kê); dòng chưa có LOT bỏ qua, kể cả FIFO_SP               AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);           ';              EXEC sp_executesql @sql,             N'@LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NVARCHAR(20)',             @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- Không có phiếu           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #PHIEU)           BEGIN             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 COMMIT TRANSACTION;                SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 6. DUYỆT PHIẾU           ----------------------------------------------------------------           DECLARE PGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   MH               FROM #PHIEU;              OPEN PGH;              FETCH NEXT FROM PGH           INTO @STT, @_LOT, @MH;              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0           BEGIN               DECLARE @DaTon BIT = 0;                  DECLARE @CheckResult TABLE               (                   Found INT               );                  ------------------------------------------------------------             -- 6.1. Serialize the complete delivery identity before checking for             -- an existing confirmation. The lock is transaction-owned and therefore             -- remains held through STOCKTP, ledger, and pending-delivery writes.             ------------------------------------------------------------             SET @LockResource = NULL;             SET @sql = N'                 SELECT @Resource =                     N''PCTP_DELIVERY:'' +                     CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64), HASHBYTES(''SHA2_256'', CONCAT(                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(MAHANG, N''''))), N''|'',                         ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS DATE), 23), N''''), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(CUA, N''''))), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(TRUYEN, N''''))), N''|'',                         ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), SOLUONG), N''''), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(GIOGIAO, N''''))), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(ISNULL(@NHAMAY, N''''), 50)))                     )), 2)                 FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']                 WHERE STT = @STT;';              EXEC sp_executesql                 @sql,                 N'@STT INT, @NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250), @Resource NVARCHAR(255) OUTPUT',                 @STT = @STT,                 @NHAMAY = @NHAMAY,                 @Resource = @LockResource OUTPUT;              IF @LockResource IS NULL                 RAISERROR(N'Không tạo được khóa chống xác nhận giao hàng trùng.', 16, 1);              EXEC @LockResult = sys.sp_getapplock                 @Resource = @LockResource,                 @LockMode = N'Exclusive',                 @LockOwner = N'Transaction',                 @LockTimeout = 10000;              IF @LockResult < 0                 RAISERROR(N'Không lấy được khóa xác nhận giao hàng; vui lòng thử lại.', 16, 1);              ------------------------------------------------------------             -- 6.1. KIỂM TRA PHIẾU ĐÃ LƯU             ------------------------------------------------------------             SET @sql = N'                   SELECT TOP 1 1                   FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] tmp                   INNER JOIN LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG luu                       ON RTRIM(luu.MAHANG) =                          RTRIM(tmp.MAHANG)                         AND CAST(luu.NGAYGIAO AS DATE) =                          CAST(tmp.NGAYGIAO AS DATE)                         AND RTRIM(luu.CUA) =                          RTRIM(tmp.CUA)                         AND RTRIM(luu.TRUYEN) =                          RTRIM(tmp.TRUYEN)                         AND luu.SOLUONG =                          tmp.SOLUONG                         AND RTRIM(luu.GIOGIAO) =                          RTRIM(tmp.GIOGIAO)                         AND RTRIM(luu.NHAMAY) =                          RTRIM(LEFT(@NHAMAY, 50))                      WHERE tmp.STT = @STT;               ';                  INSERT INTO @CheckResult               EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'@NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250), @STT INT',                   @NHAMAY,                   @STT;                  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @CheckResult)                   SET @DaTon = 1;                  DELETE FROM @CheckResult;                  ------------------------------------------------------------               -- 6.2. ĐÃ TỒN TẠI               ------------------------------------------------------------               IF @DaTon = 1               BEGIN                   INSERT INTO #STNG                   (                       MH,                       LOT,                       SLCAN,                       SLCO,                       SLTHIEU,                       STATUS                   )                   VALUES                   (                       @MH,                       @_LOT,                  0,                       0,                       0,                       N'Mã hàng này đã được lưu trước đó!'                   );               END               ELSE               BEGIN                      --------------------------------------------------------                    --------------------------------------------------------                 -- 6.2a. FIFO_SP: chọn một LOT vật lý đủ tồn trong cùng transaction.                 --------------------------------------------------------                 IF @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = N'FIFO_SP' AND ISNULL(@_LOT, N'') = N''   -- không ghi đè LOT đã thống kê                 BEGIN                     DECLARE @FifoLot NVARCHAR(500) = NULL;                     DECLARE @FifoQty INT = NULL;                      SET @sql = N'                         SELECT @Qty = TRY_CONVERT(INT, SOLUONG)                         FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)                         WHERE STT = @STT                           AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);                          SELECT TOP (1) @Lot = s.LOT                         FROM STOCKTP s WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK)                         WHERE COALESCE(                               NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.SP)), N''''),                               NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.PART)), N'''')                           ) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@MaHang))                           AND ISNULL(s.SLCONLAI, 0) >= @Qty                           AND LEN(ISNULL(s.LOT, N'''')) >= 7                           AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LEFT(s.LOT, 6), 12) IS NOT NULL                           AND SUBSTRING(s.LOT, 7, 1) IN (N''0'', N''1'', N''2'', N''3'')                         ORDER BY LEFT(s.LOT, 6) ASC,                             CASE SUBSTRING(s.LOT, 7, 1)                                 WHEN N''0'' THEN 0 WHEN N''1'' THEN 1                                 WHEN N''2'' THEN 2 WHEN N''3'' THEN 3                             END ASC, s.LOT ASC;';                      EXEC sp_executesql @sql,                         N'@STT INT, @MaHang NVARCHAR(60), @Qty INT OUTPUT, @Lot NVARCHAR(500) OUTPUT',                         @STT=@STT, @MaHang=@MH,                         @Qty=@FifoQty OUTPUT, @Lot=@FifoLot OUTPUT;                      IF @FifoQty IS NULL OR @FifoQty <= 0                     BEGIN                         SET @ErrMH = @MH;                         SET @ErrQty = @FifoQty;                         THROW 51035, N'Số lượng giao SP phải lớn hơn 0.', 1;                     END;                     IF @FifoLot IS NULL                     BEGIN                         SET @ErrMH = @MH;                         SET @ErrQty = @FifoQty;                         THROW 51036, N'Không tìm được một LOT FIFO đủ tồn cho mã hàng SP (cần đủ trong MỘT LOT, đúng định dạng yyMMdd + [0-3]).', 1;
